⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

  • Une première expérience commerciale (Stage, Alternance ou CDI), idéalement d’un à deux ans en startup, en SDR, Inside Sales, prospection B2B ou relation client.

  • Une vraie appétence pour la prospection : prendre contact, obtenir les bonnes informations, relancer et transformer une approche en rendez-vous qualifié.

  • La capacité à organiser un volume important de comptes, à prioriser et à tenir un suivi précis dans un CRM.

  • Une communication orale et écrite claire, adaptée à des interlocuteurs de direction de structures de santé.

Nice-to-have

  • Une expérience dans la santé ou auprès de professionnels et d’établissements de santé.

  • Une première expérience dans un environnement startup ou scale-up.

  • La pratique d’outils de CRM et de prospection.

Soft skills

Tu es énergique et tu aimes avancer sur un périmètre à construire. Face à une base peu qualifiée, tu sais chercher, trier l’information et décider par où commencer, sans te disperser. Tu communiques simplement, tu écoutes avant de proposer un rendez-vous et tu acceptes les retours pour ajuster ta manière de faire. L’humilité compte : tu travailleras avec une équipe Sales expérimentée et tu sauras apprendre à ses côtés tout en apportant tes propres observations du terrain.

Nos valeurs

Embrace Complexity. Tu avances dans un secteur de santé complexe et sur un portefeuille encore peu structuré, en transformant progressivement des informations éparses en opportunités qualifiées.

Bienveillance. Tu collabores étroitement avec les Sales, dans une équipe où l’entraide et le partage d’informations font partie du quotidien.

Real Impact. Chaque rendez-vous qualifié peut contribuer à équiper davantage de structures de santé avec des outils qui simplifient la circulation des documents.

👥 Process de recrutement

jobs.title: Simulation Engineer - Drone Physical Models Integration
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As our GNC, ML, Embedded Software, and Validation teams scale, they rely increasingly on simulation to develop and test our autonomous defense systems. The value of that simulation depends directly on how faithfully it reproduces the real behavior of our drones.

Joining the Tooling team, you will be responsible for bringing the physical models of our drones into the simulator—including aerodynamics, propulsion, electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems. Designed by expert domain teams, these models require your expertise to translate user needs, integrate models into the simulator software stack, and validate expected behavior. Because not every use case requires the same level of realism, you will help establish the appropriate fidelity targets across applications.

This role offers high ownership and the opportunity to work at the intersection of physics, software engineering, and AI robotics with direct mission impact.

Responsibilities

  • Coordination with Domain Experts: Work with the teams in charge of aerodynamics, propulsion, electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems to understand their models, their assumptions, and their inputs and outputs, and to agree on how they are delivered to the simulator.

  • Model Integration: Integrate these models into the simulator software stack in a clean, performant, and maintainable way, with clear interfaces and configurable parameters.

  • Validation: Define and run tests that check the integrated models against the reference data given by the expert teams (flight logs, bench tests, manufacturer data), and report discrepancies back to the model owners.

  • User Needs & Fidelity Targets: Work with the simulator users (GNC, Embedded, Validation) to understand their use cases, and translate them into a realism target for each model. Pick the right balance between fidelity, performance, and integration effort, and prioritise the model integration work to match.

  • Documentation & Standards: Document the integrated models, their parameters, validity domains, and validation results, and help standardise the model integration and validation process.

Candidate requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in software engineering, simulation, or a related engineering field.

  • Physics Understanding: Good understanding of flight dynamics and enough physics background to discuss models with experts in aerodynamics, propulsion, electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems, and to turn their models into working code.

  • Integration & Validation: Experience integrating third-party models or components into a larger software system, and validating them against experimental data with a rigorous approach.

  • Technical Proficiency: Comfortable with C++ and Python, with a good knowledge of Linux environments.

  • Educational Background: MSc or BSc in Aerospace Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, Applied Physics, or a similar technical field; equivalent professional experience is equally valued.

Plus (nice to have)

  • Experience with drones or robotic systems, ideally with open-source autopilots like PX4 or ArduPilot.

  • Hands-on experience with flight testing, test benches, or log analysis.

  • French language skills.

Mindset

  • Rigor: Empirical and disciplined about validation, grounded in real test data, and skeptical of a result that only exists in simulation.

  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication, comfortable working with several specialized teams, asking the right questions, and sharing validation results with them.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Pædagogmedhjælper / vikar søges til Rønnebæk Børne- og Ungehjem som timeansat
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at skabe en tryg og meningsfuld hverdag for børn og unge? Rønnebæk Børne- og Ungehjem søger en timeansat pædagogmedhjælper til 25–37 timer om ugen. Hvis du ønsker det, kan du i perioder få tildelt flere timer.

Om Rønnebæk

Vi har 12 pladser til børn og unge i alderen 6–18 år og et team på 16 medarbejdere. Vi arbejder ud fra en systemisk-narrativ tilgang med fokus på relationer, trivsel og udvikling. Du får en introduktion til vores tilgang og de daglige opgaver.

Dine opgaver

Du bliver en del af børnenes og de unges hverdag og deltager i både pædagogiske og praktiske opgaver. Du skal være med til at skabe struktur og nærvær, støtte børnene i deres daglige rutiner og deltage i aktiviteter sammen med dem.

Vi søger dig, der

  • Har interesse for arbejdet med børn og unge, som har brug for særlig støtte.

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og kan være en rolig og tydelig voksen.

  • Er fleksibel og bidrager til et godt teamsamarbejde.

  • Har humor og lyst til at deltage aktivt i hverdagen.

  • Har kørekort til personbil, da kørsel indgår i arbejdet.

  • Pædagogisk uddannelse er ikke et krav

Arbejdstid

Rønnebæk er bemandet hele døgnet. På hverdage ligger vagterne primært kl. 14–22 eller kl. 15–09 med overnatning. Der kan også være formiddagsvagter efter behov.

I weekenderne ligger vagterne typisk kl. 10–23, og der kan forekomme nattevagter. Du skal som udgangspunkt arbejde en samlet lørdag og søndag hver fjerde uge samt en fredag, lørdag eller søndag forskudt 14 dage.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et meningsfuldt arbejde med mulighed for at gøre en forskel for børn og unge.

  • Introduktion til opgaverne og vores faglige tilgang.

  • Et kollegialt fællesskab med fokus på samarbejde.

  • En høj grad af medbestemmelse.

  • Gratis kost og drikkevarer i arbejdstiden.

  • Mulighed for flere timer i perioder, hvis du ønsker det.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job-opslag@outlook.com. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte leder Thomas Emil Nøddelund på telefon 22 34 22 30.

Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

jobs.title: Pædagoger søges til fuldtidsvikariat på specialskole på Fyn
jobs.description:
Vil du være en del af et fast team og bidrage til en tryg,
struktureret og udviklende skoledag for børn med særlige behov? 
Udviklingsbasen søger pædagogiske medarbejdere til et vikariat som udgangspunkt er på 37 timer om ugen, på en specialskole på Fyn. Vikariatet starter hurtigst muligt og løber frem til jul. Du får dit eget skema og bliver tilknyttet det faste team omkring den eller de klasser, du skal arbejde i. 

Om skolen og børnene 
Børnene har forskellige udfordringer, som påvirker deres evne til hensigtsmæssig følelsesregulering. Det kan blandt andet være ADHD, adfærd inden for autismespektret, angst eller relations- og tilknytningsvanskeligheder. Børnene er i udgangspunktet normalt begavede. Skolen har både undervisning og morgen- og eftermiddags-SFO. 

Din rolle i hverdagen 
Du får timer i både skolen og SFO'en. Arbejdet vil primært være i indskolingen og/eller på mellemtrinnet. Dog skal du være fleksibel og kunne træde til i andre klasser ved behov. Som en del af det faste team skal du bidrage aktivt til en stabil hverdag, følge skolens pædagogiske retning og samarbejde tæt med dine kolleger om børnenes trivsel, deltagelse og udvikling. 

Vi søger dig, der 
Vi ser meget gerne, at du er uddannet pædagog og har erfaring med børn, der har behov for tydelig struktur, nærvær og professionel støtte til følelsesregulering. Det er vigtigt, at du kan skabe ro og forudsigelighed, indgå loyalt i skolens pædagogiske arbejde og bidrage konstruktivt til det tværfaglige samarbejde. Du skal samtidig kunne være fleksibel og bevare overblikket i en omskiftelig hverdag. 

Arbejdstid og ansættelse 
Stillingen er i udgangspunkt på37 timer om ugen med arbejdstid på alle hverdage mellem kl. 07.15 og 16.00. Du får et skema, så du får en forudsigelig arbejdsuge og mulighed for at blive en integreret del af skolens hverdag og faglige fællesskab. 

Det tilbyder vi 
Hos Udviklingsbasen får du mulighed for at bruge og udvikle dine pædagogiske kompetencer i en specialiseret skolekontekst. Du bliver en del af et fast team, får et tydeligt arbejdsgrundlag og kan opbygge værdifuld erfaring med special pædagogik, skole og SFO. Vi lægger vægt på høj faglighed, ordentlighed og tæt dialog gennem hele forløbet. 

Opstart og ansøgning 
Inden opstart inviteres du til en samtale på skolen, så både du og skolen får mulighed for at afstemme forventninger og sikre det rette match. Vi ansætter løbende og ønsker opstart hurtigst muligt, så send gerne din korte ansøgning og dit CV via ansøgningsformularen her på siden. 

 

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte os på 75 66 11 22.
Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Tekninen asiakaspalvelija / Vuokraamotyöntekijä (Turku)
jobs.description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme vakituista vuokraamotyöntekijää vahvistamaan heidän tiimiään. Click Henkilöstöpalvelut avustaa rekrytointiprosessissa, mutta tehtävään valittava henkilö palkataan suoraan asiakasyrityksen työntekijäksi. Asiakasyrityksemme on rakennus- ja työmaakaluston vuokraukseen erikoistunut yritys, joka palvelee rakennusalan ammattilaisia laajalla kone- ja laitevalikoimalla. Tässä tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisen kaluston parissa ja auttamaan asiakkaita löytämään oikeat ratkaisut erilaisiin rakennus-, remontti- ja maanrakennusprojekteihin.

Etsimme käytännönläheistä henkilöä, joka viihtyy koneiden, laitteiden ja asiakkaiden parissa. Vuokraamotyöntekijänä vastaat monipuolisesti kaluston vuokrausprosessista ja asiakkaiden palvelusta. Töitä tehdään arkisin 37,5 h/vko, ja työt on mahdollista aloittaa marraskuun alussa.

Työtehtävät:

\-Asiakkaiden palvelu ja tarpeisiin sopivan kaluston kartoittaminen

\-Koneiden ja laitteiden luovutukset sekä vastaanotot

\-Kaluston tarkastus, järjestely ja käyttökunnosta huolehtiminen

\-Asiakkaiden opastus laitteiden turvalliseen käyttöön

\-Kuormaukset, purkamiset ja kaluston siirtely

\-Vuokrausjärjestelmän käyttö sekä muut päivittäiset vuokraamon tehtävät

Kalusto on erittäin monipuolinen sisältäen esimerkiksi pienkoneita, rakennustyökaluja, henkilönostimia, maanrakennuskoneita, työmaakalustoa sekä erilaisia erikoislaitteita.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?:

\-Teknistä ymmärrystä tai kiinnostusta koneisiin ja laitteisiin

\-Asiakaslähtöinen ja reipas työote

\-Oma-aloitteisuutta ja kykyä tarttua erilaisiin tehtäviin

\-Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja valmiutta käytännön tekemiseen

\-Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä kaluston osaajaksi

Aikaisempi kokemus esimerkiksi rakennusalalta, koneiden parista, huollosta, logistiikasta tai teknisestä asiakaspalvelusta katsotaan eduksi.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

\-Monipuolisen työn rakennuskaluston ja koneiden parissa

\-Mahdollisuuden oppia laajasti erilaisesta ammattikalustosta

\-Vaihtelevan työn, jossa yhdistyvät asiakaspalvelu ja käytännön tekeminen

\-Hyvän perehdytyksen tehtävään

\-Mukavan työyhteisön ja pitkäaikaisen työmahdollisuuden

Täytä hakemus ohessa olevan linkin kautta ja kerro siinä mahdollisimman kattavasti itsestäsi, osaamisestasi sekä aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Click Henkilöstöpalveluiden rekrytointikonsultti Patrik Sarin, puh. 050 411 0345. Tiedustelut arkisin klo 8-16.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join Biomason’s production facility in Ikast.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is motivated by solving real technical challenges, improving operational and equipment reliability, and helping scale a first-of-a-kind process toward commercial production.

Do you have solid experience from an industrial or manufacturing environment, and do you thrive in a setting where not everything has been fully built or established yet? Then we would very much like to hear from you.

Read more about the role in the below job description.

If you have technical questions, you are welcome to contact Director of Plant Performance Aaron Bellis at +45 28966291 or HR Partner René Bitsch at +45 21756113.

If you are from a recruitment agency please note that we will contact you if we need your assistance.

Job description

The position:

As Mechanical engineer, you will play a hands-on role in establishing, stabilizing, and improving the mechanical performance of our first-of-a-kind tile production facility in Ikast. This role will work closely together with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, and Process Engineering to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient plant performance. You will help translate innovative process science into robust day-to-day manufacturing at the first of a kind facility, while driving structured problem-solving, equipment reliability, ppm, plant expansion support, and continuous improvement across the facility.

You will support the scaling of this process to our first commercial facility from engineering design and equipment selection through commissioning, start-up, and operations working together with our project department and our EPC firms.

Responsibilities also include:

  • Mechanical Operations & Equipment Reliability

    • Provide day-to-day supervisory and execution support for electrical and mechanical systems and production equipment across the tile manufacturing process.

    • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for mechanical failures, downtime events, and recurring equipment issues.

    • Help establish preventive and predictive maintenance routines for critical equipment, utilities, and production assets.

    • Support commissioning, start-up, and scale-up activities in a FOAK environment, helping to translate development work into reliable plant operation.

  • Production Support & Continuous Improvement

    • Partner with Operations and Quality teams to improve equipment performance, uptime, process stability, and product consistency.

    • Contribute to waste reduction, line efficiency, and standardization efforts as production scales.

  •   Technical leadership

    • Support the development of SOPs, technical work instructions, equipment care standards, and troubleshooting guides.

  • Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and internal teams on equipment modifications, installation work, and performance improvements.

  • Project engineering and commercial facility scale-up

    • With the Director of projects and an EPC firm, act as Biomason’s lead mechanical engineer supporting the development of FEL3 and detailed engineering design packages including participation in and review of Block Flow Diagrams (BFDs), Heat and Material Balances (HMBs), Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), General Arrangements (GAs), Basis of Design (BoD) documents, equipment specification and selection, and HAZOP (Hazard an Operations study).

    • Support the commissioning and startup of the commercial facility through:

      • Participation in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) at vendor sites as needed and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) at the facility.

      • Provide on-site technical leadership during the "boots-on-the-ground" commissioning phase, troubleshooting mechanical, thermal, or other deviations in real-time.

      • Bridge the gap between EPC firms and internal operations to ensure a seamless handover.

What we are looking for:

  • Experience

    • Minimum 5 years of experience in mechanical engineering, maintenance engineering, or a similar industrial role.

    • Strong experience in industrial process or manufacturing environments, ideally with automated or semi-automated production equipment. Concrete manufacturing or other heavy industry is bonus but not essential.

    • Experience with motors, heat exchangers, airflow and hydraulics is a strong advantage.

    • Basic electrical experience testing logout tag out.

    • Experience supporting production start-ups, greenfield projects, FOAK environments, or first-time industrial implementation is strongly preferred.

  • Technical Expertise

    • Experience working with crane and conveyance systems is a critical requirement of this position

    • Strong understanding of industrial mechanical systems, equipment reliability, maintenance strategies, and structured troubleshooting.

    • Experience with 5S, good manufacturing practices, and continuous improvement in a production setting.

    • Ability to read technical drawings, manuals, equipment layouts, P&IDs, and supplier documentation.

    • Familiarity with Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing principles, root cause analysis methodologies, and continuous improvement practices is an advantage.

  • Management & Interpersonal Skills

    • High attention to detail, with the ability to manage complex, detail-oriented projects and ensure disciplined follow-up through execution.

    • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to work across functions and cultures, preferable experience from a matrix organization..

    • Structured, practical, and data-informed approach to problem-solving and decision-making.

    • Contractor control

    • Fluency in English is essential

On a personal level, the role needs the following approach:

  • Proactive with a practical approach and the ability to be hands-on 

  • Motivation to solve real industrial challenges

  • Flexible where systems and routines are still being built

  • A collaborative mindset, but also the ability to solve matters on your own

  • Good safety attitude

  • Can do attitude

jobs.title: ASRO: Jr. Project Manager, space microscope projects
jobs.description:
**Type**: Full-time, permanent

**Location**: Lemminkäisenkatu 46, 20520 Turku

**Application deadline**: 13.10.2026

Are you excited about coordinating complex space projects and growing into a project management role? Join ASRO and help take space instrumentation from development to launch!

**Your role with us**

As a Junior Project Manager at Aboa Space Research (ASRO), you will join the microscope business area and support the project management of space projects. The projects focus on further developing ASROs microscope technology and platform, with missions currently planned for low Earth orbit and the Moon.

Working closely with the Business Area Director, you will help keep multidisciplinary development projects moving forward. Your responsibilities include coordinating schedules and meetings, tracking project actions and deadlines, and ensuring that the documentation and data packages are prepared according to the project requirements and on time.

You will work with experts across mechanics, electronics, software and optics, as well as with ESA, research partners, universities and suppliers. You may also coordinate component purchasing and help maintain project management tools such as Jira. As you gain experience, the role offers room to take on broader responsibilities and grow towards independently managing projects. **What makes you a great fit?**

You might be at the beginning of your career and motivated to grow into a project management professional in a highly technical environment. You enjoy working with people, bringing structure to complex projects and making sure things keep moving forward.

You do not need to be an experienced Project Manager – at least not yet! What matters most is a proactive approach, curiosity toward technical systems, and the confidence to take ownership. You are also comfortable working in a growing and evolving organization, where your role can develop as you gain experience and take on more responsibility.

**We hope you have:**

- A Masters degree in engineering, natural sciences, or another relevant technical field

- Some previous work experience, for example through internships, project work, or other relevant roles.

- Interest in coordinating complex technical projects and keeping schedules, actions and documentation on track

- A proactive and organized working style with the willingness to take ownership and learn

- Good English skills and confidence working with different internal and external stakeholders


**We consider as an asset:**

- Previous exposure to the space industry through studies, projects or work experience is a huge advantage

- Experience in project-based or multidisciplinary engineering environments

- Familiarity with Jira or other project management tools

- Finnish language skills


**What ASRO offers you?**

- Grow into a project management role by taking on real responsibility in ambitious space projects, supported by experienced colleagues.

- Build broad technical understanding by working closely with specialists across mechanics, electronics, software and optics.

- See your work directly support space missions from development and launch all the way to the Moon.

- Shape your responsibilities as you develop, with room to gradually take ownership of increasingly complex project management tasks.

- Flexible working methods and the possibility of partial remote work

- Healthcare insurance as an employment benefit


**Practicalities**

This is a permanent, full-time role, and you will be employed directly by ASRO. The position is based at ASROs office in Turku, and regular on-site presence is important for close collaboration with the project teams. Partial remote work is also possible. The role may also include occasional travel, typically a few trips per year depending on the project.

Salary in this position is approximately 3000-4000 €/month, with the final salary determined based on your background, potential, and the amount of relevant expertise you bring to the role. We are also happy to hear about your salary expectations.

**Recruitment process**

- Initial phone interviews with aTalent

- On-site interviews with ASRO


**Interested? Apply now!**

Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English by latest 13th of October via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/386694/create/.

Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary. For more information about ASRO, visit **https://asro.fi/**. For details about the profile & recruitment process, contact Senior Recruitment Consultant Sofia Latva-Koivisto (+358 50 321 4473, sofia.latva-koivisto(at)atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as I can.

Lægesekretær eller klinikassistent søges til Øre Næse Halsklinikken Sct Joseph i Esbjerg

25 timer om ugen · Tiltrædelse snarest muligt

Har du lyst til en varieret arbejdsdag med tæt patientkontakt, administrative opgaver og praktisk arbejde i klinikken? Så er du måske vores nye kollega.

Vi søger en engageret og imødekommende lægesekretær eller klinikassistent til vores øre-næse-halsklinik i Esbjerg. Du vil få en grundig oplæring i klinikkens arbejdsgange og specialets undersøgelser.

Om stillingen

Du får en central rolle i klinikkens daglige drift og bliver et vigtigt bindeled mellem patienterne, klinikkens læger og det øvrige personale. Arbejdet er varieret og omfatter både administrative og kliniske opgaver.

·  Telefonbetjening, tidsbestilling og modtagelse af patienter

·  Visitation og koordinering af patientforløb

·  Håndtering af henvisninger, korrespondance og øvrige sekretæropgaver

·  Journalføring og arbejde i EG Clinea

·  Klargøring af undersøgelsesrum og instrumenter

·  Rengøring og sterilisation af instrumenter

·  Assistering ved undersøgelser og mindre behandlinger

·  Udførelse af relevante undersøgelser efter oplæring

·  Praktiske og administrative opgaver i forbindelse med klinikkens daglige drift

Opgaverne tilpasses dine erfaringer og kompetencer, og du vil få grundig oplæring i klinikkens arbejdsgange og specialets undersøgelser.

Vi forestiller os at du

·  Er uddannet lægesekretær, sundhedsadministrativ koordinator, social- og sundhedsassistent, klinikassistent eller har anden relevant sundhedsfaglig erfaring

·  Har lyst til både administrative og praktiske klinikopgaver

·  Er venlig, rolig og professionel i mødet med patienterne

·  Kan bevare overblikket, også når telefonen ringer, venteværelset er fyldt, og dagens program ændrer sig

·  Arbejder struktureret, ansvarsbevidst og selvstændigt

·  Er fleksibel og hjælper til, hvor der er behov

·  Har gode IT-kompetencer

·  Bidrager til et godt samarbejde og en positiv omgangstone

Erfaring fra speciallægepraksis eller kendskab til EG Clinea er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære og trives med en arbejdsdag, hvor patientkontakt, faglighed og samarbejde er i centrum.

Vi tilbyder

·  En spændende og alsidig stilling i en velfungerende speciallægepraksis

·  Grundig oplæring

·  En arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og korte beslutningsveje

·  Et tæt samarbejde med engagerede læger og medarbejdere

·  En uformel og respektfuld omgangstone

·  Mulighed for faglig udvikling og gradvist større ansvar

·  En hverdag, hvor din indsats har stor betydning for både patienterne og klinikken

Om os

Øre-Næse-Halsklinikken Sct. Joseph er en speciallægeklinik centralt beliggende i Esbjerg. Vi undersøger og behandler både børn og voksne med sygdomme inden for øre-, næse- og halsområdet.

Vi lægger vægt på høj faglig kvalitet, gode og trygge patientforløb samt venlig og respektfuld kommunikation. Vi har en travl og varieret hverdag, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter opgaverne i fællesskab.

Praktiske oplysninger

Arbejdstid

25 timer om ugen på hverdage. Fleksibilitet i forhold til arbejdstider og arbejdsopgaver vægtes højt.

Tiltrædelse

Snarest muligt.

Løn

Efter gældende overenskomst, anciennitet og kvalifikationer.

Ansøgning

Send ansøgning og CV til suzan_kole@hotmail.com. Samtaler afholdes løbende.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Suzan Kole på e-mail suzan_kole@hotmail.com.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Øre-Næse-Halsklinikken Sct. Joseph I/S Esbjerg

jobs.title: Automasjonsingeniør
jobs.description:
Om stillingen

På grunn av økende oppdragsmengde, er vi på jakt etter deg som har erfaring med design av elektriske systemer, styresystemer og programmering/igangkjøring av styresystemer (PLS).

De fleste arbeidsoppgaver utfører vi fra kontorsted. Nordkontakt har kunder over hele landet, så noe reisevirksomhet ifm. kundebesøk, igangkjøring nye anlegg og serviceoppdrag må påregnes.

Vi har kontorsted i Bodø, men kan også vurdere andre lokasjoner om rette søker dukker opp.

Automasjonsavdelingen vår har i dag 40 ansatte, med en god bredde med tanke på bakgrunn og grunnutdanning. Her kan nevnes ingeniørutdanning/bachelor og master innen automasjon/cybernetikk, elkraft, mekatronikk og datateknikk. I tillegg har flere fagbrev som automatiker, elektriker, maskinist, kjølemontør og lignende som basis før høyere utdanning. En herlig blanding som gjør at vi sammen finner gode løsninger i et bredt spekter av oppdrag. Nordkontakt har som mål å være blant de fremste i bransjen på å teste ut og utvikle nye tekniske løsninger.


Som ingeniør i Nordkontakt

 Får du :

  • Jobbe med spennende kunder
  • Utvikle deg faglig i et sterkt teknisk miljø
  • Være med å teste ut nye systemer og tekniske løsninger
  • Ta et tydelig teknisk ansvar i prosjekter
  • Et spennende fagmiljø innen moderne og avanserte automasjonssystemer
  • Bred teknisk eksponering fra design til ferdig anlegg
  • Et kompetent og uformelt fagmiljø
  • Reell påvirkningsmulighet
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter, både faglig og personlig
  • Korte beslutningsveier og høy grad av tillit

Arbeidsoppgaver

• Prosjektering automasjonsanlegg.

• Programmering styresystemer og sikkerhetssystemer

• Konfigurering/programmering/design HMI og driftskontrollanlegg. Alarmhåndtering, datalogg og rapportering. 

• FAT- og SAT-prosesser - igangsetting nye anlegg

• Dokumentasjon 

• Serviceprosjekter - feilsøking, vedlikehold og ombygging eksisterende anlegg

• Oppsett servere/nettverksutstyr for automasjonsanlegg og driftskontroll

Avhengig av din kunnskap og erfaring, kan det også være aktuelt med arbeidsoppgaver/støttefunksjon opp mot andre funksjoner og fagfelt i bedriften. Våre leveransen stiller store krav til både IT- og OT sikkerhet.


Kvalifikasjoner

Vi søker deg som har :

Bachelor eller Master innen automasjon, kybernetikk, elektro eller tilsvarende. 

Du kan også ha teknisk fagskole innen elektro/automasjon.

Kan vise til arbeidserfaring fra lignende type arbeid.


Vi ser etter deg som
  • Er systematisk og strukturert.
  • Har lyst å jobbe direkte mot kunder.
  • Er faglig trygg og kunne jobbe selvstendig under tidspress.
  • Har god skriftlig og muntlig framstillingsevne.
  • Behersker norsk og engelsk skriftlig/muntlig.
  • Har mulighet for noe reisevirksomhet ifm. kundebesøk og igangkjøring av anlegg.
  • Har arbeidserfaring med lignende type arbeid.

Gode grunner til å jobbe i Nordkontakt

Gode grunner til å jobbe hos oss

Vi kan tilby en spennende stilling med utfordrende arbeid i en bedrift i vekst. Foruten et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø og en stor dose godt humør kan vi også tilby:

  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med god spredning i alder og kompetanse
  • Stor påvirkningskraft over din egen arbeidshverdag
  • Å delta på våre gøye sosiale tiltak
  • Treningsavtaler
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
  • En attraktiv bonusavtale

Vår viktigste kapital er våre medarbeidere! Vi setter derfor utvikling og kompetanseheving hos våre ansatte veldig høyt. Det forvalter vi som best vi kan i opplæringsplattformen vår Elektroakademiet. Les mer om hvordan vi legger til rette for at medarbeiderne våre kan søke ny- eller friske opp sin kunnskap via denne linken.


Vi trenger flere kvinner!

Vi og resten av Elektrogruppen anser mangfold som en styrke, og oppfordrer derfor spesielt kvinner til å søke. Les mer om våre målsettinger og hvordan vi arbeider med å styrke mangfoldet i vår likestillingsredegjørelse.


Vi tar bærekraft på alvor

For oss er bærekraft en del av alt vi gjør. Vi utvikler løsninger som reduserer utslipp og fremmer energieffektivitet, samtidig som vi skaper trygge og gode arbeidsplasser for våre ansatte. Les mer i vår bærekraftsrapport.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nordkontakt er en ingeniørbedrift med 105 ansatte som jobber med automasjon, tavleproduksjon, digitalisering, informasjonsteknologi og elektro. Vi har hovedkontor i Bodø, avdelingskontor i Ørsta/Volda og er ledende innfor våre områder med en historikk tilbake til1966.

Vi er i dag en betydelig aktør innenfor automatisering av landbasert settefisk- og oppdrettsanlegg. Vi har også kunder innen slakteri, vei, jernbane, gruvedrift, forskningsfartøy, fiskebåter, bygg, industri, VA-anlegg og energi. Nordkontakt tilbyr også skybaserte tjenester ifm. SD-anlegg (NK-sky) til våre kunder. 

Vi har en stor IT-avdeling som leverer kameraløsninger samt bistår med OT-sikkerheten til våre kunders anlegg. 

Nordkontakt leverer produkter og tjenester på alle nivå i prosessen, fra enkle komponenter til ferdige idriftsatte anlegg. Vi har flere ulike testverksted tilknyttet våre ulike fag. Og om vi ikke har funnet komponenter som dekker kundenes behov, så har vi faktisk bare utviklet disse selv. 

Vårt verdigrunnlag er tuftet på at vi er en bedrift som opptrer Fremtidsrettet Ansvarlig Løsningsorientert og Kompetent. Vi løser våre oppdrag med målsetting om å skape trygghet for våre kunder, så vel som våre medarbeidere og samfunnet vi er en del av, og i Nordkontakt, holder vi det vi lover!

Vi er en del av konsernet Elektrogruppen, en av landets største private tekniske entreprenører med virksomhet fra Trøndelag i sør til Vesterålen i nord.  Samlet er nesten 700 ansatte, fordelt på 15 entreprenører. Effektivt tverrfaglig samarbeid og erfaringsutveksling bedriftene imellom gir positive effekter for våre kunder lokalt.

jobs.title: ASRO: Project Manager, space radiation instrument projects
jobs.description:
**Type**: Full-time, permanent

**Location**: Lemminkäisenkatu 46, 20520 Turku

**Application deadline**: 13.10.2026

Are you ready to take ownership of technically demanding space projects and work closely with customers from development to delivery and beyond? Join ASRO and help bring Finnish space technology to customers around the world!

**Your role with us**

As a **Project Manager** at Aboa Space Research (ASRO), you will take responsibility for projects within ASROs space weather business area. Your focus will be on space radiation instruments, with several ongoing projects ranging from instrument deliveries to concept studies. You can read more about ASROs space weather monitoring solutions here.

You will independently manage typically one to three projects at a time, coordinating the work of multidisciplinary engineering teams and keeping schedules, deliverables, resources, and stakeholders aligned. You will follow project progress, make sure agreed actions move forward, and keep customers up to date throughout the project. Depending on the project, your work may range from managing straightforward instrument deliveries to coordinating more exploratory development where the technical solution is still taking shape.

Your role will also extend beyond traditional project management. You will work closely with customers, ESA, subcontractors and ASROs multidisciplinary engineering teams, with opportunities to contribute to systems engineering and technical development. As projects move from development to delivery, you may also continue working with customers around instrument data and future needs, as well as identify opportunities for follow-up projects. The exact scope can be shaped around your background and strengths.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You have experience managing technical projects and are comfortable taking ownership of complex projects involving both engineering teams and external customers. A technical background helps you understand what is happening beneath the project plan and work effectively with specialists across different disciplines.

At the same time, you are not looking for a narrowly defined Project Manager role. ASRO is a small and evolving company, and you are motivated by the opportunity to contribute where your expertise creates the most value. Depending on your strengths and wishes, in the future your role can also develop towards technical product ownership, broader project portfolio project management responsibilities, or a more customer-facing and commercial direction.

**We hope you have:**

- A Masters or PhD degree in engineering, natural sciences, or another relevant technical field

- Ideally, plus five years of relevant professional experience, including experience in project management or technical project environments

- Experience taking ownership of projects and coordinating multidisciplinary technical teams

- A strong technical understanding and the ability to work effectively with engineering specialists and customers

- Good English skills and confidence working with different internal and external stakeholders


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience from the space industry, space instrumentation or other demanding technology environments

- Knowledge of radiation effects, detection technologies, embedded software or data-related solutions

- Experience from product development, product ownership, or bringing technical products into production

- Experience working in a smaller technology company or in customer-facing engineering projects

- Finnish language skills


**What ASRO offers you?**

- Take ownership of ambitious space projects where you can directly influence how projects and customer relationships develop.

- Work with space radiation technology across instrument development, deliveries and emerging data-driven services.

- Use your technical expertise beyond project management, with opportunities to contribute to systems engineering and product development.

- Shape your role in a small organization with minimal hierarchy as ASROs products, customers and business continue to develop.

- Flexible working methods and the possibility of partial remote work

- Healthcare insurance as an employment benefit


**Practicalities**

This is a permanent, full-time role, and you will be employed directly by ASRO. The position is based at ASROs office in Turku, and regular on-site presence is important for close collaboration with the project teams. Partial remote work is also possible. The role includes occasional travel to customers and other project stakeholders, typically a few trips per year depending on the projects.

Salary ranges between 4000–6500 €/month, with the final salary determined based on your experience and expertise and your readiness to take independent ownership of space radiation instrument projects. We are also happy to hear about your salary expectations.

**Recruitment process**

- Initial phone interviews with aTalent

- On-site interviews with ASRO


**Interested? Apply now!**

Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English by latest 13th of October via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/386702/create/. In your motivation letter, we would especially like to hear what interested you in this role and ASRO, which aspects of your background and expertise you feel are particularly relevant to the position, and how you would like to develop or shape the role going forward.

Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary. For more information about ASRO, visit **https://asro.fi/**. For details about the profile & recruitment process, contact Senior Recruitment Consultant Sofia Latva-Koivisto (+358 50 321 4473, sofia.latva-koivisto(at)atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as I can.

jobs.title: Psychiatrist wanted for position in adult psychiatry in Southern Norway
jobs.description:
On behalf of a well-established outpatient clinic in Southern Norway, we are recruiting a specialist psychiatrist for a permanent role in adult psychiatry.

You will become part of a competent interdisciplinary team in a region known for its mild climate and friendly communities.

 

Your role

  • Assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of adult patients with psychiatric conditions
  • Active participation in interdisciplinary collaboration and treatment planning
  • Supervision of junior doctors and contribution to internal training
  • Engagement in the clinic’s development and professional improvements

Qualifications

  • European medical authorization and specialist certification in psychiatry
  • Fluent in English and motivated to learn Norwegian (language training will be provided)
  • Broad competence in adult psychiatry and ability to work independently

The clinic offers

  • A permanent position in a stable and well-functioning outpatient unit
  • An interdisciplinary team with skilled and supportive colleagues
  • Flexible working hours and opportunities for extended shifts with extra pay
  • Access to professional courses, seminars, and specialist development days
  • Possibility to take part in acute care rotation (optional, extra pay)
  • Secure pension and insurance schemes via KLP

Why Southern Norway?

 

Southern Norway (Sørlandet) combines modern healthcare infrastructure with a high quality of life. The region is family-friendly, with good schools, kindergartens and accessible housing.

With a milder climate than most other parts of Norway, Sørlandet is especially known as a popular holiday destination during summer, attracting both Norwegians and international visitors to its charming towns and cultural scene. At the same time, the region offers a relaxed pace of life year-round, with plenty of opportunities for outdoor activities, sports and cultural events.

 

International airports and proximity to Oslo, make it easy to stay connected with the rest of Europe. You can read more about the area at Visit Southern Norway.

 

Benefits with Dignus Medical 

  • Free online Norwegian language course tailored to medical professionals
  • Personalized follow-up throughout the recruitment process
  • Comprehensive relocation support for you and your family (housing, schools, kindergartens, etc.)
  • Guidance on paperwork and authorization procedures

Interested?

 

Take the first step towards a new career and lifestyle in Norway. Contact us for a confidential and informal chat!

 

You can also register your CV or sign up for our newsletter to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.title: Haemme nyt liikenteenohjaajia datakeskushankkeelle Vaasaan!
jobs.description:
**Haemme liikenteenohjaajia datakeskushankkeelle Vaasaan!**

**Työt alkavat heti.**

**Keitä olemme?**

Ramudden luo kokonaisvaltaisia työturvallisuusratkaisuja tietöihin, rakennuksiin, tiloihin, rautateille ja erilaisiin infrastruktuurin projekteihin. Teemme työmme turvallisesti ja välittäen!

**Ketä haemme?**

Haemme liikenteenohjaajia Vaasassa sijaitsevalle datakeskushankkeelle. Mitä tarjoamme? Tarjoamme turvallisen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön. Tavoitteenamme on varmistaa se, että sinä ja kaikki muut liikenteessä liikkujat pääsevät turvallisesti töihin tai kouluun sekä takaisin kotiin. Minne sitten olettekin matkalla, turvaamme matkasi!

**Mitä työ sisältää?**

Liikenteenohjaajan työhön datakeskuksella kuuluu varmistaa työmaan läpikulkevan liikenteen turvallinen kulku ja eteneminen. Pidämme huolta myös kollegoistamme.

Työtä tehdään kahdessa vuorossa arkisin ja lauantaisin 06-21 välisenä aikana. Työajoista on mahdollista sopia joustavasti.

**Mitä vaaditaan?**

Sinun tulee olla täysi-ikäinen

Sinulla tulee olla normaalit aistit: näkö, kuulo ja reaktiokyky

Sinulla tulee olla vähintään AM121 tai B-luokan ajokortti

Odotamme liikenteenohjaajiltamme myös hyvää liikennetuntemusta.

**Koulutamme ja perehdytämme sinut tehtävään alla olevien koulutusten avulla:**

Tieturva 1-koulutus

Työturvallisuuskoulutus

Liikenteenohjaajan pätevyys

**Palkkaa maksamme Asfalttialan työehtosopimuksen (TES) mukaisesti.**

**Sen lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle:**

Turvallisen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön

Laadukkaat työvälineet ja -varusteet

Reilun ja tasapuolisen kohtelun

Mahdollisuuden edetä uralla sekä

Erilaisia työsuhde-etuja

**Lisätietoja arkisin klo 9–15**

**Evi Ahtola, 0504653301, evi.ahtola@ramudden.fi**

**Marianne Granlund, 0503373384, marianne.granlund@ramudden.fi**

jobs.title: Senior Manager MES / Manufacturing Transformation | m/w/d
jobs.description:
Your mission

You’re a team player, authentic, open, and face challenges with a positive mindset? Then you’re a perfect fit for us! 

  • Take end-to-end ownership of international MES and Manufacturing Transformation programs – from program setup, governance, solution design, and implementation through to rollout, go-live, and stabilization – while keeping scope, roadmap, budget, resources, risks, and dependencies firmly under control.
  • Across complex multi-site programs, you bring together business functions, IT, Quality, sites, vendors, and system integrators, providing clear direction to project teams throughout demanding and critical phases.
  • Functional projects and workstreams covering process optimization and harmonization, solution design, system integration, data flows, and data migration are managed with confidence, while validation activities can also be supported conceptually at both program and project level.
  • With a comprehensive understanding of the relevant functional and technical concepts, you identify dependencies early and work closely with experts to develop and evaluate robust solutions.
  • Particularly during rollout, readiness, and go-live phases, you drive decisions and follow them through, ensure successful delivery, manage escalations, and represent the program confidently towards management, steering committees, and other relevant stakeholders.


Your profile

  • Consulting experience in leading complex international programs and projects within the life sciences or pharmaceutical industry forms the foundation of your expertise.
  • Strong knowledge of MES and Manufacturing IT is complemented by hands-on experience in the implementation, integration, and multi-site rollout of corresponding solutions.
  • Pharmaceutical manufacturing processes and their interfaces with Quality, Automation/OT, ERP/SAP, and other relevant systems are areas in which you are highly confident.
  • A solid understanding of GxP, Computerized Systems Validation, and pharmaceutical Quality processes enables you to translate regulatory requirements effectively into program planning, governance, and delivery.
  • Excellent German and English skills, combined with a willingness to travel internationally, enable you to operate confidently across complex global program environments.


Your start with us

At our company, you’ll find a work environment where initiative, collaboration, and mutual support are truly valued. You can expect exciting projects, a fair salary, plenty of development opportunities, and a flexible working model tailored to your needs.
 
Your journey with us starts with a well-structured onboarding, including two welcome days at our Frankfurt office, a buddy program, and access to internal networks to help you feel at home from day one. We offer full flexibility with flexible working hours, remote work options, and even the chance to work temporarily from abroad.
 
With 30 vacation days plus additional paid leave for special occasions, as well as a time value account for extended breaks like sabbaticals, we ensure you have the space to recharge and balance life and work.
 
Our internal training curriculum, additional learning formats, and tailored development paths support your individual career goals. Regular events, cross-location networks, and our feedback platform miaX create space for exchange, ideas, and collaboration.
 
We support your well-being with a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership and exclusive perks through our Corporate Benefits platform. You can also privately use your company IT equipment, and stay mobile with flexible options like JobRad, a company car, or a BahnCard. And because we value your network, we reward successful referrals with an attractive bonus.
 
We work in a hybrid model: depending on the project requirements, you will work remotely, in one of our offices or directly at the customer's premises.


How to contact us

Apply directly or send us your application documents (CV, certificates, desired salary and possible start date) by e-mail to: https://linktr.ee/msgindustryadvisors
Do you have questions or need more information about the position or career opportunities at msg industry advisors?
Please feel free to contact us:
Phone: +49 69 580045-4003

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer AI & Automation (d/m/w)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Du entwickelst produktive Softwarelösungen, die Geschäftsprozesse automatisieren, Daten nutzbar machen und Mitarbeitende im Alltag unterstützen. Dabei kombinierst Du fundiertes Software Engineering mit modernen KI-Technologien, um skalierbare Anwendungen mit echtem Mehrwert für unsere Fachbereiche zu entwickeln:

  • Entwicklung produktionsreifer Software-, AI- und Automatisierungslösungen – von der Idee bis zum Go-Live
  • Konzeption und Umsetzung intelligenter Anwendungen, AI-Agenten und Assistenzsysteme auf Basis moderner LLM-Technologien
  • Entwicklung robuster Backend-Services, APIs und Frontends zur Integration interner und externer Systeme
  • Analyse bestehender Geschäftsprozesse sowie Identifikation und Umsetzung sinnvoller Automatisierungs- und Digitalisierungspotenziale gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen
Bei uns arbeitest Du nicht an isolierten Proof-of-Concepts oder reinen Experimenten, sondern an produktiven Anwendungen, die täglich von Mitarbeitenden genutzt werden und einen direkten Beitrag zum Unternehmenserfolg leisten. Der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle liegt auf professioneller Softwareentwicklung. KI-Technologien sind dabei ein Werkzeug, um innovative und skalierbare Lösungen zu schaffen.


Dein Profil

Das bringst du mit 

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung
  • Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Typescript sowie Erfahrung mit modernen Softwarearchitekturen
  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Backend-Services, APIs und der Integration unterschiedlicher Systeme und Datenquellen
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Technologien wie OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, LangGraph oder vergleichbaren Frameworks
  • Fundiertes Verständnis von RAG-Systemen, Embeddings, Vektor-Datenbanken und semantischer Suche
  • Kenntnisse in Git, CI/CD, Testing sowie im Einsatz von Docker und Cloud-Technologien
    Erfahrung im Aufbau produktiver Softwarelösungen über Prototypen und Proof-of-Concepts hinaus
  • Strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an der Lösung komplexer technischer Herausforderungen
  • Deutsch und Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau
Das wäre ein Plus 
  • Erfahrung mit Machine Learning über die Nutzung von LLMs hinaus (z. B. Modelltraining, Klassifikation oder Forecasting)
  • Erfahrung mit Microsoft Copilot Studio oder der Power Platform
  • Erfahrung mit ERP-, CRM-, PIM- oder E-Commerce-Systemen (insbesondere SAP)
  • Erfahrung mit Process Automation und Workflow-Orchestrierung
Das zeichnet dich aus 
  • Du entwickelst gerne Lösungen, die produktiv eingesetzt werden und echten Mehrwert schaffen
  • Du möchtest nicht nur AI-Tools nutzen, sondern intelligente Systeme entwickeln und weiterdenken
  • Du hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und erkennst Potenziale für Automatisierung und Digitalisierung
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung, arbeitest eigenständig und bringst eigene Ideen ein


Das erwartet dich

  • Die Möglichkeit, den Einsatz von KI bei einem internationalen Unternehmen aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Spannende Projekte mit direktem Einfluss auf Unternehmensprozesse und Entscheidungen
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum, Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Ein motiviertes und erfolgreiches Team, das offen zusammenarbeitet und Wissen teilt
  • Internationale Zusammenarbeit in einem modernen und multikulturellen Umfeld
  • Flache Hierarchien und eine Unternehmenskultur, die Eigeninitiative fördert
  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit flexiblen Hybrid- und Remote-Möglichkeiten
  • Exklusive Vorteile wie Hansefit, Mitarbeiterrabatte, Getränkeversorgung, frisches Obst und Essenszuschuss


Wann es für dich los geht

Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen. 

Wenn Du gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, nachhaltige Software entwickeln möchtest und AI für Dich ein Werkzeug zur Lösung echter Probleme ist, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung. 

Bitte sende uns Deinen Lebenslauf sowie Links zu GitHub-Projekten, technischen Referenzen oder eigenen Softwareprojekten. Wir möchten sehen, was Du bereits entwickelt hast und wie Du technische Herausforderungen löst.

jobs.title: Cleaner
jobs.description:
**washup** is a professional cleaning company founded in 2009. We provide high-quality, reliable cleaning services with great attention to detail. Our services include corporate cleaning, home cleaning and window cleaning.

We are now looking for an additional member to join our team of cleaning professionals.

The work

- Work is located in Helsinki Metropolitan area (Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa).

- The job includes **corporate and home cleaning**.

- Working shifts start **early in the morning**.

- Working days are scheduled **Monday–Sunday according to customer needs**.

- The position may include **travelling between customer locations** during the workday.

- The work is varied and requires the ability to adapt to different customer environments and cleaning tasks.

- The position is part-time, with a possibility to get more hours according to operational needs.

- We are looking for a person who would be able to commit to a long-term employment.

- The work starts as soon as we find the person for the job.


We offer

- Comprehensive training and introduction to the job.

- A supportive and professional working environment.

- Salary in accordance with the Finnish collective agreement for the cleaning services sector.

- High-quality equipment and cleaning products.

- Varied work with long-term customers.

- The opportunity to become part of a growing and reliable company.


We're looking for someone who:

- Has previous practical experience in home cleaning, corporate cleaning or similar cleaning work or strong motivation to learn.

- Is able to work independently and responsibly.

- Is reliable, punctual and committed to providing high-quality service.

- Is flexible with working hours, as shifts are scheduled Monday–Sunday according to customer needs and usually start early in the morning.

- Is willing to travel between customer locations during the workday.

- Is interested in and looking for long-term employment relationship and motivated to develop your skills as part of our team.

- Is are able to quickly learn our working methods, quality standards and customer service practices.

- Is fluent in English or Finnish.


Selection is based on the applicant's suitability for the position, practical work experience, motivation, and ability to work in the specified work locations and according to the required working hours.

Please fill the application form on our website at https://washup.fi/en/work-with-us/ and attach your CV.

Please note that, unfortunately, we are unable to respond to job-related enquiries by phone.

Role overview
 
Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Associate Account Manager to come and join our global business.
 
Reporting directly to the Account Manager Team Lead, you will be accountable for building relationships and driving monetisation of the Fresha platform.
 
This is a great opportunity for someone looking to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, who likes to work autonomously, enjoys a challenge, and wants to make an impact.

Empresa em expansão no sector da construção e remodelações procura Ajudantes/Serventes (M/F) para integração imediata em equipa dinâmica. Procuramos profissionais com vontade de trabalhar e aprender, mesmo sem experiência prévia na área.

Somos uma associação sem fins lucrativos dedicada ao apoio a produtores e proprietários florestais, promovendo a gestão sustentável da floresta, a defesa contra incêndios e a valorização ambiental e cultural do espaço florestal. Pretende-se reforçar as Equipas,  para a realização de trabalhos de silvicultura preventiva, nomeadamente limpeza de matos, executar trabalhos de desramação, poda, correção de densidades, seleção de árvores e varas, controlo ou eliminação de espécies invasoras ou indesejadas, durante o período crítico, fazer vigilância, detecção, primeira intervenção e apoio ao combate e rescaldo de incêndios florestais.
Que tenha sentido de responsabilidade, assiduidade e capacidade de trabalho em equipa, gosto pelo trabalho em ambiente florestal e interesse pelas atividades de gestão e proteção da floresta,

jobs.title: EDUCADOR DE INFÂNCIA
jobs.description:
Pretende-se recrutar Educador(a) de Infância, com habilitação profissional adequada, para exercer funções em creche, acompanhando crianças até aos 3 anos.
O(a) candidato(a) deverá ter capacidade para planear, desenvolver e avaliar atividades pedagógicas ajustadas à idade, ao desenvolvimento e às necessidades individuais das crianças, promovendo a autonomia, a exploração, a comunicação e a aprendizagem através do brincar.
Compete-lhe proporcionar um ambiente seguro, acolhedor e afetivo, respeitando os ritmos individuais e assegurando, em articulação com a equipa, os cuidados de alimentação, higiene, descanso e bem-estar. Deverá observar e acompanhar o desenvolvimento das crianças, elaborar registos e participar na construção e execução do projeto pedagógico da creche.
São essenciais a sensibilidade para as necessidades da primeira infância, a empatia, a paciência, o sentido de responsabilidade, a organização e a capacidade de trabalho em equipa. Deverá manter uma comunicação próxima e construtiva com as famílias, facilitando a adaptação à creche e a continuidade dos cuidados.
Valoriza-se experiência profissional em creche e conhecimentos sobre desenvolvimento infantil e práticas pedagógicas inclusivas. Espera-se o cumprimento das normas de segurança, higiene, proteção das crianças e confidencialidade.

Poderá também efetuar recebimentos de clientes, quando aplicável, assegurando a correta entrega dos valores e respetiva documentação.

Procuramos uma pessoa responsável, pontual, organizada, dinâmica e com capacidade para trabalhar de forma autónoma, com boa capacidade de comunicação e orientação para o cliente. jobs.title: Customer Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Secappin kasvun ja kansainvälistymisen myötä haemme osaavaa ja kokenutta **Customer Operations Manageria** vahvistamaan joukkoamme. Työskentelypaikkakuntasi voi olla Helsinki, Jyväskylä tai Kuopio.

Haluatko merkityksellisen työn, jossa sinulla on tärkeä rooli? Secapp on kasvanut jo 15 vuotta peräkkäin ja haemme kasvun seuraavaan vaiheeseen uutta kollegaa, jolla on halu kehittää toimintaa ja kyky uudistaa toimintamalleja moderneilla työtavoilla ja ratkaisuilla. Arvostamme kiinnostustasi ja käytännön ymmärrystäsi siitä, miten AI:ta ja automaatiota voidaan hyödyntää oman työn ja prosessien kehittämisessä.

Sytytkö myös kouluttamisesta, asiakaskohtaamisista, teknisestä ongelmanratkaisusta ja asiakkaiden haasteiden taklaamisesta? Tässä roolissa yhdistyvät After Sales -tiimimme Technical Supportin ja Customer Successin monipuoliset tehtävät. Käytännön työn kautta pääset aktiivisesti kehittämään toimintatapoja yhdessä tiimin kanssa. Tavoitteenamme on löytää ratkaisuja, joissa tekoäly, automaatio ja toimivat prosessit helpottavat asiantuntijoidemme työtä ja auttavat toimintaamme skaalautumaan kasvun mukana.

**Aitoa tekemisen meininkiä ja osaamisen iloa**

Olet kokenut osaaja, jolla on oma-aloitteinen ja proaktiivinen työote sekä halu kantaa vastuuta ja viedä asioita määrätietoisesti eteenpäin. Arvostamme kokemuksesi mukana tuomaa näkemystä ja toivomme, että tuot aktiivisesti uusia ajatuksia ja parhaita käytäntöjä myös tiimimme käyttöön. Asiakastyössä pääset olemaan mukana käyttöönotoista ja käytön kehittämisestä aina haastavampien teknisten ongelmatilanteiden ratkaisemiseen.

Työpäiväsi sisältää:

- Haastavampien asiakastilanteiden ratkaisemista yhdessä tiimin, tuotekehityksen ja muiden teknisten asiantuntijoidemme kanssa

- Käyttöönottojen suunnittelua ja toteuttamista

- Asiakkaiden kouluttamista Secappin käyttöön parhaiden toimintatapojen mukaisesti

- Asiakkaiden teknisten tukipyyntöjen ja ongelmatilanteiden selvittämistä ja ratkaisemista sekä asiakkaiden tarpeiden kartoittamista sekä aktiivista lisämyyntiä

- Asiakkuuksien hoitoa

- Integraatioihin, käyttäjähallintaan ja asiakkaiden teknisiin ympäristöihin liittyvien asioiden ratkaisemista

- Dokumentaation, tukiprosessien ja käyttöönottokäytäntöjen jatkuvaa kehittämistä sekä työn sujuvoittamista AI:n, automaation ja muiden työkalujen avulla.


Odotamme sinulta:

- Kaupallista suuntautuneisuutta ja aiempaa kokemusta esimerkiksi SaaS-palveluiden käyttöönotoista, kouluttamisesta, teknisestä konsultoinnista tai muista asiakasrajapinnan teknisistä asiantuntijatehtävistä.

- Vahvaa ongelmanratkaisukykyä, teknistä ymmärrystä sekä kykyä ottaa haastavia asiakastilanteita hoitaaksesi.

- Erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja esiintymistaitoja, sillä asiakkaiden kanssa työskentely on merkittävä osa arkeasi. Osaat keskustella luontevasti niin asiakkaiden kuin teknisten asiantuntijoidenkin kanssa.

- Järjestelmällistä ja oma-aloitteista työskentelytapaa. Pystyt toimimaan systemaattisesti myös silloin, kun pöydällä on useampia asioita samanaikaisesti.

- Teknistä uteliaisuutta, ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja halua oppia uutta. Aiempi kokemus integraatioista, REST API -rajapinnoista, käyttäjähallinnasta tai esimerkiksi SSO-, AD- ja Entra ID -ympäristöistä auttaa sinua pääsemään tehtävässä nopeasti vauhtiin, mutta kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi.

- Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa niin suullisesti kuin kirjallisesti.

- Kykyä hyödyntää AI-työkaluja sujuvasti omassa työssäsi sekä kiinnostusta tunnistaa uusia tapoja, joilla tekoälyä voidaan hyödyntää asiakastyössä ja toimintamme kehittämisessä.

- Tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta (esim. IT-, tekninen tai kaupallinen koulutus) tai vastaavaa osaamista, jonka olet hankkinut työkokemuksen kautta.

- Matkustusvalmiutta tarvittaessa


**Ehtaa suunnan näyttämistä**

Tässä työssä pääset moneen mukaan, joten tarvitset kykyä priorisoida ja pitää langat käsissäsi. Roolissa käytännön asiakastyö ja toiminnan kehittäminen kulkevat rinnakkain. Tunnistat yhdessä tiimin kanssa kehityskohteita, kehität toimintatapojamme ja viet parannuksia käytäntöön vaiheittain. Huolehdit omalta osaltasi siitä, että asiakkaidemme asiat etenevät laadukkaasti korkea palvelutasomme huomioiden. Työsi tukena on osaava joukko eri alojen ammattilaisia, ja pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan siihen, miten teemme asioita Secappilla. Meillä kaveria ei jätetä: autamme toisiamme ja työskentelemme yhdessä kohti yhteisiä onnistumisia ja tavoitteita.

Kokeneena asiantuntijana pystyt työskentelemään itsenäisesti, hahmottamaan laajoja kokonaisuuksia sekä ottamaan vastuuta asiakkuuksien hoitamisesta ja asioiden edistämisestä. Tunnistat aktiivisesti tapoja kehittää asiakaskokemusta, tukiprosesseja, dokumentaatiota ja toimintamalleja – ja olet valmis viemään parannuksia myös käytäntöön. Pääset vaikuttamaan myös nykyaikaisten koulutusmenetelmien ja -sisältöjen kehittämiseen.

**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- Monipuolisen asiantuntijaroolin, jossa pääset yhdistämään asiakastyön, teknisen ongelmanratkaisun, kouluttamisen ja toiminnan kehittämisen

- Mielenkiintoisen, merkityksellisen ja vastuullisen työtehtävän, jossa pääset hyödyntämään aiempia oppejasi laaja-alaisesti

- Mahdollisuuden vahvistaa osaamistasi tekoälyn ja automaation hyödyntämisessä osana käytännön asiantuntijatyötä.

- Vakituisen työn. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan

- Monipuolisia henkilöstöetuja, koska olet meille tärkeä. Haluamme tukea työntekijöiden hyvinvointia, viihtymistä sekä ammatillista kehittymistä monin tavoin.

- Ajanmukaiset työvälineet ja hybridityömallin. Työskentelemme säännöllisesti myös toimistolla mutta työtä voi tehdä välillä myös etänä. Työpaikkasi voi sijaita Helsingissä, Jyväskylässä tai Kuopiossa.


**Kiinnostuitko?**

**Seuraavat askeleet**

Me käärimme hihat täällä päässä ja odotamme hakemustasi. Täytä se mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään 25.10.2026. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Halutessasi voit jättää meille videotervehdyksen hakemusta täyttäessäsi.

Tehtävään valitulta henkilöltä edellytetään hyväksytty turvallisuusselvitys. Palkkahaarukka on osaamisestasi ja kokemuksestasi riippuen 3900–4400 €/kk välillä.

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Multimodal smärtrehabilitering syftar till att förbättra funktion hos personer med långvarig smärta genom att utveckla bättre hanteringsstrategier och öka livskvalitén. Det är en teambaserad och strukturerad rehabiliteringsform. Du arbetar utifrån ett beteendemedicinskt och biopsykosocialt förhållningssätt som en del av teamet. Behandlingsmetoderna baseras på kunskap om smärtfysiologi, sensomotorisk funktion och beteendemedicin. All behandling och träning sker i grupp med cirka sex till åtta deltagare.

Som arbetsterapeut ansvarar du för att:
• hålla patientutbildning i träning av sensomotorisk funktion, utveckling av kroppsmedvetenhet samt att stödja patienten att hantera rörelserädsla och öka den fysiska aktiviteten i vardagen
• stödja patientens förmåga att kunna utföra vardagsaktiviteter genom ökad medvetenhet och anpassade aktivitetsmönster, samt identifiera och hantera hinder och stödjande faktorer i relation till sina aktiviteter
• leda aktivitetsgrupper, förmedla kunskap om ergonomi och aktiviteters betydelse
• genomföra bedömningar av funktion, rörelseförmåga och fysisk kapacitet
• planera, genomföra och följa upp gruppbaserade tränings- och rehabiliteringsinsatser
• arbeta utifrån ett beteendemedicinskt förhållningssätt med fokus på smärthantering, fysisk aktivitet och långsiktig funktionsförbättring.

En del av uppdraget innebär att verka som rehabiliteringskoordinator, vilket omfattar samordning av rehabiliteringsinsatser, dialog med patient, vårdgivare och vid behov externa aktörer samt stöd i patientens rehabiliteringsprocess med fokus på funktion, delaktighet och återgång i aktivitet. Du deltar även i utvecklings- och kvalitetsarbete inom verksamheten.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som är legitimerad arbetsterapeut med behörighet att verka inom svensk sjukvård. Språkkunskaper i svenska motsvarande lägst nivå C1 enligt Europarådets nivåskala är ett krav.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:
• erfarenhet av gruppbaserad och träningsinriktad rehabilitering
• arbete med beteendemedicinsk inriktning så som exempelvis kognitiv beteendeterapi (KBT) samt Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) och/eller motiverande förhållningssätt så som exempelvis motiverande samtal (MI)
• kvalitets- och utvecklingsarbete
• en rehabiliteringskoordinatorroll.

Har du gått kurser i smärtfysiologi och långvarig smärta är det också meriterande.

Som person ser vi att du har ett genuint intresse för rehabilitering vid långvarig smärta och ett personcentrerat arbetssätt. Du tycker om att arbeta i team kring patienten och har en vilja och förmåga att dela med dig av din kompetens till andra. Du är engagerad, strukturerad och har god samarbetsförmåga, samtidigt som du är trygg i din yrkesroll och kan arbeta självständigt. Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.

Löneintervall: 41000- 46000 kronor. Lönen är baserad på erfarenhet och kompetens.

jobs.title: Senior Embryologist for a Private Fertility Clinic in Aarhus
jobs.description:
Would you like to work as an embryologist at a private fertility clinic in Aarhus, where you will have supportive colleagues, sufficient time to perform your work and a high degree of influence?

We are looking for a skilled embryologist to join our clinic in Aarhus. You will become part of a multidisciplinary team united by a shared passion for making a difference to our patients.

About the position

The clinic is open five to seven days a week throughout the year. Many of our patients come from abroad, although we also treat a considerable number of Danish patients. We offer a full range of treatments within IUI, IVF/ICSI, egg donation and ROPA.

We are a straightforward and informal workplace guided by the principle of freedom with responsibility. Sellmer Klinik Aarhus is owned by Anette Sellmer, who forms the clinic's management team together with Clinic Manager Bodil Meldgaard. Our management is visible and committed and delegates responsibility to employees who thrive on it.

We place our patients and a positive working environment at the heart of everything we do. This means, among other things, that you will have sufficient time to carry out your duties properly and will be expected to take an active part in developing and implementing new ideas.

he laboratory team performs tasks including:

IVF and ICSI

Embryo transfer

Thawing and cryopreservation of oocytes and blastocysts

AHA

Sperm preparation and cryopreservation

Assessment of oocytes

Administrative duties, including tasks related to the export of tissues and cells

Your colleagues

We have an excellent working environment and work very well together across professional disciplines. We respect and make use of each other's expertise while keeping up with developments in the field and continuously improving our overall professional standards.

We also have a strong social community. We eat lunch together every day, enjoy spending time together and occasionally meet outside working hours. We value our positive working environment highly and make a genuine effort to protect it. It is therefore important to us that our new colleague feels at home and fits well within the team.

About you

You are a qualified embryologist.

You have experience within fertility treatment.

You enjoy working collaboratively with colleagues on patient-related tasks while also being comfortable working independently.

You speak and write Danish and English.

You are able to work 28-37 hours per week, including weekends and public holidays as part of a fixed rota.

We offer

A workplace with strong collegial support and professional sparring as part of a close multidisciplinary team. You can expect:

Sufficient time to carry out your daily duties and a high degree of influence

Opportunities for professional and personal development

Friendly and positive colleagues

An organisation with a short path from decision to action

The terms of employment will depend on your experience and qualifications. Employment is conditional upon your consent to the clinic obtaining a satisfactory child protection certificate and upon holding the required professional authorisation.

For further information about the position, please contact Bodil Meldgaard at bodil@sellmerklinik.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!
