jobs.title: Vi søger en passioneret underviser i tysk til Ballerup
jobs.description:
Er du passioneret omkring det tyske sprog og kultur? Har du lyst til at dele din viden med 6–8 motiverede kursister i et professionelt og fleksibelt undervisningsmiljø? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Lengua‑Global søger en kompetent og engageret underviser i tysk til medarbejdere fra en spændende virksomhed i Ballerup.

Om stillingen:

Du underviser ét eller to hold medarbejdere face‑to‑face på arbejdspladsen i Ballerup. Undervisningen ligger 1–2 gange om ugen og består af 2–3 lektioner pr. mødegang (á 50 minutter). Dage og tidspunkter aftales i samarbejde med deltagerne.

 Inden opstart testes deltagerne efter CEFR‑skalaen, hvorefter de opdeles i to hold efter niveau.


Vi forestiller os, at du:

• har erfaring med undervisning af voksne
• har en relevant uddannelsesbaggrund
• er født eller opvokset i et tysktalende land
• kan undervise i tysk sprog og kultur
• er fleksibel og god til at tilpasse undervisningen efter deltagernes behov
• har evnen til at motivere og engagere kursisterne
• kan starte snart eller efter aftalen
• har stærke kommunikationsevner og en professionel attitude

Vi tilbyder: 

• en spændende og meningsfuld stilling med engagerede kursister
• samarbejde med dygtige kollegaer og en støttende ledelse
• mulighed for flere undervisningsopgaver, både fysisk og online
• fleksibel arbejdstid i samarbejde med kursisterne
• konkurrencedygtig løn

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og fjerner opslaget, når den rette underviser er fundet. Send din ansøgning og CV til info@sprog-kursus.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig snart!


Lidt om os:

Vi er et privat sprogfirma, etableret i 2003, som har specialiseret sig i at tilbyde sprogkurser til virksomheder, kommuner, foreninger og private. Med vores 14 forskellige sprogkurser tilbyder vi både face2face og online undervisning, enten som enelektioner eller lukkede firmahold. Alle vores sprogkurser skræddersys i tæt samarbejde mellem kursister og undervisere, så vi kan sikre, at undervisningen altid er af høj kvalitet og fleksibilitet, der passer til den enkelte kursistens behov.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Mobile Core (Android)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is building the operating system for knowledge work, and we want people to be able to do substantive knowledge work from their phone.

A great native app is what makes that possible. On Android, that means Notion should feel like it was built for the platform: fast to open, smooth to scroll, and reliable offline or on a spotty connection. We’re investing in a more native foundation for how people read, write, and edit in Notion. That lets users capture ideas in the moment, find answers across their workspace, manage tasks and projects, and work with teammates, with the speed, polish, and dependability people expect from the best apps on their phone.

As an Android engineer, you’ll help build that native foundation, from how pages render and how people write and edit, to the navigation and app chrome people use every day, like Home, Search, and Inbox, along with the shared frameworks the rest of the app is built on. You’ll work across the Android stack, with chances to dig into our shared Rust layer and the AI tools we use for mobile development. Along the way, you’ll pair with experienced product and mobile AI engineers to find what slows the team down, try new Android capabilities, and help decide what ships in the app.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Ship the core Notion experience on Android: Build and polish the surfaces people use every day—opening and reading pages, writing and editing, navigating the app, and the Home, Search, and Inbox tabs—on a native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose stack that is fast to open, smooth to scroll, and dependable offline.

 - Build with product and design, and iterate fast: Partner with product managers and designers to turn ideas into shipped features, then use feedback and data to make them better. Use AI coding tools and agents to build, test, and investigate faster, while you stay accountable for review, validation, and quality.

 - By the end of your first year, own a core product area: Take a core part of the Android app, like Home, Inbox, or a piece of the editor, from idea to launch, and shape it into an experience that helps people do their life’s work from their phone.

 - Make the app feel fast and reliable: Find and fix issues in startup time, scrolling, typing latency, crashes, and memory use across the surfaces you own, and add the tests and monitoring that catch regressions before users do.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Solid Android fundamentals: You’ve built and shipped Android apps, through work, internships, or your own projects, and you’re comfortable with modern Android—Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines/Flow, and Gradle. Experience with a large, modular codebase is a plus.

 - Care for native UI and performance: You enjoy making UI feel fast and smooth, and you’re curious about things like custom text rendering, complex lazy lists, or rich-text editing. Experience with performance profiling, realtime collaboration, or offline sync is a plus.

 - Product instincts: You care about how the app feels to use, not just how it works. You sweat the details of interactions and polish, and you use feedback and data to decide what to build next.

 - Thoughtful problem-solving and clear communication: You build a clear picture of the problem before jumping to a fix, you can explain trade-offs in writing, and you ask for help early when you’re stuck. Experience moving a hybrid or web-based surface to native, or building something from 0→1, is a plus.

 - AI-native, end-to-end engineering practice: You use AI tools and agents as real collaborators, framing tasks clearly, reviewing generated changes, testing behavior, and designing workflows that make the broader team more effective. Web experience (TypeScript, React, Node) is welcome but not required.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THIS JOB

We're looking for a Head of Marketing Strategy & Operations to run the business side of marketing. Our marketing team went from two people to 25 this year, organized around four functions: product marketing, brand and consumer, enterprise, and growth. This is the first operations hire on that team. You'll own the marketing budget with Finance, run our planning cycle and operating cadence, keep hiring aligned with the plan, and partner directly with the CMO on how marketing sets priorities and tells its story to the executive team and the board.

It's a role for someone who has sat close to a CMO and a CFO, likes turning ambiguity into a plan people can execute, and is comfortable building the function themselves before building a team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Budget & Financial Operations

 - Own the marketing budget end to end with Finance: allocation across teams and channels, tracking against plan, forecasting, variance flags, and the tradeoff conversations that follow

 - Build the layer of visibility leadership needs (spend by team, channel, and program) on top of the spend-tracking tools we already have, so decisions get made with numbers

 - Run quarterly, half-year, and annual budget planning, and make marketing's case to Finance and the executive team

 - Own marketing's vendor and agency contracts end to end: evaluations, procurement, renewals, and a clear view of what we pay for and why



Planning & Operating Cadence

 - Own marketing's planning cycle: translate company goals into marketing objectives, OKRs, and resourced plans, and keep them current as priorities shift

 - Bring a point of view. Pressure-test plans, frame the tradeoffs, and help the CMO decide where marketing places its bets

 - Design the lightweight processes and internal tools (planning, intake, reporting) that let a 25-person team operate like a much bigger one

 - Run the operating rhythm for the marketing leadership team: meetings, all-hands, team-wide readouts, agendas, decisions, and follow-through

 - Keep the marketing functions connected so plans, launches, and budgets move together



Executive Partnership

 - Partner directly with the CMO on board materials, executive readouts, and strategy documents. Own first drafts and make them data-backed and on-message

 - Extend the CMO's reach across the team: surface risks early, chase decisions to closure, and keep priorities clear week to week

 - Represent marketing in cross-functional planning with Finance, Sales, and Product



Hiring & Org Operations

 - Partner with Talent Acquisition and marketing leads on headcount planning, requisition tracking, and interview process, and keep hiring plans aligned with budget and org design

 - Standardize the basics across sub-teams (job descriptions, interview loops, scorecards) and help new leaders land well




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 10+ years in marketing strategy and operations, business operations, strategic finance, management consulting, or a similar role supporting a CMO, GM, or business unit leader

 - You've owned a sizable marketing or departmental budget end to end and can talk about spend, forecast, and variance the way Finance does

 - You've built or run a planning cycle (annual or half-year, OKRs) and an operating cadence for a leadership team

 - You've drafted board or executive materials for a senior leader and know the difference between a readout and a narrative

 - Experience with headcount planning and hiring operations alongside a Talent team

 - You've run vendor evaluations and procurement alongside Finance and kept a clean view of contracts and renewals

 - Comfortable as an individual contributor. This is the first ops hire; you'll do the work before you have a team

 - You scope light and move fast. We plan in weeks, not quarters, and you build just enough process to keep a fast team aligned

 - You build trust quickly, from individual contributors to the C-suite

 - Bonus: you're comfortable building your own tools with AI. We use Replit to run Replit



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

 



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
jobs.description:
Description

Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes.

You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind.


Your mission

1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence 

  • Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution.

  • Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy.

  • Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters.

  • Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo.

2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership 

  • Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer.

  • Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders).

  • Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice.

  • Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos.

3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement 

  • Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation.

  • Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations.

  • Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder.

What We Want to Achieve Together

In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds.

In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount.


Your profile

  • Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies.

  • Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences.

  • Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility.

  • Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data.

  • AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new.

  • A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough.

  • Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both.


Why us?

  • Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else.

  • A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI.

  • Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites.

  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation.

  • Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority.


Process

  1. 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations.

  2. Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live.

  3. Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset.

  4. Meet the team in the office.

  5. Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team!

How to Apply

Send us your CV, two or three writing or work samples you’re proud of, and a short note answering: what’s your sharpest point of view on where Legal AI is heading, and what’s the evidence?

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer - Autonomy Architecture
jobs.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 


About the Job

The autonomy team at Gravis architects autonomous behaviors for different tasks, e.g. different types of excavation or truck loading. This role owns the architecture that lets those behaviors live in the same software stack as opposed to creating one SW stack per behavior. You'll be responsible for how tasks are decomposed and orchestrated, for the interfaces between, and for the software quality. We are looking for a senior roboticist with C++ and Python expertise and high standards for software quality, who can make clear, pragmatic architectural calls that let the system grow without losing stability.


What you'll do

Architecture

  • Own the task-level architecture shared across our autonomous behaviors

  • Define clear module boundaries and responsibilities between behavior orchestration, factor out common logic across different tasks

  • Implement component tests and telemetry/metrics collection pipelines

  • Identify technical debt early enough to guide the team toward sustainable solutions

  • Act as the go-to person for software quality: modern C++ practices, code structure, error handling, robustness. Likewise for Python.

    • Configuration & tooling

  • Design an easily extensible and testable module for deploying policies that can be reused across tasks and supports schema versioning for observations, so a deployed policy pins the exact version of the computations it was trained against

  • Provide technical leadership on C++ and Python tooling (clang-tidy, sanitizers, static analysis, linting, typing, test setup)

  • Work with our incoming simulation team to unify training, benchmarking and evaluation tooling across tasks, so adding a task doesn't mean forking tooling and infrastructure


    • What we're looking for

    Required

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

  • 5+ years developing complex C++ systems, with deep knowledge of modern C++ (17 and onwards)

  • Strong Python for tooling, configuration and simulation-side scripting

  • Strong experience designing large, modular software systems that outlived their first use case

  • High standards for software quality and long-term maintainability

    • Nice to have

  • Experience with behavior trees, state machines, or other task orchestration frameworks in production

  • Experience working alongside learned controllers in a production stack - deployment, versioning, observation pipelines. No need to train them.

  • Motion planning, geometric algorithms, or spatial data structures

  • Feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms


    • This role is a great fit if…

  • You want to make systems work reliably in the real world, and enjoy thinking through the edge cases

  • You'd rather our next behavior be a configuration than a dedicated piece of software

  • You want the best idea to win regardless of who had it, and you'd rather be corrected by the numbers than agreed with

  • You take a result end-to-end: when something needs to happen, you use or ask for whatever it takes, even outside your scope

  • You're a software purist, but pragmatic — first make it work, then make it right, and cut corners consciously when it's the right call

    • Gravis is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based on race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

You will build control modules that run on many different machines, across many sites, with different soil conditions. We’re looking for a roboticist with data driven planning and/or control background, deep python expertise and good level of C++ proficiency.

Learning-Based Planning and Control for Real Systems
 
  • Develop data driven planning and control systems for autonomous excavation that generalize across machine models and soil conditions
  • Contribute to  simulation improvements that reduce or address the sim2real gap
  • Define data collection and curation pipelines for incorporating real data in policy training

  • Explore the usage of adaptive and online reinforcement learning in deployed systems
  • Provide mentorship and supervision for junior team members, interns, and students.

    System Integration
 
  • Integrate learned components into a larger software stack
  • Collaborate with excavation and motion planning engineers
  • Build tools for analysing and evaluating the behavior of learned components

What we’re looking for

Core qualifications

  • 2–5 years industry experience developing Reinforcement learning systems for control and/or planning and deploying them on real robots with a customer. If you only have experience with simulation, you’re most likely not a good fit for this position.

  • Experience with GPU accelerated simulation environments (e.g. IsaacSim/IsaacLab, CARLA, MuJoCo)

  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch or similar libraries

  • Proficiency in C++

  • Comfortable debugging real-world system behavior

  • Ability and willingness to travel as required by business projects. 

    • Great-to-Have Skills & Experience

    • Experience with hydraulic machinery

    • Experience with supervised learning or imitation learning

    • Research experience in reinforcement learning

    • Experience deploying robotic systems at scale (e.g. hundreds of units)

    • Familiarity with ROS or similar robotics frameworks

    • Familiarity with or interest in utilizing AI coding tools.

      • You are passionate about building systems that work reliably in the real world

      • You are comfortable working with the realities of imperfect data and noisy measurements.

      • You have a keen interest in bridging the sim2real gap and understanding the differences between simulation and physical environments.

As a senior engineer focused on the embedded platform, you will own the software layer closest to that hardware: bootloader, kernel, device tree, root filesystem, and the update mechanism that keeps the fleet current. You will work at the intersection of our Hardware, Firmware, Autonomy, and Perception teams to bring up new boards alongside the engineers who designed them, then hand the software organization a platform they can build on without thinking about it. When something fails on site and nobody can yet say whether it's a driver or a solder joint, you are the person who finds out.


What you’ll do

  • Own the embedded Linux platform from end to end: bootloader, kernel, device tree and rootfs.

  • Bring up new hardware alongside electrical engineers.  Take our boards from first power-up to a boot you’d trust on a customer site.

  • Write and maintain the kernel drivers that connect the Rack’s sensors to the autonomy stack

  • Be the low level link between hardware and software teams; the person who can tell a driver bug from a hardware fault.

  • Drive our OTA update and recovery strategy for machines around the world

  • Implement security hardening: secure boot, disk encryption, container isolation, vulnerability patching.


    • What we're looking for

    We recognize that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with varied combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we encourage you to apply.

  • Degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering, CS, or related field.

  • Deep knowledge of Linux kernel internals: device drivers, device tree, interrupt handling, memory management, scheduling.

  • Experience with custom hardware bring-up: pin muxing, clock configuration, regulator control, PCIe, USB, I2C, SPI, UART, CSI, Ethernet.

  • Strong understanding of circuit diagrams and digital electronics.

  • Self-driven, able to take full ownership in a fast-moving startup.

  • Good English (written and spoken) is a must.


    • Bonus Qualifications

  • Yocto, Buildroot, nixOS or bootc experience for custom embedded distributions.

  • Experience with NVIDIA Jetson platforms (Thor, Orin, Xavier, Nano or equivalent) and JetPack/L4T ecosystem.

  • Power, thermal, or performance optimization on resource-constrained SoCs.

  • Familiar with CI/CD, Git, and automated build/deployment processes.

  • Know how to use debugging tools like JTAG, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.

  • Experience with the design, implementation and documentation of safety critical firmware

jobs.title: Data & ML Ops Lead
jobs.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 


About the role

At Gravis, the intelligence behind our machines is only as good as the systems that develop, train, and operate it. The Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into a learning-based control system that adapts in real time to changing ground conditions. As our fleet grows and our models become more sophisticated, we need world-class infrastructure to support the full ML lifecycle: from raw sensor data ingestion on the edge to continuous model training, evaluation, and deployment at scale.

As our MLOps Lead, you will be driving the strategy, technical roadmap, and leadership of our MLOps team. You will serve as both the technical lead and people manager, taking full ownership of building, mentoring, and scaling a high-performing engineering team. The systems you and your team build power every ML experiment, training run, and production deployment at Gravis. You will devise and execute an optimal MLOps vision while collaborating closely with platform and robotics leadership to enable high-velocity and high-quality ML development and deployment across the organization.


What you will do

  • Own the MLOps technical vision and roadmap, aligning infrastructure investments and architecture decisions with broader company and engineering milestones

  • Lead and build an engineering team to architect, build, and optimize high-throughput data ingestion pipelines and platform infrastructure for petabyte-scale multimodal datasets (e.g., LiDAR point clouds, camera streams, GNSS/IMU, hydraulics time-series)

  • Mentor and grow the team members through continuous feedback, career development, and technical guidance

  • Design, build, and operate high-availability hybrid (cloud and on-premise) compute clusters, providing developers and researchers with a seamless, unified compute experience

  • Lead the continuous deployment and monitoring pipelines for ML models deployed across thousands of edge devices in the field

  • Establish full model lifecycle management, incorporating robust model registries, artifact versioning, automated regression testing, and real-time observability/monitoring.

  • Collaborate closely with robotics engineers to understand requirements and translate them into reliable, scalable training environments

  • Evaluate and integrate best-in-class MLOps tooling on cloud and on-prem compute platforms


    • What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in ML Ops, data engineering, or ML infrastructure roles, preferably in a leadership role driving the ML Infrastructure

  • 5+ years of production experience with Kubernetes, including designing and maintaining cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and on-premise cluster infrastructure

  • Prior experience in technical leadership or engineering management, including mentoring and growing engineers

  • Strong background in building, scaling, and optimizing large-scale data pipeline infrastructure for ingesting complex multimodal datasets and high-volume data and organizing them in curated datasets (e.g. using Encord, Scale AI, Lightly )

  • Proven experience deploying, observing, and maintaining ML models at scale across thousands of edge/remote devices in production.

  • Deep experience with model registry, artifact versioning, experiment tracking, and data versioning tools (e.g., MLflow, W&B, DVC)

  • Demonstrated track record of building CI/CD pipelines for ML workloads (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) implemented with Infrastructure as Code

jobs.title: Rengøringsleder søges til MB Rengøring ApS
jobs.description:
MB Rengøring ApS søger en engageret og ansvarsbevidst rengøringsleder til en fuldtidsstilling

MB Rengøring ApS er en virksomhed i udvikling, som leverer professionelle rengørings- og serviceydelser til erhvervskunder på forskellige lokationer. Vi oplever en stigende aktivitet og søger derfor en engageret og struktureret rengøringsleder, som kan være med til at sikre en stabil og effektiv daglig drift samt høj kvalitet i vores leverancer til kunderne.

Som rengøringsleder får du en central rolle i virksomheden og bliver ansvarlig for koordinering, planlægning og opfølgning på den daglige rengøringsdrift. Du vil fungere som bindeled mellem ledelsen, medarbejderne og vores kunder og vil derfor have en vigtig funktion i forhold til både kvalitet, kundetilfredshed og medarbejdernes daglige arbejde.

Stillingen indebærer et betydeligt selvstændigt ansvar, og vi forventer, at du kan bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag, prioritere opgaver og sikre, at vores aftaler med kunderne bliver overholdt.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet bestå af planlægning og koordinering af den daglige rengøring hos virksomhedens kunder. Du skal være med til at sikre, at de rette medarbejdere bliver fordelt på de rette opgaver, og at arbejdsplanerne tilpasses efter kundernes behov, ferie, sygdom, ændringer i bemanding og øvrige driftsmæssige forhold.

Du vil have ansvar for løbende kvalitetskontrol af det udførte arbejde. Dette indebærer blandt andet kontrolbesøg hos kunder, opfølgning på rengøringsstandarder og sikring af, at medarbejderne følger virksomhedens arbejdsbeskrivelser, procedurer og kvalitetskrav. Hvis der konstateres mangler eller fejl, forventes det, at du følger op og sørger for, at forholdene bliver rettet hurtigt og professionelt.

En vigtig del af jobbet vil være oplæring og vejledning af rengøringsmedarbejdere. Du skal kunne introducere nye medarbejdere til arbejdsopgaverne, forklare virksomhedens metoder og kvalitetskrav samt følge op på deres arbejde. Du skal desuden være med til at sikre, at medarbejderne arbejder effektivt, sikkert og i overensstemmelse med virksomhedens retningslinjer.

Du vil også have løbende kontakt med vores kunder. Det kan eksempelvis være i forbindelse med ændringer i arbejdsopgaver, ekstra rengøring, særlige ønsker, kvalitetsopfølgning eller andre forhold vedrørende den daglige drift. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan kommunikere professionelt og serviceminded og samtidig finde praktiske løsninger, når der opstår ændringer eller udfordringer.

Stillingen omfatter desuden opfølgning på igangværende opgaver og sikring af, at aftalte deadlines overholdes. Du vil være med til at håndtere akutte situationer, eksempelvis sygdom blandt medarbejdere, ændringer fra kunder eller behov for ekstra bemanding. Det kræver, at du kan reagere hurtigt, finde løsninger og sikre, at kunden fortsat modtager den aftalte service.

Du vil ligeledes få ansvar for fordeling af arbejdsopgaver blandt medarbejderne og for at følge op på, om arbejdet bliver udført inden for den forventede tid og kvalitet. Det forventes, at du løbende kommunikerer med medarbejderne og støtter dem i deres daglige arbejde.

Praktisk deltagelse i rengøringsopgaver kan forekomme efter behov. Det kan eksempelvis være i forbindelse med opstart af nye kunder, oplæring af medarbejdere, kvalitetskontrol, sygdomsdækning eller særlige opgaver. Hovedvægten i stillingen vil dog være på koordinering, planlægning, kvalitetssikring og den daglige driftsledelse.

Arbejdet vil primært foregå på forskellige kundeadresser, og der vil derfor ikke nødvendigvis være ét fast arbejdssted. Du skal være indstillet på at bevæge dig mellem forskellige arbejdssteder og have kontakt med både kunder og medarbejdere i løbet af arbejdsdagen.

Vi søger en person, som er ansvarsbevidst, struktureret og selvstændig. Du skal kunne planlægge din egen arbejdsdag og samtidig bevare overblikket over flere medarbejdere og forskellige kundeopgaver. Det er vigtigt, at du kan tage ansvar og træffe beslutninger i forbindelse med den daglige drift.

Vi forventer desuden, at du har gode samarbejdsevner og kan kommunikere professionelt med både kunder, medarbejdere og virksomhedens ledelse. Du skal kunne håndtere forskellige typer mennesker og situationer og være i stand til at løse problemer på en rolig og professionel måde.

Erfaring fra rengøringsbranchen, servicebranchen, personaleledelse, arbejdsplanlægning eller koordinering vil være en fordel. Det er ligeledes en fordel, hvis du tidligere har haft ansvar for medarbejdere eller arbejdet med kvalitetskontrol og kundekontakt.

Vi lægger stor vægt på, at du har en praktisk tilgang til arbejdet og er villig til at tage ansvar for, at opgaverne bliver løst korrekt. Du skal have forståelse for, at kvalitet, stabilitet og god kundeservice er afgørende i rengøringsbranchen.

Hos MB Rengøring ApS tilbyder vi en fast fuldtidsstilling med et stort selvstændigt ansvar og mulighed for at få indflydelse på den daglige drift. Du bliver en del af en virksomhed i udvikling, hvor der er fokus på kvalitet, gode kunderelationer og en professionel arbejdsform.

Du vil få mulighed for at arbejde tæt sammen med virksomhedens ledelse og være med til at udvikle og forbedre vores interne arbejdsgange, kvalitetsprocedurer og planlægning.

Vi søger en medarbejder, som ønsker et langsigtet samarbejde og som har lyst til at være med til at udvikle MB Rengøring ApS i takt med, at virksomheden får flere kunder og flere medarbejdere.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling, og arbejdet vil primært foregå på forskellige kundeadresser.

Ansøgning med relevante oplysninger om erfaring og tidligere beskæftigelse sendes til MB Rengøring ApS.

jobs.title: Technical Marketing Engineer
jobs.description:
The role

Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories.

You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market.

Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications.

This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams.

Your mission

Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable.

You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it.

The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate.

What you will do

Drive technical co-builds with partners

  • Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept.

  • Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks.

  • Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure.

  • Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories.

  • Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets.

  • Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility.

Produce technical marketing content

  • Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives.

  • Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations.

  • Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets.

  • Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember.

  • Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity.

Build for the audience

  • Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work.

  • Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype.

  • Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance.

  • Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology.

  • Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication.

What we are looking for

  • A strong engineering background

  • The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems.

  • Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video.

  • A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation.

  • Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value.

  • Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams.

  • The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

This role may suit you if

  • You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing.

  • You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value.

  • You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market.

  • You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems.

  • You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message.

This role is probably not for you if

  • Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations.

  • You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it.

  • You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete.

  • You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes.

How the role complements Product Marketing

Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity.

The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content.

What success looks like

Within the first year, you will have:

  • Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners.

  • Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities.

  • Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos.

  • Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance.

  • Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

jobs.title: Myyjä, Sale Naantali, Turun Osuuskauppa
jobs.description:
Primary location:
NAANTALI

Etsimme myyjää Sale Naantaliin ihan tavallisiin töihin, harvinaisen mukavien työkavereiden joukkoon!
Tehtävä on vakituinen ja osa-aikainen 10 tuntia viikossa. Tämä tehtävä sopii myös opiskelijalle! Työt olisi tarkoitus aloittaa sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.

Salessa myyjän työpäivät koostuvat ihan perustehtävistä, kuten asiakaspalvelusta, kassa- ja hyllytystyöstä, robotilauksien keräilystä sekä myymälän yleisestä järjestelystä ja siivouksesta. Työssä muun muassa varmistat tuotteiden saatavuuden ja tuoreuden sekä sen, että myymälä on asiakkaille houkutteleva. Työskentely on nopeatempoista ja vaatii kykyä hypätä työtehtävästä toiseen. Käytät kaupan järjestelmiä, huolehdit saldojen oikeellisuudesta ja näin vaikutat omalla tekemiselläsi suoraan myyntiin. Seuraat myymälän toimintatapoja ja viestintää, huolehdit turvallisista ja ergonomisista työtavoista sekä osallistut tarvittaessa uusien työntekijöiden perehdyttämiseen. Myymälässä työskentely on fyysistä, sillä liikumme päivän aikana paljon, nostamme ja siirrämme tavaraa ja olemme suurimman osan päivästä jaloillamme.

Työhön sisältyy myös hetkiä, jolloin työskentelet vuorossa yksin, joten edellytämmekin sinulta täysi-ikäisyyttä. Työvuorot vaihtelevat arkisin ja viikonloppuisin kello 6.30–22.00 väillä. Varmistathan, että sinulla on mahdollisuus kulkea toimipaikkaan kaikkina kaupan aukioloaikoina.

Olet saletisti etsimämme myyjä, jos sinulla on reipas ja positiivinen työskentelyote. Haluat olla luomassa onnistunutta asiakaskokemusta ja tervehtiminenkin tulee sinulta luonnostaan. Nautit työskentelystä hektisessä myymäläympäristössä, jossa toimit sovittujen toimintatapojen mukaisesti ja edistät omalla tekemiselläsi yhteisten tavoitteiden saavuttamista. Olet valmis tarttumaan oma-aloitteisesti erilaisiin työtehtäviin ja pidät tiimityöskentelystä, jossa pääset jakamaan omaa osaamistasi työkavereille sekä auttamaan muita onnistumaan. Lisäksi sinulle sopii fyysinen vuorotyö, jossa työskentelet vaihtelevissa vuoroissa ja työtehtävissä sekä kohtaat paljon ihmisiä päivän aikana. Eduksi katsomme aiemman työkokemuksen vastaavista työtehtävistä, mutta tärkeintä on halu oppia, toimia tehokkaasti ja tavoitteellisesti sekä työskennellä asiakaslähtöisesti.

Myyjän palkka perustuu Kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen palkkaluokkaan B. Tuntipalkka on koulutuksesta ja kokemusvuosista riippuen 10,89-14,57 €/h. Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kannustepalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1,20 € per tehty työtunti.

Liity meidän porukkaan, niin tarjoamme sinulle:

Ihan tavallisia töitä, epätavallisen hyvillä henkilöstöeduilla! Työskennellessäsi meillä, saat rahanarvoisia ostoetuja S-etukortillasi, kuten S-ryhmän ravintoloista –25 %,Sokos ja Emotion myymälöistä -15 % tai autopesusta –50 %

Työpäiviä poikkeuksellisen rennossa porukassa yhdessä Suomen innostavimmassa työpaikassa

Mahdollisuuden kerryttää osaamista sekä lisätienestiä tekemällä lisävuoroja muissakin Sale-myymälöissä sekä kaikissa TOK:n toimipaikoissa koko Varsinais-Suomen alueella

Kattavan perehdytyksen työtehtävääsi ja mahdollisuuden ammatilliseen kasvuun, jota tukevat S-ryhmän monipuoliset oppimis- ja valmennusmahdollisuudet


Jos ihan tavalliset työt houkuttaa, laita hakemusta tulemaan 11.10. mennessä! Me ollaan sinuun yhteydessä sähköpostitse tai puhelimitse 010 764 –alkuisesta numerosta. Kannattaa seurata myös roskapostia, sillä meidän viestit voivat eksyä myös sinne.

Haluaisitko kuulla lisää tehtävästä ja Turun Osuuskaupasta? 📞 Lisätietoja antaa myymäläpäällikkö Anssi Ahokas. Anssin tavoitat parhaiten arkisin klo 7–14 numerosta 010 764 4180.

Turun Osuuskauppa on osa S-ryhmää ja yksi alueensa suurimmista työllistäjistä. Meillä työskentelet vakaassa organisaatiossa, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi ja rakentamaan entistä parempia asiakaskokemuksia yhdessä ammattilaisten kanssa. Me Turun Osuuskaupassa työskentelemme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei tarkoita, että meillä olisi tylsää tai osaamatonta porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin! Meillä on harvinaisen hyvä työilmapiiri, epätavallisen hyvät henkilöstöedut ja poikkeuksellisen paljon monipuolisia työmahdollisuuksia. 82 % työntekijöistämme suositteleekin meitä työpaikkana. Meitä tokkilaisia on reilu 2600, ja työskentelemme neljällä eri toimialalla. Työskentelemme pilke silmäkulmassa ja tavoitteenamme on olla asiakkaiden ykkösvalinta! Lue lisää Turun Osuuskaupasta: Tietoa meistä – TOK.

jobs.title: Ergoterapeut til Helhedsplejen
jobs.description:
Er du en fagligt stærk ergoterapeut med interesse for rehabilitering og genoptræning? Brænder du for at gøre en forskel for ældre borgere – med udgangspunkt i deres egne ønsker og mål? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i Frit Valg Svane Pleje Nørresundby.

 

Om os

I Frit Valg Svane Pleje arbejder vi ud fra ældrelovens værdier om selvbestemmelse, fokus på borgerinddragelse og personcentreret omsorg. Vores tilgang bygger på et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde og en helhedsorienteret indsats, hvor borgerens ressourcer og livskvalitet er i centrum.

I Frit Valg Svane Pleje arbejder vi teamorganiseret. Du bliver tilknyttet et eller flere teams bestående af en planlægger, SOSU-assistenter, SOSU-hjælpere og ufaglærte. Du får desuden en fysioterapeut som kollega i afdelingen og du bliver en del af et engageret terapeutteam på tværs af alle vores 14 afdelinger, hvor der er mulighed for sparring.

Om stillingen

Opgaverne som ergoterapeut spænder bredt inden for forebyggelse, vedligeholdelse, rehabilitering og genoptræning. Du skal fungere som forløbsansvarlig hovedsaligt for borgere visiteret efter Ældreloven, herunder afklaring af hjælpsbehov og vurdering af rehabiliteringspotentiale samt planlægning af borgerens forløb efterfølgende.

Du har desuden til opgave at understøtte, at alle SOSU-assistenter, SOSU-hjælpere og ufaglærte arbejder rehabiliterende, hvilket vi forestiller os sker via daglig sparring med kolleger, deltagelse i teammøder og tværfaglige møder, undervisning og supervision. Det er derfor en forudsætning, at du er nysgerrig og har lyst til at varetage en vejledende rolle ift. dine kollegers faglige udvikling.

Du får mulighed for generelt at bidrage i kvalitets- og udviklingsopgaver, f.eks. skal vi implementere velfærdsteknologiske løsninger og styrke samarbejdet med frivillighed og civilsamfund.

En typisk dag starter ude ved borgerne, hvor du fx opstarter et rehabiliteringsforløb, træner at borgeren kan blive selvhjulpen i bad eller til måltid, foretager en arbejdspladsvurdering eller understøtter dine kolleger i hverdagsrehabilitering. Senere har du fx administrative opgaver på kontoret, hvor du bestiller hjælpemidler, udfører dokumentationspraksis og dagen afsluttes måske med et tværfagligt møde.

 

Dine opgaver

  • Som forløbsansvarlig skal du vurdere borgerens rehabiliterings- og genoptræningspotentiale og opstarte den rette hjælp eller træning og sikre løbende opfølgning på forløb

  • Inddrage kolleger i borgerens plan, således alle arbejder med borgernes mål og med afsæt i den rehabiliterende tankegang

  • Varetage aktivitets- eller genoptræning i borgerens hjem eller som holdtræning

  • Sikre faglig refleksion, facilitere tværfaglige møder og teammøder

  • Understøtte tværfagligt samarbejde med kommunale samarbejdspartnere, herunder myndighed

  • Sætte fokus på frivillighed og civilsamfundets betydning for borgerens liv

  • Bidrage til oplæring af nye medarbejdere og understøtte opgavefordeling efter kompetencer

 

Om dig – faglige kompetencer

  • Du arbejder struktureret, reflekteret og med høj faglighed

  • Du formidler tydeligt – både skriftligt og mundtligt

  • Du ser stor værdi i tværfagligt samarbejde og kan facilitere møder på tværs

  • Du er motiveret for at dele viden, skabe læring og udvikle kollegers kompetencer

 

Om dig – personlige kompetencer

  • Du trives med alsidige opgaver og en til tider uforudsigelig hverdag

  • Du kan arbejde selvstændigt

  • Du er samarbejdsorienteret og bidrager til et positivt og lærende arbejdsmiljø

  • Du brænder for at støtte borgeren i at nå sine mål og bevare livskvaliteten

 

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og varieret hverdag

  • Mulighed for at påvirke implementeringen af den nye ældrelov og mulighed for at påvirke implementering af den nye sundhedsreform i 2027, hvor genoptræning efter §140 forventes at indgå for private leverandører

  • Mulighed for vidensdeling på tværs af afdelingerne samt Svane Plejes kvalitetsgruppe

  • Kort mellem handling og beslutning

 

Ansøgning og ansættelsesforhold

Der er tale om en fastansættelse på 32-37 timer, hvor du kan være med til at aftale ugentlig arbejdstid ved ansættelse. Arbejdstid planlægges typisk indenfor tidsrummet kl. 7-16, men eftermiddag og/eller aftenarbejde kan forekomme.

Vi ønsker stillingen besat fra 1. november 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Ansøgningsfrist den 18/10-2026

Samtaler forventes afholdt uge 43. Der kan indgå en kort case til samtalen.

Hvis du har spørgsmål eller ønsker stillingsopslaget uddybet, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

-          Direktør Tina Jørgensen 41402010 hverdage mellem kl. 08.00 og 14.00 eller på e-mailadressen tij@svanepleje.dk

-          Faglig chef for rehabilitering og genoptræning Trine Bassett på. tlf. 92 43 51 22 eller på e-mail tpi@svanepleje.dk (træffes i uge 31-33)

jobs.description:

Pas besoin d'être un expert de la restauration ! Ce que nous valorisons avant tout, c'est votre attitude et votre motivation :
- Vous aimez travailler en équipe et avez un bon relationnel.
- Vous êtes dynamique, rigoureux(se) et organisé(e).
- Le respect des normes d'hygiène et la ponctualité sont essentiels pour vous.

Travail du dimanche au jeudi de 10H30 à 18H, comprenant deux jours de repos consécutifs.
- Un environnement de travail convivial et dynamique, au sein d'une équipe passionnée.

Envie de faire partie de l'aventure et de contribuer à notre succès ? Rejoignez-nous et faites de chaque préparation un moment gourmand et agréable pour nos clients !

jobs.title: Chef Manager
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Chef Manager Location: Ringaskiddy, Co. Cork Salary: €50,000 per annum Contract: Permanent, Full Time About the Role We are looking for an experienced and passionate Chef Manager to lead our catering operation at Pfizer Ringaskiddy. This is a hands-on leadership role for a chef who takes pride in delivering high-quality food, exceptional service and consistently high standards. You will lead and support the kitchen team, oversee the full food cycle from delivery through to service, and ensure that catering services are delivered safely, efficiently and to the required client standards. You will also play a key role in supporting the day-to-day operation of the unit and deputising for the Business Manager when required. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage the kitchen team to deliver excellent food and service. Plan weekly menus and ensure all food and supply requirements are ordered on time. Maintain the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, preparation, presentation and service. Ensure allergen and HACCP documentation is completed accurately and on time. Manage food costs, labour costs and expenditure within agreed budgets. Ensure stock is correctly stored, organised and rotated. Drive the daily use of the Leanpath Waste Management System and actively reduce food waste. Ensure all food preparation and production complies with company standards and procedures. Maintain compliance with Health & Safety, hygiene, fire, COSHH and site requirements. Monitor equipment to ensure it is safe, maintained and fit for use. Support continuous improvement and identify opportunities to enhance the catering service. Build and maintain excellent relationships with clients and customers. Respond professionally to customer feedback, compliments and complaints. Support recruitment, induction, training, development and performance management of the kitchen team. Lead regular team briefings and ensure staff maintain a positive, friendly and professional approach. Support the achievement of service level agreements, KPIs, audit standards and client satisfaction targets. What We're Looking For We're looking for a confident and commercially aware Head Chef with proven experience leading a kitchen team. You will ideally have: Proven experience managing and leading a kitchen team. Strong knowledge of the catering industry and awareness of current developments and innovations. Excellent budgeting and financial management skills. Experience working within a standards-driven or compliance-focused environment. A strong customer-service mindset. Excellent communication and negotiation skills. Creativity, personal innovation and a genuine passion for food. Experience implementing and driving company initiatives. Relevant culinary qualifications and training. Sodexo reserves the right to close this advert early if we are in receipt of a high number of applications.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja, PÄIVÄ/ILTAVUOROJA, Raisio/keskusta
jobs.description:
Vuonna -76 syntyneelle liikuntarajoitteiselle pariskunnalle haetaan lisää avustajia. Päivävuoroja on tarjolla vaihtelevasti 1-3/vko (ajoittuen ma, ke ja pe päiviin), työaika on noin klo 8.30-16. Iltavuoroja on tarjolla useampia/vko, huomioiden avustajan oma toive. Työaika iltavuorossa on klo 16-23.

Avustajalta ei vaadita erityisosaamisia, työhön perehdytetään. Haetaan luotettavaa ja työhönsä sitoutuvaa, rehellistä naishenkilöä.

Toinen käyttää liikkumisen apuvälineenä pyörätuolia sekä sähköpyörätuolia, turneri on tarvittaessa käytössä siirroissa. Toinen on pienikokoinen ja hän siirtyy itse, mutta nostaa pitää tarvittaessa. Työtehtäviin kuuluu päivittäisissä toiminnoissa avustaminen kotona, kuten suihkussa ja wc käynneillä, sekä avustaminen ruoanlaitossa ja kodinhoidossa yms. Työhön kuuluu myös avustaminen kodin ulkopuolella asioinneissa ja harrastuksissa sekä joskus pienimuotoisia päivämatkoja (esim. Helsinki/Tampere). Työ ei sovellu eläinallergikoille koska pariskunnalla on kotona myös kolme lemmikkikania, joiden hoidossa avustajan tulee tarvittaessa myös auttaa.

Työsuhteessa noudatetaan työsopimuslain mukaista koeaikaa. Tuntipalkka on B1 -palkkaryhmän mukainen 13,73€ - 15,14€, mahdollisista kokemuslisistä riippuen, työaikakorvaukset HetaTESin mukaisesti. Työnantaja on Heta -liiton jäsen.

Katso tarkemmat hakuohjeet sivun alalaidasta.

Lounais-Suomen Avustajakeskus/LSLY ry (avustajakeskus.fi) välittää henkilökohtaisia avustajia vammaisille työnantajille. Avustajan valinnasta päättää työnantaja itse.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
YOUR IMPACT As a business analyst, you will join a client service team and take ownership of a workstream to solve some of the toughest challenges our clients face. And these aren’t just any clients—they're some of the most influential organizations around, from Fortune 500 giants to innovative startups. We will expect you to go the extra mile, delivering solutions that solve immediate problems and drive long-term change. And we’ll rely on your judgment and integrity to ensure our recommendations are effective and long-lasting. You will take on a role that goes beyond advising. You’ll be at the heart of the action—helping to uncover the true challenges behind a client’s strategy and creating actionable plans that drive real change. Working alongside clients and other McKinsey colleagues, you’ll combine research, analyzing data, interviews, and brainstorming to generate fresh insights and breakthrough solutions. Your commitment to our values will be crucial in earning our clients' trust and delivering results that matter. As you collaborate directly with clients, you’ll help them solve problems, refine strategies, and implement transformations. By equipping them with the tools and knowledge to continue innovating and improving after we’ve left, you’ll ensure the impact of our work endures. In doing so, you’ll uphold McKinsey’s commitment to making a meaningful difference in the industries and communities we serve. YOUR QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS Typically, an undergraduate degree with less than 4 years of work experience; Requirements may vary by country or practice. Excellent organization capabilities, including the ability to initiate tasks independently and see them through to completion. Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English and local office language(s), with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels. Proficient in rational decision making based on data, facts, and logical reasoning. Ability to create work product-focused materials / outputs, which may include PowerPoint decks, Excel models, articles, or other written deliverables. Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment. Ability to work or attend meetings outside of traditional business hours or take on projects with limited or no notice at times. Ability to travel to and work in varying environments that may be challenging and/or not accessible (e.g., factories, hospitals, mines). HOW TO APPLY Apply with your CV (no cover letter required) via https://www.mckinsey.com/careers/search-jobs/jobs/businessanalyst-15136 by Thursday 29th October ADDITIONAL DETAILS Company: McKinsey & Company Working hours: 37.5 per week Location: Dublin

The Care Assistant plays a key role in supporting adults with intellectual disabilities to live meaningful, fulfilling lives within a warm and inclusive home environment. Working as part of the house team, the Care Assistant provides person-centred support, contributes to the daily life of the house, and fosters positive relationships with Core Members, colleagues, and volunteers. The role involves practical care, emotional support, participation in community life, and collaboration with the House/Team Leader and wider team to ensure high-quality support in line with L’Arche values. Reporting to: House leader / Team Leader / Deputy Team Leader In Relation to the Core Members Build respectful, trusting, and supportive relationships with each Core Member. Support Core Members in their daily living activities (personal care, meals, household tasks, etc.) while promoting independence. Encourage and support Core Members to make choices and take responsibility in their own lives. Uphold the dignity, self-esteem, and individuality of each person. Follow care plans and Person-Centred Plans (PCPs) in line with HIQA standards. Support Core Members in communication, ensuring their voice is heard and respected. Assist with social, recreational, and community activities in line with Core Members’ interests. Support Core Members to attend appointments (medical, social, etc.) as required. Assist in maintaining accurate and confidential records. Support safe medication practices as directed and trained. Promote a safe, clean, and healthy living environment. In Relation to the Staff Team Work collaboratively as part of the house team, supporting a positive and respectful team culture. Follow guidance from the House/Team Leader and contribute to the smooth running of the house. Participate in team meetings, training, and reflective practice. Communicate effectively with colleagues regarding Core Members’ needs and daily updates. Support new staff and volunteers through welcoming and sharing knowledge of daily routines. Contribute to a supportive and cooperative team environment. Attend support and supervision sessions In Relation to Volunteer Assistants Welcome and include Volunteer Assistants as part of the team. Support volunteers in understanding their role and the daily life of the house. Work alongside volunteers to ensure consistent and supportive care for Core Members. Promote a culture of inclusion, learning, and shared responsibility. In Relation to the House / Community Actively participate in the daily life and routines of the house. Support meal preparation, cleaning, and general household tasks. Contribute to creating a warm, welcoming, and inclusive home environment. Support celebrations, events, and community gatherings. Encourage Core Members’ participation in the wider community. Maintain awareness of health and safety procedures and follow all policies.

Jsme ryze česká, rodinná firma s více než stoletou tradicí, umíme revidovat a opravovat nákladní železniční vozy. Děláme to profesionálně, s nadšením, respektem a láskou. Máme zákazníky z celé Evropy. Dokud budou jezdit vlaky, budeme tu taky.
U nás se rychle rozhodujeme, máme přehledné procesy a jasné postupy, umíme naslouchat, reagujeme na podněty, problémy neřešíme. Jsme stabilní, spolehlivý a slušný zaměstnavatel. O svých více než 350 zaměstnanců se staráme, vážíme se svých lidí i lidské práce. I díky tomu rosteme, rozvíjíme se, modernizujeme a daří se nám. U nás platí podání ruky, neslibujeme, co nemůžeme splnit, jednáme na rovinu. Šikovní, ochotní a pracovití kolegové se u nás mají dobře.
Topíme, svítíme, opravujeme. Práci máme nasmlouvanou na několik let dopředu, daří se nám, proto i dnes nabíráme nové kolegy. Rádi mezi nás přijmeme lidi, kteří se nebojí práce. Právě teď oslovujeme ty z vás, kteří věří, že se k nám hodí, mají rádi vlaky a bavilo by je u nás pracovat 5, 10, 15, 20 i více let.
Hledáme totiž šikovné a spolehlivé dělníky pro pracoviště Děčín.

Náplň práce:
Práce při opravě nákladních vlaků - broušení, čištění, tryskání, vrtání, soustružení, demontáž, kontrola, výměna dílů, montáž… jedná se o dělnickou pozici. Hlavní činností RYKO je provádět technickou kontrolu železničních vozů. Budete ten, kdo umí rozebrat jednotlivé části vagónu, zkontrolovat je, opravit nebo vyměnit a poté změřit. Pracujete s úhlovou bruskou, pneu nářadím, gola sadou, autogenem a někteří i se svářečkou. Vaším úkolem bude rozebrat šroubové spoje, odmontovat nebo namontovat díl, umět narovnat plech nebo vyměnit pororošt nebo prkno. Pracujete u nás také s měřidly, měřícími zařízeními a s počítačem. Umíte nejen opravit rozbitou část vozu, ale i vyplnit protokol, namazat nárazník nebo provést zkoušku brzy. Ze zámečníka jsme schopni vychovat paliče, svářeče, brzdaře, lakýrníka, písmomalíře nebo tlakaře. Ze zámečníka se může stát také četař nebo mistr. Pracujete u nás s železničními nákladními vozy a jejich jednotlivými díly v jednosměnném nebo dvousměnném provozu od pondělí do pátku.

Požadujeme:
Vzdělání - vyučení výhodou (zámečník, mechanik, strojař, automechanik, instalatér..)
Manuální zručnost
Vhodná pracovní zkušenost, zkušenost s výše uvedenými pracemi
Pečlivost, přesnost a zodpovědnost
Ochota a zájem pracovat a občas chodit na přesčasy (12 hodin/měsíc)

Nabízíme:
• Několikaměsíční zaškolení a zapracování pod vedením zkušených kolegů, kteří u nás dlouhé roky pracují
• Práci na dlouhodobě nasmlouvaných zakázkách, stabilní, rodinné prostředí a lidský přístup
• Práci v jednosměnném nebo dvousměnném provozu (ranní a odpolední směny), Po - Pá, občas • So, neděle vždy volné.

Termín nástupu: dohodou

Mzdové podmínky:

• Výše nástupní mzdy dle znalostí a zkušenostní, konkrétní mzdové podmínky pro nástup, období zapracování a možnosti růstu vysvětlíme u pohovoru

jobs.title: Inženýr mechatroniky – pokročilé materiály, design a víceúrovňové modelování (m+ž), Inženýři elektronici
jobs.description:
Upřesňující údaje:
Podřízenost
Inženýr mechatroniky bude podřízený CTO a CEO & zakladateli společnosti.
Přehled práce
Inženýr mechatroniky bude navrhovat, provozovat a udržovat více 3D tiskáren, aby poskytoval podporu rychlému prototypování ve všech lokalitách FabLab. Tato role zahrnuje aktivní účast v každé fázi procesu designu produktů a 3D tisku, od počátečního přezkoumání souborů CAD až po dokončení dílů, včetně následného zpracování, výběru materiálů, simulace, optimalizace, analýzy dat a výzkumu a vývoje nových materiálů a komponentů. Inženýr zajistí plynulý průběh, aby byly výtvory vyrobeny co nejefektivněji, poskytne klíčovou zpětnou vazbu ohledně vyrobitelnosti na základě parametrů materiálů, naplánuje výrobní harmonogramy a bude obsluhovat nejmodernější 3D tiskárny. Dále role zahrnuje sdílení zpětné vazby s týmem a komunitou pro zlepšení našich 3D nástrojů, přičemž bude spolupracovat s kolegy na neustálém zlepšování kvality produktů a efektivity výroby.
Odpovědnosti a povinnosti
• Používat software jako Creo, SolidWorks, Autodesk, Netfabb, Simplify3D, Ansys, Altair Hyperworks a/nebo Magics k přezkoumání, designu a přípravě dílů pro tisk na různých 3D tiskárnách, včetně strojů FabLab.
• Vytvářet technické výkresy v různých jazycích (španělština, angličtina, němčina a čeština).
• Navrhovat a vyrábět velkorozměrné 3D tiskárny.
• Připravovat soubory pro 3D tisk; opravovat problémy nebo rychle komunikovat s původcem, pokud je to nutné.
• Zajistit, aby všechny 3D tiskárny byly správně udržovány a kalibrovány.
• Vybrat vhodné materiály a nastavení pro tisk.
• Řešit problémy s designem, materiály nebo zařízením.
• Provádět následné zpracování pro čištění a přípravu dílů k použití.
• Výzkum a vývoj nových 3D tiskáren, technik a materiálů.
• Poskytovat vstupy pro strategie automatizace k škálování služeb.
• Nabízet zpětnou vazbu produktovému týmu ohledně vlastností materiálů a pravidel designu.
• Cestovat do jiných lokalit, jako jsou partnerské operace v Ghaně, podle potřeby.
Kvalifikace
• Magisterské studium v oboru mechatronického inženýrství (preferováno EU4M Erasmus Mundus).
• 1-3 roky praxe ve výrobním prostředí.
Vysvětlivky viz 2. strana (nebo poslední strana).
Zaškrtnutí platí křížkem i zatržením, oboje má ve formuláři stejný význam.
Dokument je platný dnem vydání
• Zkušenosti s konvenčním a CNC obráběním.
• Znalost softwaru CAD, CAM a CAE.
• Silná prostorová představivost a komunikační dovednosti plynule ve španělštině a angličtině
• Zkušenosti s 3D softwarem, analýzou dat a designem.
• Pečlivý a organizovaný přístup.
• Iniciátor změn a neustálého zlepšování prostřednictvím iniciativy a podpory ostatních.
• Konstruktivní týmový hráč se silnými sociálními a komunikačními dovednostmi, včetně v
prostředích pouze elektronické komunikace.
• Schopnost efektivně komunikovat s interními zákazníky a dodavateli.
• Silné technické a mechanické schopnosti: porozumět fungování zařízení, diagnostikovat
jednoduché problémy nebo spolupracovat s dodavateli na složitějších.

jobs.title: ekonom/ka, Ostatní odborní pracovníci v oblasti účetnictví a ekonomiky
jobs.description:
Minimálně úplné střední odborné vzdělání ekonomického zaměření ukončené maturitní zkouškou.
Praxe v oblasti účetnictví je výhodou.
Praxe ve školství nebo v příspěvkové organizaci je výhodou.
Náplň práce
Komplexní vedení podvojného účetnictví organizace, včetně účetnictví jednotlivých organizačních složek a projektů.
Účtování o stavu a pohybu majetku, závazků a pohledávek, nákladech a výnosech, příjmech a výdajích. Vedení účetních knih a zpracování účetní závěrky.
Sestavování a vyhodnocování hospodářského výsledku.
Zpracování účetních, statistických a dalších požadovaných výkazů, včetně výkazů PAP.
Zajišťování bezhotovostního platebního styku. Komunikace s bankami a finančním úřadem, včetně agendy související s plátcovstvím DPH.
Tvorba a zpracování provozního rozpočtu jednotlivých součástí organizace i organizace jako celku. Kontrola a koordinace čerpání rozpočtu jednotlivých středisek.
Sledování a vyhodnocování čerpání prostředků na platy a ostatní přímé náklady na vzdělávání.
Příprava návrhů a případných opatření v oblasti hospodaření organizace.
Evidence, zařazování, vyřazování a odpisování majetku a sestavování odpisového plánu. Tvorba, aktualizace a metodické zajištění ekonomických směrnic organizace.
Provádění rozborů hospodaření a navrhování případných nápravných opatření.
Spolupráce s vedením školy při plánování a vyhodnocování ekonomické činnosti organizace.
Požadujeme
Znalost podvojného účetnictví, ideálně v prostředí příspěvkové organizace.
Orientaci v právních předpisech vztahujících se k hospodaření příspěvkových organizací, zejména v oblasti účetnictví a rozpočtových pravidel územních rozpočtů.
Uživatelskou znalost práce na PC, zejména MS Word a MS Excel.
Samostatnost, pečlivost a systematičnost, vysokou míru odpovědnosti a spolehlivosti. Schopnost organizovat si práci a dodržovat stanovené termíny, Ochotu dále se vzdělávat a sledovat změny právních předpisů. Morální a právní bezúhonnost.
Výhodou
Praxe v ekonomické oblasti ve školství nebo jiné příspěvkové organizaci.
Znalost účetního programu FÉNIX.
Zkušenost s problematikou DPH u příspěvkových organizací.
Nabízíme
Pevnou pracovní dobu, volné víkendy a státní svátky.
Jistotu a stabilitu 11. platové třídy: Platové zařazení podle platových tabulek pro veřejné služby a správu (výše tarifu závisí na délce vaší započitatelné praxe).
Finanční ohodnocení nad rámec tabulek: K základnímu platu získáte osobní příplatek (po zapracování) a mimořádné odměny za aktivní přístup k práci.
Více času pro rodinu a odpočinek: 5 týdnů dovolené.
Předání a zaučení do agendy dle dohody.
Platové zařazení
11. platová třída podle nařízení vlády č. 222/2010 Sb., o katalogu prací ve veřejných službách a správě, a nařízení vlády č. 341/2017 Sb., o platových poměrech zaměstnanců ve veřejných službách a správě, v platném znění, dle dosaženého vzdělání a délky započitatelné praxe.
Možnost přiznání osobního příplatku a mimořádných odměn za aktivní přístup k práci.
Pracovní poměr na dobu určitou v délce 1 roku. Možnost následného prodloužení pracovního poměru na dobu neurčitou.
Zkušební dobu v souladu s platnými právními předpisy.

B; orientaci v právních předpisech souvisejících s oborem požadované práce, především v zákoně č.134/2016 Sb., o veřejných zakázkách a v zákoně č. 128/2000 Sb., o obcích.

-  Ve spolurpáci s věcným garantem ÚP ČR vypracovávání metodických postupů, pravidel a manuálů pro jednotnou realizaci a administraci projektu DIGIkurzy, zejména kurzů digitálního vzdělávání napříč ÚP ČR.
-  Koordinace a standardizace postupů krajských poboček a kontaktních pracovišť
-  ÚP ČR prostřednictvím nového nástroje aktivní politiky zaměstnanosti (dále jen "APZ") - Příspěvek na úhradu kurzu digitálního vzdělávání.
-  Koordinace a standardizace postupů krajských poboček a kontaktních pracovišť ÚP ČR při využívání Databáze.
-  Spolupráce s věcným garantem ÚP ČR na přípravě a aktualizaci Podmínek pro vzdělavatele v Databázi, Potvrzení o poskytnutí příspěvku na úhradu kurzu digitálního vzdělávání, vč. Podmínek poskytnutí příspěvku na úhradu kurzu digitálního vzdělávání, dalších dokumentů a vnitřních řídicích aktů nezbytných pro realizaci projektu DIGIkurzy.  
-  Koordinace, administrace a posuzování obsahu kurzů digitálního vzdělávání zadaných do Databáze vzdělavateli.
-  Koordinace a administrace sdílených informací o posuzování obsahu kurzů digitálního vzdělávání na sdíleném prostředí ÚP ČR.
-  Koordinace krajských poboček ÚP ČR při deaktivaci kurzů, které nesplňují podmínky kurzu digitálního vzdělávání.
-  Konzultace a případné provádění nezbytných servisních zásahů v Databázi v souladu s interními metodikami, konzultace a koordinace dotazů krajských poboček k Databázi a pracovním postupům.
-  Spolupráce a komunikace s odborným garantem MPSV za věcnou stránku projektu.
-  Spolupráce a komunikace s administrativními pracovníky MPSV na rozvoji Databáze.
-  Spolupráce a komunikace s pracovníky dodavatele technického řešení Databáze.
-  Zapojení do pracovních skupin ÚP ČR k agendě kurzů digitálního vzdělávání a Databáze.
-  Příprava informačních materiálů pro veřejnost a zpracování vstupů pro média.

Obor služby: "Zaměstnanost".

V případě zájmu o uvedenou pozici zašlete, prosím, elektronicky povinné dokumenty:
-  vyplněnou "žádost o zařazení na služební místo" (dále jen "žádost") s uvedením názvu pozice a pracoviště (formulář žádosti naleznete ke stažení na výše zmíněném odkazu výběrového řízení; žádost není nutné podepisovat),
-  strukturovaný životopis,
-  motivační dopis.

Posuzovány budou žádosti podané ve lhůtě do 24. července 2026, tj. v této lhůtě
