jobs.title: Associate Professor (100 %, three years) in snow science / snow avalanches
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
The position

We are seeking a three-year fixed-term Associate Professor with a focus on snow science at the Department of Geosciences at The Faculty of Science and Technology, UiT the Arctic University of Norway. The position is attached to the Solid Earth Science, Mineral Resources and Geohazards scientific group.

Tromsø is a vibrant Arctic city surrounded by dramatic mountains, fjords and accessible wilderness — an exceptional living laboratory for snow and mountain research. The region offers year-round opportunities for fieldwork, easy access to skiing and mountaineering, and outstanding nature experiences (midnight sun in summer, northern lights in winter). We value work-life balance and outdoor culture here, which many researchers find inspiring for both research and personal life.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position in Tromsø within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.


The department

The Department of Geosciences has currently 16 permanent scientific staff positions, 21 post-doctoral fellows and researchers, 24 PhD students and 15 technical/administrative positions. The Department includes three scientific groups: (1) Solid Earth Science, Mineral Resources and Geohazards group, (2) Sedimentary Systems, Paleoclimates and Environments group, and (3) Geophysics, Glaciology and Oceanography group. It also hosts the Centre of Excellence iC3: Centre for ice, Cryosphere, Carbon and Climate . The Department is also a member of iEarth - Centre for Integrated Earth Science Education. We offer courses at all levels from bachelor to PhD studies and hosts approximately 150 students.

Over the last decade, the department has strategically built up expertise and research and education activities in geohazards. Geohazards is now a key focus area for the department, with established networks, ongoing projects and ambitions to further expand capabilities in snow science, avalanches and related processes. Earlier work has focused on rock slopes, slush flows, wet snow avalanches, climate adaptation and hazard/runout modelling. We would like to develop this research direction. The position benefits from active connections to the Department of Physics and Technology, Department of Technology and Safety and the Center for Avalanche Research and Education (CARE), and interdisciplinary research is encouraged to strengthen UiT’s position as a driver of Arctic knowledge, such as incorporating elements of psychology, preparedness and climate research.


The position’s field of research/field of work

The successful candidate is expected to:

  • Conduct high-quality research that strengthens UiT’s snow science portfolio within the snow science and geohazards thematic area. Research may also be interdisciplinary, and a connection with CARE and other UiT institutes is encouraged.
  • Teach undergraduate and advanced graduate courses, as well as participate in teaching of the field courses organized by the scientific group. The successful candidate will be expected to fulfil basic pedagogical competence within two years.
  • Supervise students at all levels, including MSc and PhD students.
  • Build external networks and represent the department at meetings, conferences and community outreach events.
  • Respond to media enquiries within your field.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to secure external funding and contribute to establishing permanent snow science capability at UiT.

It is expected that the participant will participate in disseminating research to a wider public. 


Contact

Further information about the position and UiT is available by contacting

Associate Professor Louise Daines-Vick, phone + 47 90 47 30 83, email: louise.m.vick@uit.no

Professor/Head of Department (interim) Anders Schomacker, phone + 47 95 52 34 64, email: anders.schomacker@uit.no


Qualifications

For this three-year fixed-term position as Associate Professor with a focus on snow science the applicants

  • must have a PhD in geosciences, physics, mathematics or a closely related field and a documented publication record in snow science and/or related geohazards. 
  • must have experience in, and a strong dedication to, field-based research and navigating snowy terrain. A track record or commitment to acquisition of external funding is desired.  The research should complement the existing research strengths within the fields of the Solid Earth Science, Mineral Resources and Geohazards scientific group, which includes the field of geohazards. 
  • must have an ability to communicate effectively in English. 
  • documented pedagogical competence. All applicants for teaching and research positions shall document their pedagogical competence. You must have acquired basic competence for teaching and supervision at higher education level. This includes basic skills in planning, conducting, evaluating and developing teaching and guidance. Those who do not meet the requirements for pedagogical competence upon employment will be required to meet them within two years.
  • Norwegian language skills: The position requires proficiency in a Scandinavian language equivalent to level B2 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). New employees who do not fulfill the language criteria by appointment are required, within three years, to demonstrate sufficient proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language. Arrangements will be made to facilitate the completion of Norwegian courses.
  • personal suitability: Our working culture is important to us. We will emphasize the applicants motivation for the position and personal suitability. We are looking for candidates who display the following:
    • Collegial team player, ability to cooperate and communicate well with other members of staff and contribute to a good working environment.
    • Strong networking skills, ability to collaborate and conduct scientific leadership
    • Interest in strategy and strategic development of the department.
    • Good communication skills and ability to engage with academic, stakeholder and public audiences.

The applicants should have expertise in one or several aspects of snow avalanches and geohazards. Research approaches may include, for example, remote sensing, numerical and physical modelling, laboratory experiments, and field measurements on snow, slush, debris, or mixed materials. 

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).


Pedagogical competence

All applicants for teaching and research positions must document their educational competence in their application.

Those who do not meet the requirements for pedagogical competence upon employment will be required to meet them within two years. UiT offers courses in educational competence to employees.

You must have acquired basic competence for teaching and supervision at university and college level.This entails basic skills in planning, implementing, evaluating and developing teaching and supervision. 

See how to document educational competence: About the pedagogical portfolio - Result  (English guide at the bottom of the page)


We offer
  • A stimulating international research environment within the geohazards theme and opportunities for collaboration across UiT.
  • Support for career development, supervision of students and external funding applications
  • Access to university research infrastructure, administrative and technical support, and professional development (mentoring, courses and workshops)
  • You will join a thriving geosciences environment with active projects, a strong student cohort and close interdisciplinary collaboration. You will have access to relevant laboratory and field equipment, opportunities to participate in and lead field campaigns, and support for outreach and stakeholder engagement
  • Allocated funds to support your research, travel and equipment needs
  • Good welfare arrangements for employees
  • Good arrangements for pension, insurance and loans in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Access to the department cabin Heiahytta for a reasonable rental fee
  • If you have to relocate to Tromsø then the Faculty of Science and Technology may reimburse your moving costs. Further details regarding this matter will be made available if you receive an offer from us.

 

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.


Work- and salary conditions 

The successful candidate must be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

The allocation of working hours is flexible and allocated on a case-by-case basis. In general, Associate Professors will spend an equal amount of time on teaching and research and development work after time spent on other duties has been deducted. As a norm, the time resources spent on administrative duties constitutes 5 % for academic staff. 

The remuneration for Associate Professor is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1011, with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 700000,-  to 900000,- in a 100 % position. In special cases, a higher salary may be considered. 

As a state employee, you have one of the best pension schemes available. For more information see: spk.no.


Application

The application must include: 

  • Cover letter including a short description of interests and reasons for applying for the position  
  • CV containing a complete overview of education, experience and professional work 
  • Diplomas, diploma supplements and transcripts (all degrees, in original language and translated) 
  • Letter(s) of recommendation if applicable
  • Two references with contact details 
  • Documented pedagogical competence. Brief description of teaching philosophy/documentation of educational competence in the form of a pedagogical map or course certificate of completed university pedagogical basic competence such as UNIPED 100 at UiT or equivalent from other universities 
  • A list of your academic production 
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important 
  • Academic works, up to ten. The doctoral thesis is regarded as one work. 
  • Documentation of English proficiency.  

Proficiency in the English language can be documented in the following ways: 

  • Diploma from a Norwegian upper secondary school with both spoken and written English (140 hours) 
  • TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language) 
  • IELTS (International English Testing Service) 
  • Completed university degree in the field of English language or literature 
  • One year of completed university studies in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the UK or USA, for which English was the language of instructions. 

Documentation has to be in English or a Scandinavian language. The application and submitted documents must be sent electronically via www.jobbnorge.no 


Assessment

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications on the basis of the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description drawn up for the position.

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview shall among other things, aim to clarify the applicants personal suitability for the position and motivations. A trial lecture may also be held.


General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who by assessment of the application and attachment are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment.

After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.

More information about moving to Norway and working at UiT: http://uit.no/mobility

​According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

In case of discrepancies between the Norwegian and the English version of this description, the Norwegian version takes precedence. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is an internationally leading broad-based university. Our vision is to be a driving force in the North. The Northern Sami term eallju, which means diligence, sets the tone for UiT's drive. Together with students, staff, and society at large, we will utilizeour location in Northern Norway and Sápmi, our academic breadth, and interdisciplinary advantages to shape the future.
 

UiT has approximately18,000 students, more than 4,000 employees, and is established across four main campuses and seven additional study locations in Northern Norway and on Svalbard. Our largest campuses are Tromsø, Alta ,Narvik, and Harstad. UiT has seven faculties, 40 departments and centers, and leading research environments in various fields. The university offers 269 study programs and focuses on educational quality.

Academic freedom, scientific principles, and research ethics form the foundation of all UiT'sactivities. Participation, co-determination,
transparency, and sound processes will provide the basis for making wise and forward-looking decisions. Our students and staff will have the opportunity to develop their abilities and potential. Rooted in scientific integrity, we aim to be bold, engaged, and generous -closely connected to academia, people, and contemporary developments

See: UiTs strategi mot 2030

ETSIMME OULUN ALUEELLE LÄHIHOITAJAA KOTIHOITOON VIIKONLOPPUIHIN

Kotihoito tarjoaa mahdollisuuden tehdä yksilöllistä ja merkityksellistä työtä, jossa asiakkaan hyvinvointi ja elämänlaatu ovat keskiössä. Etsimme nyt Oulun alueelle lähihoitajaa tai loppuvaiheen opiskelijaa kotihoitoon osa-aikaiseen työhön. Pääset aloittamaan työn heti tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Kotihoidossa työsi on monipuolista, itsenäistä ja ihmisläheistä. Työskentelet asiakkaiden omissa kodeissa ja tuet heitä toimimaan arjessa turvallisesti ja mahdollisimman omatoimisesti. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat mm.:

* Lääkehoito (osaamisen ja lupien mukaisesti)

* Asiakkaan toimintakyvyn, hyvinvoinnin ja turvallisuuden tukeminen

Kotihoidossa jokainen työpäivä on erilainen. Pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi laaja-alaisesti ja tekemään työtä, jolla on todellista merkitystä asiakkaiden arjessa.

* Merkityksellisen, arvostetun ja itsenäisen työn

* Mahdollisuuden työskennellä omalla tavallasi, asiakasta kunnioittaen

* Ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön tueksesi

* Yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan

MITÄ TOIVOMME SINULTA?

* Lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja voimassa olevia lupia

* Asiakaslähtöistä, vastuullista ja lämminhenkistä työotetta

* Kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksentekoon

* Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa

* Oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta, sillä liikut asiakaskohteiden välillä

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi! Haastattelemme jo hakuajan aikana.

Nähdään Alinassa!

Alina on valtakunnallinen ketju, joka työllistää jo 350 alan ammattilaista. Paikallisia Alina-yrityksiä on jo yli 30 eri puolilla Suomea. Yhdeksän kymmenestä asiakkaastamme suosittelisi Alinaa tuttavilleen, ja työtyytyväisyytemme sai arvosanaksi 4,39/5 vuonna 2025.

jobs.description:
Who we are looking for

We're looking for a Founding Growth Marketer to build Birdsview's growth engine from the ground up, the person who turns "we have a great product" into a steady flow of qualified pipeline. AI first person.

Birdsview - Prolonging the lifetime of the built world

Birdsview is a Norwegian technology company on a mission to change the way we preserve critical infrastructure to ensure a more sustainable and secure future.

Infrastructure is one of society’s most important assets. It includes the buildings we live in, the bridges we cross and the power grid that provides us with electricity. These structures are aging rapidly, and solutions that help preserve and secure critical infrastructure are now needed more than ever.

Birdsview's state-of-the-art technology combines radar (GPR), lidar, and AI to visualize what’s inside structures without destructive interventions. This allows for efficient and cost-effective inspection and monitoring of our most precious infrastructures - and enables clear, user-friendly visualizations that enhance understanding, extend asset lifespan, and promote material reuse - ultimately reducing costs and CO₂ emissions.

We are 17 people, we have customers in 9 countries, and we raised NOK 40.5 million from leading Nordic VC's to scale internationally.

About the job and why it matters

Much of concrete inspection today still relies on manual methods and fragmented, ageing non-destructive testing (NDT) equipment. You will help structural engineers, contractors, surveying specialists, and asset owners see clearly what is hidden inside the concrete. New critical data, faster inspections, and real cost savings are why they want our technology in their daily projects.

As a Founding Growth Marketer, you will be the engine of our international growth. The role is hands-on: you'll use AI tools to build and test campaigns across channels, turn technical value into content that resonates with engineers and asset owners, run experiments to find what actually converts, and hand qualified leads to our sales team. This is a foundational role in a newly formed marketing function, where you will have a direct impact on our strategy, processes, and success.

  • Build the engine
    You'll design and implement our full growth marketing engine, taking a foundational role in shaping our strategy.

  • Own demand generation
    Own demand generation across content, paid, and organic channels, directly impacting qualified lead flow to sales. You're measured on qualified leads reaching sales.

  • Find the message that lands
    Test positioning against our different customer segments; engineers, contractors, asset owners and find the one we can scale. Nobody has the answer yet.

  • Work the funnel with sales
    Hand qualified leads to our sales team, and use what they hear back to sharpen the next campaign.

  • Build the measurement
    Set up tracking, reporting, and analytics to measure performance, identify effective strategies, and drive continuous improvement.

  • Make the technical obvious
    Leverage AI tools to create and test innovative campaigns that translate complex technical value into resonant messages for our target audience.

What we're looking for

  • AI-first, systematic and test-driven. You run experiments, read the data, and a campaign that flops doesn't slow you down.

  • Proven ability to build and run a complete growth engine: lead generation, content, paid campaigns, organic channels.

  • Skills in setting up tracking, reporting and analytics, so performance is measured rather than asserted.

  • Experience developing, testing and refining positioning and messaging, in collaboration with sales and leadership.

  • 1–3 years of experience in B2B growth or marketing, ideally in a startup or scale-up. Hands-on and results-oriented, this is a building role.

  • Fluent English; Norwegian is an advantage.

  • Based in Bergen or Oslo, or willing to relocate.

Why this is interesting

  • Top-tier colleagues
    Work alongside leading people in a supportive and ambitious team culture, with regular social events and company trips.

  • Build it yourself
    Be a foundational member, directly shaping our international sales strategy and playbook.

  • Room to grow
    We're building the commercial team right now. What you own in a year depends on what you build in the first six months.

  • Compensation
    Competitive salary and equity - become an owner.

  • Impact
    Make a tangible impact on preserving critical infrastructure and fostering a circular economy.

  • Location
    Work in Bergen or Oslo with a fast-moving, hands-on team. Excellent working facilities at StartupLab centrally located in both cities.

jobs.title: Associate professor of Equine Sports Medicine
jobs.description:
Associate professor of Equine Sports Medicine

Department of Veterinary Clinical Sciences

Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences

University of Copenhagen



The University seeks to appoint an associate professor within Equine Sports Medicine to the Department of Veterinary Clinical Sciences to commence 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Information on the Department can be found at: http://www.sund.ku.dk/ and www.ikv.ku.dk/english.

About us

The Department of Veterinary Clinical Sciences covers strong and internationally recognized research areas in clinical veterinary sciences. A relatively large part of our research is fertilised and inspired from clinical challenges, identified in the hospital, in our ambulatory field practice or from our external collaborators. Based on these, we want to set a new standard for cross-disciplinary research, education and innovation within animal health and disease.

The Section for Medicine, Surgery and Reproduction for Large animals holds research and clinical teaching, in a modern 24-hour open university veterinary teaching hospital and ambulatory field practice service for all large animals with horses as the primary species consulted. We also have the cross departmental, University of Copenhagen Centre for Veterinary Simulation, which is open 24/7 for veterinary students to practice clinical skills. Our research is focused on diseases of clinical relevance for horses and cattle thereby having a direct application for veterinarians and animal owners. Also, translational research bridging basic science to companion animal as well as human medicine is a strength of the section.

We have a strong educational and scientific focus on the athletic horse collaborating with internationally recognised research groups within cardiovascular, airway and orthopaedic research with a high impact translational research profile. To fully exploit the scientific and clinical potentials, the muscular development and disease understanding in sports and rehabilitation medicine both in horses and companion animals and is a strategic research area in the department, why collaboration with the companion animal sections of the department is expected in the position. The announced associate professorship is crucial to enhancing and strengthening this area to fully obtain the synergy of the other research areas mentioned above.

Equine medicine is a core discipline in the fourth and fifth years of the veterinary medical education in Denmark. Therefore the position is highly involved in research based teaching of veterinary students within equine sports medicine and the candidate is expected to take a leadership role in conducting clinical relevant research, teaching and examining undergraduate students, as well as assist and promote the development of both pre-and postgraduate teaching as well as research strategies within the field of equine sports medicine.

The culture of the department is typical Scandinavian: a flat structure with a tradition for close collaboration where all employees are expecting openness, mutual respect, and sharing of ideas, resources and competences.

Job description

In considering applications for the associate professorship, the main emphasis will be on the following aspects:

  • The applicant's ability to document a high level of original scientific production at an international level within the area of equine sports medicine and preferably with a strong translational profile.
  • The applicant’s practical experience within equine general medicine in both a hospital and in research setting.
  • The applicants experience with development of clinical research-based teaching of veterinary students.
The associate professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of:

  • Research, including publication/academic dissemination
  • Research-based pre-and postgraduate teaching, including clinical teaching and service, associated examination and course responsibilities
  • Strengthen, developing and integrating muscular research in research-based teaching of veterinary students
  • Research leadership, including guidance and supervision of researchers and veterinary students as well as securing external funding.
  • Obligation to share knowledge with the rest of society, including participation in public debate and engagement in topics of relevance for horse owners
  • Organizational contribution to the section, department and university incl. e.g. participation in department committees and course leadership.
  • Academic assessments
Required qualifications

To be qualified for an associate professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution and leadership.

Find information about each criterion.

The successful applicant should:

  • Hold a DVM with license to practice in Denmark or be willing to apply for such within 6 months.
  • Hold a PhD degree or similar qualifications.
  • Diplomat degree within ECEIM, ACVIM or ECVSMR is an advantage.
  • Document a high degree of research experience and scientific publications within the field of equine internal medicine and sports medicine at an international level, including considerable contributions to the development of the academic discipline.
  • Have experience with research management and other management functions, including attraction of external funding and group leadership.
  • Document pre-and postgraduate clinical teaching experience within the field of the position and documented pedagogical training at university level.
  • Perform research-based teaching.
  • Perform quality patient care and service management in an equine hospital and ambulatory field practice within equine general medicine.
  • Possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.
  • If Danish is not the first language, the applicant is expected to obtain sufficient Danish skills within 1-2 years.
Diversity and International Applicants

The University of Copenhagen is committed to fostering diversity and encourages all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of personal background.

Useful resources:

  • www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility)
  • www.workingconditions.ku.dk.
Terms of employment

The position is a permanent position.

The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

Employment is as associate professor according to the collective agreement or job structure under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025.

This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package for up to 2,500,000 DKK that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. Please read about the contents of the programme and conditions, as well as UCPH’s extensive support for international researchers here

Questions

For further information, please contact group leader Tina Holberg Pihl thpi@sund.ku.dk.

Application

The application must be submitted in English, by clicking on "Apply online" below, and must include the following:

  • Application, including motivation for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages)
  • Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding)
  • A complete list of publications
  • Diplomas - (Master’s, PhD, and other relevant certificates)
  • Upload a list of maximum 5 publications to be assessed
  • Research plan (3-5 pages)
  • Teaching plan
  • Teaching portfolio (Guidelines)
The further process
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The Dean then appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee and each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at the university's job portal.

Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.

The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

Please submit the application with the required attachments.

The closing date for applications is 29 October 2026 23.59 p.m. CET.

Employer: Department of Veterinary Clinical and Animal Sciences, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. Homepage: http://ikvh.ku.dk/english/

The University of Copenhagen actively influences current and future generations through excellent research, education and co-operation. UCPH is one of the highest ranked universities in Europe and is Denmark´s oldest university, founded in 1479. Today, the University has 37,000 students and

jobs.title: Apulaispäällikkö, S-market Tammisaari / Biträdande enhetschef, S-market Ekenäs
jobs.description:
Primary location:
RAASEPORI

APULAISPÄÄLLIKKÖ, S-MARKET TAMMISAARI, 37,5H, VAKITUINEN TYÖSUHDE

Etsimme S-market Tammisaareen kokoaikaista apulaispäällikköä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Tämä työ sopii sinulle, joka nautit vaihtelevasta arjesta, pidät ihmisten kohtaamisesta ja haluat olla mukana tekemässä isosta ja monipuolisesta myymälästä paikkaa, jossa on kiva asioida ja tehdä töitä. S-market Tammisaaren arki tarjoaa paljon erilaisia toimintoja, tilanteita ja mahdollisuuksia onnistua yhdessä tiimin kanssa.
Apulaispäällikkönä, eli tuttavallisemmin apparina, olet toimipaikkapäällikön tärkein työpari ja mukana varmistamassa, että myymälän arki rullaa sujuvasti aamusta iltaan. Isossa yksikössä pääset näkemään kaupan arkea laajasti ja saat kivasti vastuuta sekä hyvän mahdollisuuden kasvaa esihenkilönä konkreettisen tekemisen kautta.

Tässä tehtävässä:
- Vastaat yhdessä toimipaikkapäällikön kanssa asiakastyytyväisyydestä, palvelusta, prosesseista, henkilökunnan työnohjauksesta ja myymälän operatiivisesta tuloksesta.
- Johdat toimintaa omalla esimerkilläsi ja olet arjessa mukana niin hyllytyksessä, kassalla kuin asiakaspalvelussa.
- Sparraat toimipaikkapäällikköä ja tuet henkilökuntaa, sillä tiimityö on avain kaikkeen, mitä teemme.
- Työskentelet vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa, jotta myymälä on parhaassa mahdollisessa kunnossa kaikkina aukioloaikoina.
- Hyppäät vastuuseen itsenäisesti toimipaikkapäällikön lomien aikana.
Onnistuaksesi tehtävässä:
- Olet oma-aloitteinen, järjestelmällinen ja tykkäät siitä, että työpäivässä tapahtuu.
- Sinulla on jo kokemusta kaupan alalta – mielellään myös vastuutehtävistä.
- Osaat toimia paineisissakin tilanteissa hymyssä suin.
- Kohtaat asiakkaat ja työkaverit sydän kohdallaan <3
- Valmentava ote ja hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ovat osa sinua.
- On tärkeää, että kykenet asiakaspalveluun vähintään suomeksi tai ruotsiksi.
Mitä ihan tavallinen työ meillä tarkoittaa?
- Työpaikkaa, johon on kiva tulla ja josta on kiva lähteä kotiin.
- Tiimiä, jossa kaveria ei jätetä ja jossa esihenkilöt ovat mukana arjen tekemisessä.
- Mahdollisuutta kehittyä ja kouluttautua jatkuvasti, esimerkiksi erilaisten koulutusten sekä ammatillisen tutkinnon tai sen osan suorittamisen kautta.
- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista – ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja paljon muusta.
- Kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja liikuntaetuja.
Palkkaus
- Kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkausta (13,33 €/h – 15,26 €/h), johon vaikuttavat kokemuksesi ja koulutuksesi.
- Apulaispäälliköille maksetaan lisäksi tehtävän vaativuuden mukaista vastuulisää.
- 5 % kielilisä, jos asiakaspalvelu onnistuu vähintään suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.
- Mahdollisuuden tulospalkkioon, joka on jopa 1,70 euroa lisää jokaiselta työtunnilta, jos ja kun saavutamme vuosittaiset tavoitteemme.

Jos ihan tavallinen (mutta sopivasti haastava) työ kiinnostaa, laita hakemus tulemaan.
Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään sunnuntaina 11.10.2026. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa toimipaikkapäällikkö Malin Fransman (puh. 010762 6029, malin.fransman@sok.fi ). Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

-------------

BITRÄDANDE ENHETSCHEF, S-MARKET EKENÄS, 37,5H, TILLSVIDAREANSTÄLLNING

Vi söker en biträdande enhetschef på heltid till S-market Ekenäs för en tillsvidareanställning. Det här jobbet passar dig som trivs med en omväxlande vardag, gillar att möta människor och vill vara med och skapa en stor och mångsidig butik där det är trevligt att både handla och arbeta. S-market Ekenäs är en enhet där vardagen bjuder på många olika funktioner, situationer och möjligheter att lyckas tillsammans med teamet.
Som biträdande enhetschef, eller tvåa som vi brukar säga, är du enhetschefens viktigaste arbetspar och med och säkerställer att vardagen i butiken flyter på smidigt från morgon till kväll. I en stor enhet får du se handelns vardag brett, ta lagom mycket ansvar och få en fin möjlighet att växa som chef genom konkret arbete.

I den här rollen:
-Tillsammans med enhetschefen ansvarar du för kundnöjdhet, service, processer, arbetsledning och operativt resultat.
-Du leder verksamheten med ditt eget exempel och deltar i det dagliga arbetet, både i varuplock, i kassan och i kundservice.
-Du sparrar enhetschefen och stöder personalen, eftersom teamarbete är nyckeln till allt vi gör.
-Du jobbar i varierande skift, för vi vill att butiken ska vara i bästa möjliga skick under alla öppettider.
-Du tar självständigt ansvar under chefens semestrar.
Vad vi önskar av dig:
-Du är initiativtagande, strukturerad och gillar när det händer saker under arbetsdagen.
-Du har redan skaffat erfarenhet från handeln - gärna också från ansvarspositioner.
-Du kan hantera stressiga situationer med ett leende på läpparna.
-Du möter kunder och kollegor med hjärtat på rätt ställe. <3
-Du behöver god samarbetsförmåga och ett coachande arbetssätt.
- det är viktigt att du kan ge kundservice på åtminstone finska eller svenska.
Vad innebär ett helt vanligt jobb hos oss?
-Ett jobb som får dig på gott humör både före och efter arbetsdagen.
-Ett team där man inte lämnar kollegorna i sticket och där cheferna jobbar sida vid sida med teamet.
-Möjlighet att utvecklas och utbilda dig kontinuerligt, till exempel genom olika utbildningar samt möjlighet att avlägga en yrkesexamen eller en del av den.
-Personalrabatt på S-gruppens produkter och tjänster, till exempel på mat, dryck, smink, elektronik, restauranger, hotell och mycket annat trevligt.
-Kultur-, välbefinnande- och motionsförmån
Lön
- Lön enligt handelns kollektivavtal (13,33 €/h - 15,26 €/h), beroende på din erfarenhet och utbildning.
- Därtill får biträdande enhetschefen ett ansvarstillägg som motsvarar arbetsuppgiftens kravnivå.
- Ett språktillägg på 5 procent om du kan betjäna kunder på åtminstone finska och svenska.
- Möjlighet till en resultatpremie på upp till 1,70 euro extra för varje arbetad timme om och när vi når våra årliga mål.

Om du är intresserad av ett helt vanligt (men lagom utmanande) jobb, skicka in din ansökan. Vi framskrider med rekryteringen redan under ansökningstiden, så lämna in din ansökan så fort som möjligt men senast söndag 11.10.2026. För mer information om uppgiften, vänligen kontakta enhetschef Malin Fransman (puh. 010762 6029, malin.fransman@sok.fi ). Anställningen börjar enligt avtal.

jobs.title: Senior Power Electronics Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

Power electronics are the bottleneck on every next-generation UAS airframe we build: motor controllers, gate drivers, and DC-DC stages are what define flight time, payload, thermal envelope, and field reliability. We're looking for a senior IC to own the analog power chain end-to-end across our UXV platforms: from MOSFET commutation simulation through PCB layout to lab validation. You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment.

This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware.

 

Responsibilities

  • Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification.

  • MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs.

  • Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink.

  • BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces.

  • High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EMC engineered in from the first revision.

  • EMI / EMC Engineering: Drive pre-compliance, filter design, and root-cause debug under flight-representative loads.

  • Prototype-to-Production: Take motor-controller PCBAs through revision discipline, DFM, and qualification - closing the loop on field returns.

  • Lab Validation: Execute bench characterization (power analysers, oscilloscopes, thermal imaging, double-pulse testing) and reconcile against simulation.

  • Firmware & Controls Interface: Partner with embedded and propulsion on FOC tuning, current-sense calibration, and the hardware/firmware compensation boundary.

  • Design Authority & Mentorship: Set the bar via design-decision records and reference designs. Mentor 1–2 junior engineers.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or equivalent.

  • 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience on motor drives, BLDC/PMSM controllers, or high-power-density power electronics.

  • Deep working mastery of MOSFET commutation design: gate-driver selection, dead-time tuning, switching transitions, loss budgets.

  • Proven ownership of at least one motor-controller PCBA shipped from prototype through production (or pre-production qualification): ideally on drone, robotics, eVTOL, or automotive platforms.

  • Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium).

  • Strong, hard-earned intuition for EMI / EMC design and debug.

  • Lab-bench discipline: you've personally debugged what simulation missed.

  • Comfort with scale-up iteration speed and end-to-end ownership.

  • English fluent (working language); French is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

Bonus points for: GaN / SiC experience, safety-critical design exposure , applied control theory implemented in hardware, exposure to defense, aerospace, or UAS programmes.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

About the role

As an Embedded Electrical Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to design the compute modules and associated boards used across our platforms. You will own these designs end-to-end, from system architecture and schematic through layout guidance, fabrication, bring-up, and qualification. This is a high-impact role that combines demanding high-speed design work with hands-on bench work, taking hardware from a first prototype through to boards that fly.

Responsibilities

  • Board Design: Design SoMs, baseboards, and test boards for our compute platforms.

  • High-Speed Digital Design: Design around high-end application processors, covering PCIe, 10 Gb Ethernet, USB 3.x, and MIPI, managing layout constraints and signal integrity.

  • Power Design: Design power trees, sequencing, and conversion topologies, and verify power-up and power-down behaviour.

  • Design Reviews: Prepare and lead design reviews at each milestone, from block diagram to release for fabrication.

  • Manufacture: Work with PCB and EMS partners on stack-up, via technology, layout guidance, and cost trade-offs.

  • Bring Up and Qualification: Define verification test plans, troubleshoot and characterise boards, and run thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with the embedded software team through board bring-up, the mechanical team on form factor and thermal constraints, and validation for flight qualification.

Candidate requirements

  • Educational Background: MSc in electrical, computer, or a related engineering field. A PhD is a plus. A hands-on design and bring-up record matters more than the specific degree.

  • Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded hardware design, with boards taken from specification through bring-up and qualification into production.

  • Technical Expertise: High-speed design including layout constraints, signal integrity, and validation. Systems built around a processor with external memory (DDR, Flash) are carried through to a committed layout. Power trees with deliberate conversion topologies and verified power-up and power-down behaviour.

  • Tools: In-depth knowledge of electronic CAD tools (e.g., Altium).

  • Testing Proficiency: Proficiency with electronic test equipment and experience planning thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification.

  • Manufacturing: Experience working with fabrication and assembly partners on stack-up, via technology, and cost trade-offs.

  • Problem Solving: Rigorous, structured, and analytical; able to work autonomously and see a board from concept through to production.

  • Communication and Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, able to present design and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Additional Skills: FPGA or MPSoC design, prior work deploying AI inference on embedded targets, and UAS, drone, or defence hardware experience are strong advantages.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

  • Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded hardware design, with boards taken from specification through bring-up and qualification into production.

Systems built around a processor with external memory (DDR, Flash) are carried through to a committed layout. Power trees with deliberate conversion topologies and verified power-up and power-down behaviour.

  • Tools: In-depth knowledge of electronic CAD tools (e.g., Altium).

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Ohjaaja
jobs.description:
Ammattilaiset yhdessä lasten parhaaksi.

Koska lasten tulevaisuus alkaa nyt.

Pelastakaa Lapset on maailman johtava sitoutumaton lapsijärjestö ja lastensuojelun edelläkävijä. Ammattilaisiamme Suomessa ja yli 100 maassa yhdistää maailman tärkein tehtävä. Rakennamme parempaa tulevaisuutta lapsille yhdessä lasten, vapaaehtoisten ja kumppaneiden kanssa.

Lupaamme sinulle työpaikan, jossa teemme vaikuttavaa työtä, työskentelemme vahvalla ammattitaidolla ja arvostamme inhimillistä työkulttuuria.

Pelastakaa Lasten palvelutoiminnan kokonaisuuteen kuuluvat kaksi lastenkotia, kolme erityislastenkotia ja yksi perhekuntoutusyksikkö. Palvelutoiminnan tukena työskentelee Pelastakaa Lasten oma nuorisopsykiatri, kehittämispäällikkö sekä kokemusasiantuntijavanhempi. Palvelutoimintamme on ollut SHQS laaduntunnustuksen piirissä vuodesta 2012 alkaen.



Haemme ammattitaitoiseen joukkoomme

Ohjaajaa

toteuttamaan kanssamme laadukasta ja lapsenoikeusperustaista perustason sijaishuoltoa Lastenkoti Ritvalaan 50 % työajalla, vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Odotamme hakijalta AMK- tason tai lähihoitajan tutkintoa.

Lastenkoti Ritvala on 7-paikkainen lastenkoti luonnonkauniilla paikalla Vesijärven rannalla Vääksyssä. Asiakkaamme ovat 7–18-vuotiaita huostaanotettuja lapsia ja nuoria. Työtämme ohjaa yhteisöllisyyteen ja osallisuuteen pohjautuva toimintakulttuuri, jonka olemme luoneet yhdessä lasten ja työryhmän kanssa. Työmme perustana ovat lapsen oikeudet, lapsen osallisuus, kiintymyssuhdeajattelu ja DKT.

Meillä Ritvalassa on hyvä työilmapiiri ja kaikilla on tilaa tehdä työtä omalla persoonallaan. Arvostamme Ritvalan yhteisössä avoimuutta, rehellisyyttä, läpinäkyvyyttä sekä vastuullista yhdessä tekemisen meininkiä.

Ohjaajana tehtävänäsi on edistää yhdessä ammattitaitoisen työryhmän kanssa lasten kokonaisvaltaisista hyvinvointia Ritvalan arjessa. Omaohjaajana luot kiintymyssuhdetta lapseen sekä työskentelet työparina lapsen perheen ja verkostojen kanssa. Koko työryhmämme perehdyttää sinua työhösi Ritvalassa.

Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän arvostetussa järjestössä. Kehitämme rohkeasti uusia toimintatapoja, asetamme kunnianhimoisia tavoitteita ja teemme tinkimättömästi töitä niiden eteen. Haluamme yhdessä rakentaa monimuotoista työyhteisöä ja ilmapiiriä, jossa jokainen voi olla oma itsensä. Ympäriltäsi löydät mukavia ja ammattitaitoisia kollegoita, joista voit olla ylpeä ja jotka ovat ylpeitä sinusta. Sydän paikallaan – se yhdistää meitä kaikkia.

Tarjoamme työsi ja ammatillisen kehittymisesi tueksi:

· tarvittaessa henkilökohtaisen omaohjaajatyön työnohjauksen

· säännölliset lasten- ja nuorisopsykiatrin konsultaatiot

· monipuoliset sisäiset ja ulkoiset koulutusmahdollisuudet

· tarvittavat lisäkoulutuksen

· Pelastakaa Lasten- yhteisen arvopohjan sekä tuen työn ja yksityiselämän yhteensovittamiseen

· kattavan sairaanhoitotasoisen työterveyshuollon Terveystalossa

· kehittämisyksikkö, HR ja talousosasto ovat työsi tukena

· ePassi hyvinvointiedun



Toivomme sinulta:

· AMK – tasoista (esim. sosionomi / sairaanhoitaja), - tai lähihoitajan tutkintoa

· arvostamme aikaisempaa lastensuojelutyön kokemusta sekä neuropsykiatrisia ja psykiatrisia erikoistumiskoulutuksia

· kykyä yksilöllisen ja yhteisöllisen hoito- ja kasvatustyön suunnitteluun, toteuttamiseen ja kehittämiseen

· valmiutta tehdä iltapainotteista kolmivuorotyötä (jaksotyöaika 50 % /3 vko)

· B - ajokorttia



Tehtävä on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva työsuhde ja alkaa 26.10.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Palkkaus määräytyy kokemuksesi perusteella Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n mukaisesti. Palkkaluokka tehtävässä on G24D (2811,09 € - 3071,09 €). Palkanmaksuprosessimme on kunnossa ja olemme turvallinen ja säännöllinen palkanmaksaja.

Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, lähetäthän hakemuksesi viimeistään 18.10.2026. Käsittelemme hakemuksia kuitenkin jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Huomiomme myös loppuvaiheen opiskelijoiden hakemuksia.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa arkisin klo 8–15 Ritvalan lastenkodin johtaja Tuire Mikkonen-Kalpio p.040 7691764/ tuire.mikkonen-kalpio@pelastakaalapset.fi [tuire.mikkonen-kalpio@pelastakaalapset.fi]

Lasten turvallisuus on meille tärkeää kaikessa toiminnassamme ja työntekijöidensitoutuminen lasten suojelemiseen väkivallalta on ehdoton edellytys valinnalle tehtävään, joten tarkistamme rikostaustaotteesi ennen työsopimuksen solmimista (Laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämiseksi 504/2002). Lisäksi edellytämme Pelastakaa Lapset ry:n sitoumuksen allekirjoittamista lasten suojelemiseksi.


Arvostamme työyhteisön monimuotoisuutta ja teemme töitä yhdenvertaisuuden eteen. Toivomme hakijoita erilaisista taustoista, kuten eri-ikäisiä, eri sukupuolia olevia, vammaisia ihmisiä sekä eri kieli-, kulttuuri- tai muihin väestöryhmiin kuuluvia.

jobs.title: Director, Business Development
jobs.description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry? Are you interested in helping international brands/organizations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!

TransPerfect was founded with a mission to help the world's businesses navigate the global marketplace. Today, we have grown to be an industry leader organization by helping clients globalize their business no matter what service they might need. TransPerfect provides a full array of language and business support services, including translation, subtitling and dubbing, multicultural marketing, website globalization, legal support, and any kind of technology solution.

That’s enough about us – what about you? We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success.

TransPerfect is looking for established sales professionals to further develop our engagement model. The Director of Business Development will be responsible for identifying and engaging with client prospects as well as managing client relationships during the full life cycle of client campaigns. Minimum 3 years experience in a similar role required.

Key position responsibilities:

  • Source and close new clients through referrals, cold calling, networking, and other means (tradeshows, regional organizations, etc.)

  • Build a productive pipeline and manage each phase of the sales process

  • Cultivate and maintain long term relationships with clients by delivering elite client service and engaging them by using knowledge of each industry and organization

  • Formulate sales plan to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets

  • Generate daily outreach efforts (direct mail, digital marketing, cold calls) to prospective clients

  • Develop an effective understanding of the capabilities, benefits, and competitive advantages of TransPerfect's services

  • Present TransPerfect's solutions via one-on-one, group, online and in-person meetings

  • Set and manage client expectations while consulting with each client for best practices

  • Manage and control pricing and contractual issues

  • Travel (including multiple annual conferences, client meetings) - domestic and/or international


Essential skills required:

  • Commit to a high level of integrity and service

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Owning your performance and taking responsibility

  • Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

  • Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

  • Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers

  • Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

  • Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

  • Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

Essential experience required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

  • Minimum 3 years successful sales experience

  • Superior written and spoken communication skills in German and English

  • Familiarity and ability to communicate value and competitive advantages

TransPerfect values equal opportunities. Applicants are therefore considered regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnic origin, skin colour, religion, belief, descent, genes, disabilities, sexual orientation, marital status or other characteristics worthy of protection. Applicants with disabilities are welcome and encouraged. If you experience any issues with your application process or require assistance please contact ----- style="text-align:start;min-height: 1.7em;">

jobs.description:
China Harbour Engineering Company Ltd. (CHEC) is a world-renowned international contractor and a leading provider of comprehensive services across the entire industry chain for both public and private sectors. CHEC has been engaged as the main contractor for the CAM Plant project in Kotka, responsible for the implementation and construction of the plant.

We are looking for an HVAC & Fire Engineering professional to join the CHEC team for the Kotka CAM Plant project to support the project during the construction, installation, testing, statutory inspection, commissioning and handover stages.

The job

The HVAC & Fire Engineering Manager shall lead and coordinate HVAC and Fire engineering for the CAM Project, with primary responsibility for design management, technical coordination, multidisciplinary interfaces and technical closure.

The position shall act as CHECs principal engineering interface with relevant HVAC and Fire designers/subcontractors, ensuring that engineering deliverables support construction, testing and commissioning priorities.

The role requires a hands-on and site-oriented engineering manager with a strong HVAC engineering background, who can actively drive designers and subcontractors, review technical solutions, identify missing or incomplete design scope, and resolve engineering issues through to documented closure.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and coordinate HVAC and Fire Engineering activities for the project.
- Manage design interfaces and collaborate with designers, consultants, subcontractors,and site teams.
- Ensure engineering deliverables support construction, testing, commissioning, andhandover.
- Resolve technical and installation-related issues and support site operations.
- Ensure compliance with Finnish regulations, authority requirements, and projectstandards.

Required Experience and Competence

- Relevant degree and strong experience in HVAC Engineering.
- Understanding of fire safety and fire protection systems.
- Experience in industrial construction projects, such as process plants, manufacturingfacilities, energy projects, or similar environments.
- Proven experience in design coordination and multidisciplinary project interfaces.
- Experience with testing, commissioning, and handover of building systems.
- Good knowledge of Finnish regulations and industry practices.
- Fluent Finnish and professional English skills.

The preferred candidate should be an active, hands-on HVAC engineering professional who is willing to work closely with the site team on a daily basis, rather than performing only an advisory or high-level project management role.

This project offers a fantastic opportunity to contribute to a high-impact initiative and develop professionally in a diverse and challenging environment.

Preferred start date: According to an agreement as soon as possible.

jobs.description:
Nordec is a supplier of steel frame structures and façade solutions for construction projects across the Nordic region, with an established presence in Central and Eastern Europe, including Poland, Lithuania, the Czech Republic and Germany.

The company designs, fabricates and installs steel structures for buildings and bridges, covering the project lifecycle from engineering to installation. Projects range from industrial facilities, logistics buildings, data centres, commercial, public, sports and cultural buildings, and bridges. Nordec operates its own production units in Peräseinäjoki and Ylivieska in Finland, Oborniki in Poland and Gargždai in Lithuania.

For more information, visit www.nordec.com.

Our Multi-storey unit continues to grow, and we are now looking to strengthen our team with a

**_PROJECT PLANNER_**

**_Would you like to play a key role in ensuring that complex international projects progress according to plan?_**

As a Project Planner, you will be responsible for preparing, maintaining and monitoring overall project schedules. You will plan project activities and their dependencies, while coordinating schedules across engineering, procurement, production, logistics and installation. You will monitor project progress, anticipate potential delays and scheduling risks, and provide project management and customers with up-to-date information on project status. You will be involved in projects from the tendering phase through to execution, working closely with the Project Manager and the wider project organisation.

To succeed in this role, you have previous experience in project planning and scheduling, along with a good understanding of overall project schedules, activity dependencies, progress monitoring, forecasting and reporting. Experience in EPC/EPCM, industrial, construction, data centre, battery factory or other demanding large-scale projects provides a strong foundation for the role. You can take independent responsibility for project planning and scheduling.

The role requires experience with Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project, as well as a relevant technical degree, for example in civil, construction or mechanical engineering. Strong English skills are essential. You should also be able to communicate in Finnish with your team, while Swedish language skills are considered an advantage. For a candidate with extensive relevant experience, the position may be offered with the title Planning Manager.

An analytical, structured and systematic approach to work is important in this role, along with strong collaboration skills and the ability to take responsibility as part of the wider project organisation.

The preferred location for the position is Seinäjoki or Vaasa, although other Nordec locations are also possible. The role offers flexible remote work. You should also be prepared to travel to factories and project sites, depending on project needs.

At Nordec, you will have the opportunity to work on large international projects in a role where your contribution has a direct impact on their success. You will be supported by an experienced project organisation and have the opportunity to develop both your own expertise and Nordecs project planning and scheduling processes.

The selected candidate will undergo a health examination and drug screening.

For more information about the position, please contact Mikaela Nyberg at WasaTalent, available Mondays to Thursdays, tel. 050 4141 600 or mikaela.nyberg@wasatalent.fi.

Pier 4:ssä luomme huomisen merkityksellisiä elämyksiä, joissa laatu korvaa määrän. Vastuullinen tapamme toimia välittyy huolenpidossa niin henkilökuntaa, asiakkaita kuin hotelliakin kohtaan. Roolissasi olet osa hotellin johtoryhmää ja raportoit hotellinjohtajalle.

jobs.title: CNC Turner, Lohja
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced CNC turner with proven Fanuc programming skills? You might be the right fit for the job!

Location: Lohja
Employment: Fixed-term employment with a possibility of long-term employment
Salary: 15 - 22 € / hour depending on skills and work experience

Wellpack is looking for a skilled CNC turner for our client company in Lohja to manufacture demanding industrial products. The client is a long-established Finnish technology industry company that manufactures demanding products and assemblies for industrial applications. Its production is characterized by high quality, strong technical expertise, and the machining of demanding materials.

What is the work like?

As a CNC turner, you will work on a wide range of machining tasks. You will independently program and operate CNC lathes, so the role requires previous experience with Fanuc controls and programming directly at the machine. The machines used are modern CNC lathes, including machines with sub-spindles and tailstocks.

The materials and component sizes vary, offering a broad range of machining tasks and technically interesting work.

The work is currently carried out in one shift from Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week, with the possibility of moving to a two-shift system. Depending on production needs, there may also be opportunities to work longer days and weekends. The position will start as soon as possible, according to agreement.

We expect you to have

* Previous work experience in CNC turning

* Independent Fanuc control and programming skills

* A precise and quality-oriented approach to work

* Carefulness and a responsible attitude

* A valid Occupational Safety Card

* Good Finnish or English language skills

The following are considered an advantage

* Experience with other controls

* Experience with a CAM-software

* Experience in machining demanding or large components

* Experience in machining titanium and other demanding materials

We offer you

* Full-time work in varied CNC turning tasks

* The opportunity to work with components of different sizes and materials

* A versatile range of machines and technically interesting tasks

* The opportunity to make full use of your CNC programming and turning skills

* The possibility of working longer days and weekends depending on production needs

* Assistance with arranging accommodation, if needed

* Competitive salary

* Salary: 15 - 22 € / hour depending on skills and work experience

You will be employed by Wellpack, a high-quality staffing services company established in 2013. Wellpack is particularly known as a trusted partner in the industrial and defence industries. We connect skilled professionals with high-quality jobs and contribute to employment in Finland.

Apply quick!

Submit your application promptly through the Apply for this position link in the job advertisement. Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted during the application period. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

In your application, please describe in particular your CNC turning experience, programming skills, the machines you have worked with, and the materials and types of components you have machined.

For more information about the position, please contact Wellpacks recruitment team by email at wellpack@wellpack.fi [wellpack@wellpack.fi].

jobs.title: (Senior) Data Engineer (Snowflake) – Building and Technical Trade, K Group
jobs.description:
Snowflake is becoming the foundation of Building and Technical Trade's future data ecosystem. As a (Senior) Data Engineer, you'll help define how data is modelled, built and utilized across analytics, AI and business development. Rather than joining a fully established environment, you'll have a rare opportunity to influence the development practices, data models and technical standards that will shape our future data platform. We are open to candidates from experienced Data Engineer to Senior Data Engineer level. The exact scope and level of responsibility can be shaped based on your background and expertise.

You will work as part of Kesko's Central Data & Analytics Platforms team while collaborating closely with Building and Technical Trade's Data, AI and ESG team. Together with BI analysts, analytics engineers, data experts and business stakeholders, you'll turn business needs into scalable and reliable data solutions that support both daily decision-making and future growth. We are working in a hybrid workplace model where we combine office days at K Kampus in Kalasatama and remote work to best suit both the role and the team. Come and join our professional team and start building your own kind of career in K Group!

What is the role about?

As a (Senior) Data Engineer, you will be a key data expert helping BTT build a modern Snowflake-based data foundation for analytics, AI and business development. This is a hands-on senior role with strong architectural influence: you will help shape how Snowflake development is done in BTT, while working closely with the BTT Data, AI and ESG team and Keskos central data platform experts. In addition to building solutions, you will help grow the teams Snowflake capabilities through collaboration, mentoring and practical examples.

Your key responsibilities include:
- Technical ownership: owning the technical direction of BTTs Snowflake solutions and ensuring that solutions are reliable, maintainable and aligned with agreed platform principles - Best practices and architecture: defining BTTs Snowflake development practices, including modelling approach, warehouse strategy, documentation, quality and maintainability, while contributing to the broader data architecture and innovation - Mentoring and collaborating: coaching BTT data team members towards stronger Snowflake competence, collaborating with BI analysts, analytics engineers and business stakeholders, and translating business needs into practical data solutions - Building solutions: designing, building and optimizing scalable dbt-based data pipelines, transformations and logical and physical data models



Who are we looking for?

We are looking for an experienced data engineer who enjoys hands-on building but also thinks about the bigger picture, and who genuinely wants to help others grow.

We are not looking for unicorns, but the more of below capabilities are found the better youd fit to the ideal candidate profile:
- Snowflake, dbt and SQL: strong hands-on experience in data engineering with Snowflake, proficiency with dbt for transformations, efficient SQL skills and solid data modelling capability. (This one is actually mandatory) - Modern engineering practices: experience with version control, CI/CD pipelines and a DevOps mindset in a data context; what we develop, we also support. - Background in data warehousing/ETL: You have designed or maintained data pipelines with different technologies. Experience with SAP BW data models and transformations is beneficial, as it helps in understanding our legacy environment. - Data management mindset: Familiarity with data cataloging, lineage tools, semantic views, or overall data governance frameworks. You care about documentation and data quality. - Big picture view: the ability to make sound technical choices across source data, data modelling, transformations and reporting needs, not just build individual pipelines. - Mentoring ability: experience and motivation in sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues and contributing to the development of data engineering practices - AI mindset: interest in leveraging AI to speed up and improve development and maintenance processes - Communication: excellent teamwork and communication skills, and the ability to explain complex data topics to both technical and non-technical colleagues. Fluency in English is required (our working language). Finnish or other Nordic language skills are beneficial but not necessary. - Self-driven and proactive attitude: You take initiative to improve things and arent afraid to suggest new ideas. You are solution-oriented and able to work independently when needed, but also know when to ask for help or input. - Relevant experience with SAP, Aspect4 or web-based business application data as well as familiarity with chain-operated wholesale and/or merchant-led retail business models, especially in the building and technical trade sector










Please note that the role is in Finland and you will need the existing right to work here. Kesko is unable to sponsor work permits or visas.

Why join us?

We offer you the chance to work in a key role, building a modern data platform in a large and diverse organization. Rather than stepping into a fully established environment, you'll have a rare opportunity to help define the development standards, modelling principles and engineering practices that will shape how BTT utilizes Keskos Snowflake platform.

With us you get:
- a genuinely impactful, hands-on role in building our Snowflake data platform from the ground up - a supportive community of expert colleagues in both BTT and Keskos central data teams - the opportunity to influence the technical direction, best practices and ways of working of our future data platform - modern work tools and numerous opportunities to learn, develop and grow your career in a large, international organization - extensive K Group employee benefits, including a mobile-phone benefit, culture, well-being and sports benefit (ePassi Flex), staff discounts in K Group stores, own occupational health care, leisure-time accident insurance, and a car benefit according to our company policy. - partner benefits related to optical stores, accommodation and travel, as well as sports and wellbeing services - a flexible hybrid working model with at least one office day per week

jobs.title: Industrielektriker søges til stærkt team i Vestjylland
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde med installationsopgaver hos nogle af Danmarks største industrivirksomheder? Og sætter du en ære i at levere solidt håndværk, hvor kvalitet og samarbejde er i fokus? Så kan du blive en del af vores voksende industriafdeling hos Viftrup Jespersen A/S.

Et arbejde med mening og ansvar

Vi har travlt og udvider derfor teamet i vores industriafdeling. Her arbejder vi tæt sammen med store fødevareproducenter og leverer tekniske løsninger, der holder produktionen i gang. Det kræver faglighed og ansvarlighed – og det er netop dét, vi leder efter.

Du får din daglige base i Videbæk og bliver en del af et stærkt hold, hvor samarbejde, ordentlighed og godt håndværk går hånd i hånd. Dine opgaver vil primært være hos én af vores største industrikunder.

”Hos os får du mere indflydelse på dine opgaver og en tættere relation til både kolleger og ledelse, end du finder mange andre steder.”
– Anders Elkjær, ejer

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som en del af industriafdelingen vil du arbejde med:

  • Installation og montage af el-tekniske løsninger

  • Opsætning af føringsveje og kabelføring

  • Automationsopgaver og mindre styretavlearbejde

  • Servicering og vedligehold af installationer

  • Deltagelse i både projekter og løbende drift

Du vil samarbejde med både vores egne teknikere og kundens projektledere. Vi sørger for grundig oplæring og introduktion til opgaver og arbejdsgange.

Faglig udvikling og et stærkt fællesskab

Hos os er der plads til at udvikle sig. Vi starter dig op med mindre opgaver og bygger gradvist på, i takt med at du bliver fortrolig med arbejdsgangene. Har du ambitioner, støtter vi gerne op med relevante kurser og efteruddannelse.

Vi er et team, der hjælper hinanden – både fagligt og socialt. Vores personaleforening arrangerer jævnligt aktiviteter, og vi prioriterer et arbejdsmiljø, hvor alle trives.

Hvad vi forventer af dig

Vi leder efter en kollega, som:

  • er fagligt stærk og arbejder med kvalitet og struktur

  • er mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • har lyst til at samarbejde og tage ejerskab i opgaverne

Du har sandsynligvis en baggrund som elektriker, industrielektriker eller automatiktekniker – og gerne erfaring med industriinstallationer.

Det får du hos os

Udover spændende opgaver og et godt fællesskab tilbyder vi:

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

  • Fastansættelse i en stabil virksomhed

  • Overenskomst, pension og sundhedsforsikring

  • Lokale goder som fx rabat på fitness og svømmehal

  • Mulighed for efteruddannelse

 

Interesseret?

Er du klar til at tage ansvar for, at vi lever op til vores kunders høje forventninger? Så send CV og ansøgning til Jette på jcl@viftrup.dk Vi vurderer kandidater og indkalder til samtaler løbende. Vi ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vil du vide mere om dit nye job, så er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os på jcl@viftrup.dk eller 51200268.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Salgsassistent til Imerco Vordingborg - deltid
jobs.description:
Kunne du tænke dig at blive en del af Danmarks største kæde indenfor køkken, gaver og bord?

Hos Imerco Vordingborg bliver du en del af et team, som engagerer sig for at skabe gode og mindeværdige oplevelser for vores kunder.

Har du appetit på Imerco?

Så tilbyder vi dig en stilling som salgsassistent hvor du: 

  • Får en uforudsigelig hverdag med masser af udfordringer
  • Bliver en del af et ambitiøst og fagligt stærkt team
  • Skal sælge nogle af Danmarks stærkeste brands.

Din hverdag som salgsassistent:

Som salgsassistent i Imerco Vordingborg bliver det din opgave, at henvende dig til vores kunder og yde en førsteklasses service, hvor du rådgiver dem om vores produkter, så de forlader butikken med en god oplevelse – og alle de relevante produkter.
