jobs.title: Kitchen workers to a catering company close to Copenhagen Airport
jobs.description:
Kitchen worker - Copenhagen

Mission

Summary:

This individual works in the Production department performing a variety of possible tasks that involve everything with salads, fruits, vegetables, sandwiches, desserts, and other food items that require to be in cold temperatures to remain fresh. This may entail preparing and setting up the airline trays with the appropriate sandwiches, fruits, salads, etc. This person may also be involved with slicing and cutting fruits, vegetables, and other foods. Although the individual may not do all the responsibilities mentioned below, employees must be willing and able to perform the tasks below as assignments change frequently and without notice.

Essential tasks:

· Load carts and trolleys with platters, dishes, utensils, and containers.

· Collect serving trays and arrange plates in trays by following the instructions and guidelines.

· When loading trays into the trolleys, ensure they are placed appropriately within the frame of the rack.

· Assist in setting up and packaging special meals and ingredients.

· Complete defined packaging schedule as assigned by supervisor or manager.

· Edit and organize labels outside and inside for the scheduled production of the day.

· Perform proper food packaging and storing based on safety requirements and customer's instructions.

· Tag every rack, tray, and trolley according to company's standards and processes.

· Ensure that left-over ingredients and packaging material are properly labeled and returned in the dry storage,        cooler or packaging material storage.

· Follow all process control documentation.

· Bring trays and packaging material from the warehouse and waiting area.

· Ensure proper and timely recording of activities.

· Report any unsanitary practice and/or unsafe condition.

· Make sure trolleys are properly identified, secured and moved away from chemicals and hazardous substances.

· Follow all food safety, health and safety, company rules and standards.

· Regular and timely attendance is expected for the position.

· Perform other duties as assigned.

Education/experience requirements: 

· No experience required, but any experience in fast-paced environments is helpful.

Qualifications:

·          Must be comfortable working in a cold environment – occasionally.

·          Ability to read and follow specifications and instructions in English

·          Ability to work quickly and safely

·          Ability to show flexibility in working in various areas of the department

·          Ability to know how one's performance affects the areas before and after you

·          Ability to read and speak to understand instructions from supervisors and co-workers.

·          Speak Danish or English

·          Be a Danish or Swedish residence (mandatory).

Physical environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential responsibilities of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential responsibilities.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be exposed to occasionally cold temperature environment. The individual is required to stand or walk for the entire shift (there are breaks however).

Working hours and others:

This is a full-time position, but the specific weekly working hours depend on the shift. You will have to work weekends. You must have permission to work in Denmark and be able to complete a security check, which among other things, require a clean criminal record.

We are located in Dragør, next to Copenhagen Airport.

If you have any questions, please contact Deputy Production Manager Morten Degn on m.degn@newrest.eu

If you haven't heard from us no later than 14 days after applying, we have moved on with other candidates.

jobs.description:
Tehtäväsi

Mäntymäen perhetukikeskuksen johtajana vastaat perhetukikeskuksen toiminnasta, sen kehittämisestä ja henkilöstöjohtamisesta.

Mäntymäen perhetukikeskus on Turussa sijaitseva 18-paikkainen vastaanottoyksikkö kiireellisesti tai avohuollon tukitoimena sijoitetuille lapsille. Johdettavanasi työskentelee moniammatillinen henkilöstö, johon kuuluu 26 perhetukikeskuksen ohjaajaa, 3 vastaavaa ohjaajaa, 3 perheohjaajaa, sairaanhoitaja, 2 kokkia sekä 0,5 laitoshuoltajaa.

Tehtävässäsi vastaat toiminnan laadukkaasta johtamisesta ja kehittämisestä sekä henkilöstön arviointi- ja vastaanottotyöskentelyn ohjaamisesta. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä lasten, perheiden ja heidän verkostojensa kanssa sekä varmistat toiminnan sujuvuuden myös vaativissa ja haastavissa tilanteissa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle vastuullisen ja vaikuttavan johtamistehtävän lastensuojelun keskeisessä palvelussa.

Pääset työssäsi hyödyntämään osaamistasi sekä kehittämään vastaanottotyötä ja palveluja yhdessä osaavan moniammatillisen henkilöstön kanssa. Tehtävä tarjoaa mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa sekä yksikön toimintaan että lasten ja perheiden saaman tuen laatuun.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Odotamme sinulta vahvaa kokemusta lastensuojelun laitoshuollosta sekä johtamisesta. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää kehittämismyönteistä työotetta, hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä kykyä johtaa henkilöstön arviointi- ja vastaanottotyöskentelyä lasten, perheiden ja heidän verkostojensa kanssa myös haastavissa tilanteissa.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on ylempi korkeakoulututkinto sekä kokemus alan johtamisesta ja kehittämisestä.

Lisäksi edellytämme hyvää suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa sekä tyydyttävää suullista ja kirjallista ruotsin kielen taitoa.

Jos haluat yhdistää vahvan lastensuojelun osaamisen, henkilöstöjohtamisen ja toiminnan kehittämisen merkityksellisessä tehtävässä, odotamme hakemustasi.

jobs.title: (Senior) Solution Architect
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Do you want to design and evolve modern organisation-wide architecture that enables investments, from climate and health to food systems worldwide? And are you ready to take a pivotal role in one of the most ambitious digital transformations in Danish development finance?

At Impact Fund Denmark, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh.

Here is what you get with us:

  • A leading role in shaping our holistic organisation‑wide solution architecture

  • Collaboration with highly skilled IT professionals in a friendly and inclusive culture

  • Access to the full suite of Microsoft enterprise tools in a modern and tech-driven environment

Global impact, strong IT culture and meaningful teamwork

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark’s development finance institution, investing in sustainable solutions that create measurable impact in developing countries. While headquartered in Copenhagen, our work extends across more than 45 countries, supported by six regional offices and unite 24 nationalities under one purpose.

You will be part of the Technology & Operations team, which is expanding to 26 professionals, including specialists in processes, architecture, data, and IT Security. Here, you will join a team of experienced and collaborative professionals who are eager to share knowledge and support each other across disciplines.

You shape our digital backbone and architectural direction

We are looking for an Solution Architect, to take the lead in designing, maintaining, and governing the company wide architecture that underpins our global impact. You ensure coherence across platforms, promote future‑ready solutions, and translate business needs into secure, scalable, and well‑governed technologies. Along the way, you will work closely with our subject matter experts, and various business stakeholders.

You will, for example:

  • Design and maintain the end‑to‑end organisation-wide architecture for our technology stack, which includes Dynamics 365 CE and F&O, Power Platform, Fabric, Copilot and related SaaS systems.

  • Co-own and enforce best practices for deployment, release management, and technical documentation

  • Define and create Architecture Principles for our entire technology stack e.g. integration principles and patterns that govern how applications and data interconnect

  • Drive a forward‑looking technology perspective, monitoring trends and identifying improvements

  • Drive technology selection to evaluate and assess new applications or technology requests to improve our internal value generation and efficiency.

You bring technical insights and architectural understanding

With your background in architectural areas like, Solution Architecture, application/system architecture, Software Architecture or transferable roles), you understand how to turn technical complexity into structured, long-term solutions.

We imagine that you:

  • Hold a relevant degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field

  • Have strong experience with solution architecture and how applications and platforms integrate

  • Understand IT governance, data protection, and compliance

  • Communicate clearly with both engineers and business stakeholders

  • Desirably have experience from the financial sector

Our current technology stack is among others based:

  • Dynamics CE

  • Dynamics F&O

  • M365

  • Microsoft Fabric

  • Microsoft Dataverse

  • and several fit for purpose SaaS solutions/applications

Ready to build the digital foundation for global impact?

As part of the recruitment process, we need your targeted CV, preferably with a brief motivational statement at the top. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so do not wait too long to apply.

CVs not submitted via the platform will not be considered. The start date is as soon as possible, but we are ready to wait for the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark.

jobs.title: Iltapäiväkerhotoiminnan ohjaaja
jobs.description:
Huvikumpu ry hakee innokasta ja motivoitunutta iltapäivätoiminnan ohjaajaa täydentämään reipashenkistä ja aurinkoista työtiimiä. Huvikumpu ry järjestää perusopetuksen iltapäivätoimintaa Porvoon keskuskoululla.

Meille mieluisa työkaveri olisi positiivinen ja oma-aloitteinen. Odotamme, että kollegamme on motivoitunut ohjaamaan lapsia monipuolisesti mm. erilaisten kädentaitojen, retkien ja liikunnan parissa. Järjestämme lapsille mielekästä ohjattua toimintaa päivittäin, mutta toki jätämme tilaa myös leikille sekä vapaalle ulkoilulle. Työ on hyvin monipuolista ja antoisaa, varaamme laadun takaamiseksi myös aikaa suunnitteluun mm. kuukausipalavereiden ja tiimipalavereiden muodossa. Yksikön vahvana tukena toimii koordinaattori sekä kaksi palveluntuottajaa.

Ohjaajan tehtävänä on mm. koululaisten iltapäivätoiminnan suunnittelu, toteutus ja ohjaus yhdessä muun työtiimin kanssa. Tehtäviin kuuluu myös yhteydenpito sekä yhteistyö niin kouluun kuin vanhempiinkin. Noudatamme kerhoissamme teema-kuukaudet ajattelua sekä viikko-ohjelmaa, näin takaamme mielekästä ja vaihtelevaa ohjelmaa lapsille. Tärkeä osa laadukasta iltapäivätoimintaamme on ns. maksuton kerhotoiminta, jota suunnittelemme ja toteutamme perheiden ja lasten toiveiden pohjalta.

Huvikummussa on käytössä perehdytyskansio, jonka avulla uusien työntekijöiden on helppo ja mukava aloittaa työt. Työntekijöistämme pitää huolta Terveystalo ja henkilökuntaamme koulutamme vähintään kaksi kertaa vuodessa pidetyissä koulutuspäivissä. Lisäksi järjestämme työyhteisön virkistyspäiviä muutaman kerran vuodessa, hyvinvoiva työyhteisö on meille sydämen asia.

Työhön sopiva koulutus/ tutkinto voisi olla esim. liikuntaneuvoja, liikunnanohjaaja AMK, aamu- ja iltapäivätoiminnan ohjaaja, artenomi, lähihoitaja, sosionomi, nuoriso- ja vapaa-ajanohjaaja. Katsomme eduksi myös erityisen tuen oppilaiden kanssa työskentelyn taidon. Tehtävään valitun tulee esittää lasten kanssa työskenteleviltä vaadittava rikosrekisteriote.

Jos olet innokas kuulemaan lisää, niin ota rohkeasti yhteyttä! Juuri sinä voit olla meidän uusi työkaverimme.

Hakemuksen ja CV:n voi jättää osoitteeseen: palveluntuottajat@huvikumpury.fi

jobs.title: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg
jobs.description:
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen
• Can handle prep, mise en place and service in a structured way
• Have experience with à la carte service
• Care about quality, teamwork and consistency
• Thrive in a busy restaurant environment
• Can work independently and take responsibility during service

We offer:
• Full-time employment
• A fixed work schedule

• Salary of approximately DKK 30,000–35,000 gross per month, depending on qualifications and experience
• Five weeks of paid holiday
• Company apartment / accommodation available
• Help with relocation and settling in Denmark
• Possibility of support with moving costs and/or paid accommodation in the first month, by agreement
• Good working conditions in a structured and professional environment
• Staff meals

• Staff discounts
• A stable, established restaurant with a proven concept and an organised kitchen
• The freedom to develop your own ideas and contribute to the menu
• A workplace where English can be used in daily communication

Location
The position is based in Kalundborg, Denmark, in the heart of the city's main pedestrian street. Kalundborg offers a local Danish atmosphere, a charming town centre and a good quality of life.

Language
English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

jobs.title: Strategy & Business Development Analyst
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by turning analysis into strategic decisions and supporting products that mobilise capital for impact? 

 

The job

As an Analyst in Strategy & Business Development (S&BD) at Impact Fund Denmark, you will support strategy implementation and management-initiated projects through structured analysis, research and preparation of high-quality presentation material. In parallel, you will facilitate Impact Fund Denmark’s collaboration with our owner, the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Support strategy implementation initiatives through analyses, presentations and structured decision material for senior leadership. 

  • Produce insights and fact-based recommendations based on research and analysis. 

  • Facilitate good collaboration with the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs by producing meeting materials, and supporting development of new public investment mandates.

  • Support Impact Fund Denmark’s work on stakeholder relations by facilitating internal coordination, producing relevant insights and analysis, and engaging directly with stakeholders.

  • Run and support internal projects in Strategy and Business Development and across the organisation.

 

The team

 

You will join the Strategy & Business Development team and work closely with colleagues in across the organisation. The S&BD team supports senior leadership with strategy development, implementation of priority initiatives, corporate planning and preparation of fact-based decision material.

 

Your qualifications & experience

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated strong analytical capabilities and a structured approach to problem solving. 

  • A relevant Master’s degree with strong academic results. 

  • 1 to 2 years of full-time work experience from relevant positions (e.g. strategy, analytics, consulting, investing or corporate finance)

  • Strong analytical and problem-structuring skills, with the ability to translate analysis into clear messages and presentations. 

  • Strong PowerPoint skills and solid Excel skills. 

  • Fluency in English, written and spoken. 

  • Ability to read and write in Danish in an advantage.

  • A collaborative mindset and motivation to work across strategy, product development and investor relations. 

 

Working and learning at Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark’s learning culture provides the tools and organisation for individual development. Learning is an important element of working in Impact Fund Denmark, and we will support your personal development through training, sparring and by ensuring that you get exciting and challenging tasks and new opportunities for growth. When joining Impact Fund Denmark, you will take part in our extensive onboarding program to get the best possible start in your new role.

Impact Fund Denmark offers a hybrid workplace, allowing you to manage your own time effectively. We have a diverse and inclusive working environment with more than 150 talented individuals from 20+ different nationalities. We work seamlessly together with colleagues around the corner, cross the organization and between offices in Asia, Africa, LATAM and Europe.

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at www.impactfund.dk.

jobs.title: Inhoppare som kock inom äldreomsorgen
jobs.description:
Vill du ha ett givande och trivsamt jobb där du bidrar till att matgäster serveras god, vällagad och näringsrik sammansatt kost? Serviceboendet Sveagården med heldygnsomsorg inom äldreomsorgen i Lemlands kommun söker dig som vill arbeta som kock med kortare vikariat/inhopp. Stor möjlighet finns för längre vikariat på grund av föräldraledighet.

**Din roll hos oss** Som kock deltar du i måltidsplaneringen och ser till att måltiderna följer kostpolicyn för de äldre i Lemlands kommun. Tillsammans med ansvarig kock tillagar ni måltider för de boende på Sveagården samt lunch för pensionärer och andra vårdbehövande i kommunen.

Du delar ansvar med ansvarig kock gällande att hygienkraven följs.

**Din profil** Vi söker dig som har en gymnasialutbildning inom branschen, samt hygienpass. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av liknande arbete.

Vi förutsätter att kost och matlagning ligger dig varmt om hjärtat och du delar uppfattningen att måltiden är en viktig del av vardagen. Du är van att ta egna initiativ och arbetar på ett strukturerat sätt. Som person är du engagerad, flexibel och har god samarbetsförmåga.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och lämplighet.

**Vår rekryteringsprocess** Lemlands kommun rekryterar fördomsfritt och objektivt. Intervjuer kan komma ske löpande under ansökningstiden.

**Om vår kommun** Lemlands kommun är en mellanstor kommun ur ett åländskt perspektiv, men en liten kommun i ett större omvärldsperspektiv. Här finns det utrymme för att både vara liten och stor på samma gång. Lemlands kommun ger service till kommuninvånarna inom allt från barnomsorg till vattenledningsnät. Av kommunens ca 120 anställda arbetar ungefär 10 % med administration, medan de flesta arbetar med service nära kommuninvånarna inom barnomsorg, skola, äldreomsorg, bibliotek och fritidsverksamhet.

Hos oss erbjuds du en trivsam arbetsmiljö med varierande arbetsuppgifter.

För mera information om arbetet, vänligen kontakta Ledande vårdare Andréa Mattsson, +358 (0)18 34228 eller andrea.mattsson@lemland.ax.

Skicka ansökan till:

Vi ser fram emot att få din ansökan med personligt brev samt CV. Ansökan skickas via länken https://e-tjanster.ax/e-form/sv/8c1a47cae1, senast 13 oktober 2026. Alternativt via e-post: aldreomsorgen@lemland.ax eller via postadress: Lemlands kommun, Kommunrundan 7, 22610 Lemland

jobs.description:
Dansk version længere nede

Den Gamle Bagergaard in Maribo is looking for a baker. You do not need a formal qualification if you have practical experience working in a bakery.

We are a family-run business with three bakers and a pastry chef in production. Two packing staff and a driver help get our bread ready and delivered to our shops.

Your work

You will take part in the daily production at the bakery. We are looking for someone who knows their way around a bakery, takes responsibility for their work and enjoys working with colleagues. You must be able to communicate in Danish or understandable English.

You must already have the legal right to work in Denmark, for example through EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship or a valid Danish residence and work permit. We cannot offer visa or work permit sponsorship.

What we offer

  • Gross monthly salary: Based on qualifications and experience. For a qualified baker, the salary starts at approximately DKK 26,000.

  • Permanent, full-time employment

  • Pension scheme

  • 5 weeks of vacation

  • Flexible benefits account

  • Additional pay for applicable night and Sunday work

  • The employer can support you in finding accommodation in the area

The planned working hours start at 01:30 on Mondays and 05:00 from Tuesday to Thursday. You will also work every other weekend. During the night shifts on Mondays and every other weekend, you will bake bread, Danish pastries and other baked goods. We will agree on the schedule together, and working night shifts only is also an option.

The expected start date is 1 November 2026.

Recruitment process

The first interview can be held online if needed. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the bakery before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications as they arrive, so please apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your application and CV to rekruttering@lolland.dk with “Baker – Maribo” in the subject line.

If you have questions, contact Martin Hansen, Business Consultant and EURES Adviser at Lolland Municipality, on +45 21 47 73 43 or maha@lolland.dk.

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and relocation support

Lolland is in southern Denmark and offers easy access to nature, beaches and open countryside, along with affordable housing and short commuting distances. The region is developing rapidly, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link between Denmark and Germany.

If you are moving from abroad, Lolland Municipality’s Newcomers Service can help with practical questions about relocation, registration, housing, a partner’s job search and settling in Denmark. Read more at newcomers.lolland.dk. You can also find information about working in Denmark at workindenmark.dk.

Den Gamle Bagergaard i Maribo søger en bager. Du behøver ikke at have svendebrev, hvis du har praktisk erfaring fra et bageri.

Vi er en familievirksomhed med tre bagere og en konditor i produktionen. Derudover har vi to pakkere og en chauffør, som kører brød ud til vores udsalg.

Jobbet

Du bliver en del af den daglige produktion i bageriet. Vi søger dig, der kender arbejdet i et bageri, tager ansvar for dine opgaver og trives med at arbejde sammen med andre. Du skal kunne kommunikere på dansk eller forståeligt engelsk.

Det tilbyder vi

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling

  • Pension, feriepenge og fritvalgskonto

  • Relevante tillæg for nat- og søndagsarbejde

  • Hjælp til at finde en bolig i området, hvis du skal flytte hertil

Arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt fra kl. 01.30 om mandagen og kl. 05.00 tirsdag til torsdag samt hver anden weekend. Når du møder ind om natten, bager du blandt andet brød og wienerbrød. Vi aftaler den nærmere plan sammen, og det er også muligt kun at arbejde om natten.

Forventet start er 1. november 2026.

Den første samtale kan holdes online, hvis der er behov for det. Vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Søg jobbet

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til rekruttering@lolland.dk, og skriv “Bager – Maribo” i emnefeltet.

Har du spørgsmål, kan du kontakte virksomhedskonsulent Martin Hansen på 21 47 73 43 eller maha@lolland.dk.

jobs.title: Palomies, kesätyö ja muut sijaisuudet, Länsi-Uudenmaan pelastuslaitos
jobs.description:
Palomies, tervetuloa joukkoomme Länsi-Uudenmaan pelastuslaitokselle!

Palomiehen tehtäviin kuuluu osallistuminen pelastustoimintaan, ensihoitopalvelujen tuottamiseen sekä onnettomuuksien ehkäisytyöhön. Onnettomuuksien ehkäisyyn liittyvät tehtävät sisältävät muun muassa turvallisuusviestintää sekä neuvonta- ja valistustehtäviä.

Tarjoamme käyttöösi nykyaikaiset henkilökohtaiset suojavarusteet sekä modernin pelastuskaluston. Panostamme henkilöstömme osaamisen jatkuvaan kehittämiseen ja tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia erikoistua erilaisiin tehtäviin, kuten pelastussukeltajaksi tai venemieheksi.

Länsi-Uudenmaan pelastuslaitoksella henkilöstön työhyvinvointia ja ammatillista kehittymistä tuetaan suunnitelmallisesti. Esihenkilöitä koulutetaan jatkuvasti, jotta henkilöstöllä on käytettävissään laadukas tuki päivittäisessä työssään. Lisäksi alueellemme rakennetaan uusia paloasemia, mikä vahvistaa palvelutuotantoa ja tarjoaa monipuolisia työskentelymahdollisuuksia eri puolilla Länsi-Uuttamaata.

Pelastajatutkintoa suorittavien hakijoiden osalta palvelussuhteen edellytykset arvioidaan tapauskohtaisesti. Tällä hakemuksella voit hakea sekä kesän vuosilomasijaisuuksiin että muihin määräaikaisiin palomiehen tehtäviin. Ilmoitathan hakemuksessasi minkä pituisesta sijaisuudesta olet kiinnostunut ja sen ajankohdasta.

Länsi-Uudenmaan pelastuslaitos tarjoaa mahdollisuuden työskennellä vaativissa ja merkityksellisissä tehtävissä osana ammattitaitoista ja kehittyvää työyhteisöä

Työpaikan nimi ja osoite: Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue / Länsi-Uudenmaan pelastuslaitos, Palomiehentie 1, 02750 Espoo

Työaika: Poikkeusluvan mukainen vuorokausirytmi, 42 tuntia viikossa.

Tehtävät ovat määräaikaisia. Aloitusajankohta sovitaan erikseen.

Kelpoisuusvaatimukset: Päätoimiselta pelastustoimintaan osallistuvalta miehistöltä vaadittava kelpoisuus.

Tehtävässä edellytetään:
- tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa.
- että hakija antaa pyydettäessä luvan turvallisuusselvityslain (726/2014) mukaisen henkilöturvallisuusselvityksen ja päihdeohjelman mukaisen huumausainetestin tekemiseen.
- BC-luokan ajokorttia.

Arvostamme: Laaja-alaista osaamista, niin pelastustoimesta kuin muilta aloilta ja kokemusta perustason ensihoitajana toimimisesta sekä ruotsin kielentaitoa. Ikään suhteutettu erinomainen fyysinen suorituskyky katsotaan eduksi.

Kiinnostuitko? Odotamme innoissamme hakemustasi! Jätäthän sen Kuntarekryn hakuportaalin kautta.

Olemme muutoksen tekijöitä. Uudistamme rohkeasti sen, mikä kaipaa parannusta, ja säilytämme sen, mikä toimii. Panostamme jokaisen työntekijämme hyvinvointiin ja haluamme tarjota monipuolisia etuja henkilöstöllemme. Tarjoamme lounasedun ja saat käyttöösi vuodessa 300 €, jonka voit käyttää toiveidesi mukaan kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi-, liikunta- tai matkalippuetuuksiin. Lisäksi pääset kehittämään omaa osaamistasi Eduhousen ja Oppiportin laajojen verkkokoulutusten avulla.

jobs.title: Financial Accountant (m/w, 80–100%)
jobs.description:
IN KÜRZE

Du begeisterst dich für Zahlen, legst Wert auf Präzision und möchtest aktiv das Wachstum von FELFEL mitgestalten? Als Financial Accountant (80–100%, ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung) in Zürich Wiedikon übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle in unserem agilen Finance Team. Hier formst du nicht nur Zahlen, sondern gestaltest gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft unseres Unternehmens.


DEINE VERANTWORTUNGEN

  • Führe das Tagesgeschäft inklusive Haupt- und Nebenbücher (Debitoren, Kreditoren, Bank- und Zahlungsabstimmungen) für unsere Schweizer Gesellschaft und unterstütze das Tagesgeschäft unserer US-Gesellschaft.
  • Erstelle Verrechnungen an Kunden und wirke bei Monats-, Jahres- und Konzernabschlüssen nach Schweizer Recht mit.
  • Pflege und optimiere unser ERP-System (Abacus / Microsoft Dynamics BC), um dessen kontinuierliche Skalierbarkeit sicherzustellen.
  • Agiere als Ansprechperson für interne sowie externe Stakeholder bei Fragen zur Rechnungsstellung und Kreditorenbuchhaltung.
  • Wirke an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Finanzprozesse mit.
  • Steuere die Kommunikation als Schnittstelle zu externen Partnern wie ERP-Support, Behörden und Lieferanten.
  • Unterstütze bei der Erstellung von MWST-Abrechnungen, Sales and Use Tax Meldungen für unsere US-Gesellschaft sowie bei der jährlichen Steuererklärung.


WAS DU MITBRINGST

  • 2–4 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen in einem ähnlichen Umfeld.
  • Abschluss als Eidg. Finanzfachmann/frau im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen (oder aktuell in entsprechender Ausbildung).
  • Sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse sowie Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen (Abacus / Microsoft Dynamics BC von Vorteil).
  • Leidenschaft für Zahlen, Strukturen und Prozesse in einem agilen Umfeld.
  • Selbstständige, exakte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise.
  • Ausgeprägter Teamgeist und Fähigkeit, mit internen sowie externen Partnern professionell zu kommunizieren.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Nichtraucher:in – wir möchten nicht, dass du nach Zigaretten riechst, weder bei der Arbeit noch bei Kundenterminen. Schliesslich dreht sich bei FELFEL alles um gutes Essen.
  • Gültige Arbeitsbewilligung für die Schweiz oder Schweizer Pass.


WAS WIR BIETEN

  • Jede Menge leckeres Essen, nur wenige Schritte von deinem Schreibtisch entfernt - wir erfüllen all deine kulinarischen Wünsche...
  • Bester Barista-Kaffee und Tee für das ganze Team dank unserer innovativen Gavetti Kaffeemaschine
  • 5 Wochen Urlaub pro Jahr
  • Pro Jahr gewähren wir zwei ganze Wochen "Work from anywhere" und sorgen damit für Abwechslung im Arbeitsalltag
  • Wir finanzieren dein Halbtax-Abo, und unterstützen so unsere Mitarbeitenden bei der Nutzung des ÖV
  • Frisch gebackene Eltern erhalten von uns 16 bzw. 3 Wochen voll bezahlte Elternzeit. Wir unterstützen zudem die Rückkehr in den Beruf, indem wir einen grosszügigen finanziellen Beitrag an die Kinderbetreuung bis zum Erreichen des Kindergartenalters leisten
  • Tolle Team-Events, wie z.B. unsere bekannten FELFEL Summer-Outings
Klingt das nach dem perfekten Job für dich? Wir können es kaum erwarten, mehr über dich zu erfahren! BEWIRB DICH JETZT mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen auf Deutsch oder Englisch.

jobs.description: Per conto di una realtà tecnologica di grandi dimensioni, operante in un contesto internazionale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Cyber Security Engineer da inserire all'interno di un team Cyber Security strutturato. La risorsa entrerà a far parte di una funzione tecnica che opera trasversalmente a supporto delle diverse aree IT, Software e Business del Gruppo, contribuendo alla progettazione, evoluzione e miglioramento dei servizi e dei controlli di Cyber Security. Cerchiamo un professionista con una buona seniority tecnica e una visione trasversale della sicurezza, capace di andare oltre la gestione operativa degli incidenti e contribuire all'evoluzione dell'ecosistema Cyber aziendale. Principali responsabilità La persona sarà coinvolta in attività quali: supporto a nuovi progetti IT e Software secondo principi di Security by Design, attraverso security review e definizione dei requisiti di sicurezza; definizione ed evoluzione dei controlli di Cloud Security, principalmente in ambienti Microsoft Azure e AWS; presidio delle tematiche di Identity Security, con particolare riferimento a Microsoft Entra ID e Active Directory; valutazione e scouting di nuove tecnologie e servizi messi a disposizione dai principali cloud e security provider; evoluzione dei servizi di Cyber Security Monitoring, collaborando con il SOC esterno e contribuendo al tuning delle piattaforme SIEM e dei relativi controlli di detection; attività di Vulnerability Management su componenti infrastrutturali e applicative; evoluzione dei presidi di sicurezza relativi a Firewall, WAF, endpoint, infrastrutture e ambienti Cloud; supporto ad attività di Incident Response e miglioramento continuo dei relativi processi e controlli; partecipazione alla definizione di iniziative di Purple Teaming, finalizzate all'identificazione delle aree di miglioramento della postura difensiva; confronto con Software Architect, Service Manager, team IT e Business per integrare i requisiti Cyber all'interno di nuovi servizi e applicazioni; supporto, quando necessario, nel confronto con clienti enterprise sui presidi di sicurezza adottati nei servizi erogati. Profilo ricercato Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in ambito Cyber Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security o Security Architecture, maturata in contesti aziendali strutturati o all'interno di società di consulenza tecnologica. Non è necessario aver maturato esperienza approfondita in tutte le aree indicate. Sarà particolarmente interessante una solida competenza in una o più delle seguenti: Cloud Security in ambienti Azure e/o AWS; Identity & Access Security, Entra ID / Active Directory; Security Engineering e definizione di security controls; Cyber Security Monitoring e tecnologie SIEM/XDR; Vulnerability Management; Infrastructure & Network Security; Application Security / Security by Design. Saranno considerate un plus esperienze in ambito Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Security, Incident Response, Purple Teaming e attività di security assessment. È richiesta una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Offerta RAL indicativa: €50.000 - €60.000 + MBO, valutabile in funzione dell'esperienza; inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato; modalità di lavoro ibrida con 2 giorni alla settimana in presenza a Bologna; #LI-AM2

jobs.title: Applied Scientist, SCOT FO Science and Tech (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

Applied Scientist, SCOT FO Science and Tech
Job ID: 10522151 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

How does Amazon decide which fulfillment center ships your order, which truck carries it, and how to keep promise, across hundreds of millions of packages daily? SCOT Fulfillment Optimization (FO) owns the science behind these decisions. We are seeking Applied Scientists to join the FO Science & Tech team in Luxembourg (alternatively: Barcelona, or London). You will design and build optimization models that power Amazon's fulfillment decisions at scale from real-time order assignment and multi-objective cost-speed tradeoffs to capacity-aware control systems that steer millions of shipments per hour toward operational plans.

Basic qualifications

• PhD in Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience)
• Strong programming skills (Python preferred; experience with optimization solvers a plus)
• Research experience in one or more:
• Large-scale mathematical programming (LP, MIP, decomposition methods)
• Combinatorial optimization (assignment, scheduling, network flows)
• Multi-objective optimization and control

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building optimization systems that run in production at scale
• Being comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration cycles
• Publications in relevant venues

Key job responsibilities

Design and implement optimization models (MIP, heuristics, decomposition) that solve large-scale fulfillment problems, from order assignment to network flow control. Build research prototypes end-to-end: from problem formulation through scalable implementation to production validation. Analyse complex tradeoffs (cost, speed, capacity) and translate findings into actionable recommendations for leadership and operations teams. Collaborate with engineers to bring science solutions into production systems serving millions of customer orders daily.

A day in the life

You formulate an optimization problem on a whiteboard with teammates, then prototype it in Python with real data by the afternoon. You run experiments against production-scale datasets, iterate on the model, and present results to stakeholders who will use them to make network decisions next week. Some days you dive deep into solver performance; other days you're explaining a Pareto frontier to an operations leader. You collaborate with large engineering and product teams to bring your solutions into systems serving millions of customers. Alongside fast-turnaround prototypes, you own long-term research bets, the kind that reshape how Amazon's fulfillment network operates at scale. Your work goes live.

About the team

SCOT Fulfillment Optimization Science & Tech (FO SnT) is the applied research team behind Amazon's fulfillment decision-making systems. We decide how orders get assigned to warehouses, how capacity is allocated across the network, and how cost and speed tradeoffs are managed in real time, at global scale. Our models influence billions of euros in annual operational spend. They protect sites from overload during peak, reduce transportation costs and CO2 emissions, and ensure customers receive their packages when promised. Leadership relies on our science to make investment decisions worth hundreds of millions. We are practitioners of large-scale optimization: MIP formulations, decomposition methods, approximation algorithms, and parallelisation. We use machine learning where it sharpens our decisions, including forecasting, learned heuristics, and multi-armed bandits. We pick the right tool for the problem, not the fashionable one. You will work alongside Senior and Principal scientists, and collaborate with Amazon Scholars and academic partners who bring frontier research into our applied problems. We code our prototypes to be production-ready and collaborate with large engineering teams to ship systems, not papers. Above all, we have fun solving hard real-world problems at real-world speed, failing, learning, and shipping along the way.

Basic Qualifications

• PhD
• Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
• Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
• Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience using Unix/Linux
• Experience in professional software development

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Head of International Markets (m/f)
jobs.description:
Head of International Markets

Permanent contract

At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction - we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our private banking business.

What you will do:

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer Luxembourg, you will define and execute the Bank's international business development and market corridor strategy in Asia, the Middle East, the UK and the US. Working closely with the Business Head and Relationship Managers, you will drive disciplined delivery of Net New Money (NNM) and revenue, while safeguarding segment and book purity and ensuring a consistently strong client experience. You will promote HSBC Private Bank Luxembourg as the Booking Centre of choice for HSBC PB's international clients, seeking diversification in Continental Europe. As a senior member within the Luxembourg Front Office management team, you will also be accountable for governance and risk management processes and provide supervisory oversight of business activities.

In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Own retention and growth of a Luxembourg-based private banking portfolio sourced from key international markets (Asia, Middle East, UK and US).
• Drive deepening across investments, lending and deposits (where applicable), reducing attrition and ensuring appropriate booking governance and book purity for corridor-sourced relationships.
• Run disciplined sales management, including opportunity qualification, pricing/returns focus, and activity standards.
• Establish corridor-to-PBLU portfolio routines (pipeline, attrition watchlist, top-client plans, rebooking/booking exception management).
• Define, refresh and execute the International Markets strategy in close partnership with the Business Heads, including priority client segments, target industries, and value propositions.
• Build and execute PBLU awareness and adoption plan through structured engagement programmes (education series, immersion and exchange visits, regular follow-ups) to deepen understanding of PBLU's platform, offering and capabilities across other HSBC Private Bank booking centres and relevant HSBC lines of business.
• Deliver market financial targets (revenue, margin, profitability, cost-to-serve where applicable), monitor performance drivers (mix, pricing, attrition, productivity), and ensure transparent forecasting by high-quality management information.

You should apply if you have:

• Extensive experience in Private Banking Relationship Management and senior client-facing roles.
• Positive track record in business development and risk management.
• Strong, up-to-date understanding of the market landscape, peer product offering and industry innovation.
• Experience working with clients and teams across Asia, MENA, the UK and the US.
• Demonstrated ability to shape market strategy and multi-year business plans, including footprint/capability design and target setting.
• Strong commercial execution skills, including pipeline management, conversion discipline, pricing/returns focus.
• Strong stakeholder management skills across products, operations, risk, compliance and multiple geographies.
• Fluent English (written and spoken).

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.

What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is EUR 155,700 - 233,600.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.com

Optimiser et digitaliser les processus internes, résoudre les problématiques inter-services et faire remonter (escalader) les points bloquants à la direction.
Fournir un support opérationnel à la direction générale par la préparation d'analyses, d'évaluations et de bases de décision.

2. Contrôle de Gestion, Finance & Audit

Piloter le contrôle de gestion des projets : analyser les écarts (coûts/recettes/marges), réviser les prévisions, valider les durées de projets et contrôler les coûts post-clôture.
Assurer l'interface entre la finance et le métier : aligner les données de la comptabilité avec la gestion de projet, et suivre les flux de trésorerie (garanties bancaires, retenues de garantie).
Coordonner de manière centrale l'audit financier avec notre auditeur externe (pré-audit de novembre et audit final en mars-avril), préparer les dossiers et justifier les données.

3. Supervision Comptable et RH (en binôme)

Encadrer la facturation régulière et en temps utile des clients.
Organiser les relances et suivre le bon recouvrement des factures clients.
Assurer les cycles de paiement (et la collecte systématique des escomptes fournisseurs).
Procéder au contrôle et à la validation finale des factures d'achat du département administratif.
Superviser l'administration RH : contrôler avec ses équipes les temps de travail avant l'envoi en paie, apporter un support à la rédaction de courriers/contrats RH, et faire l'interface avec le comité d'entreprise.
Fixer les grilles salariales annuelles, notamment pour la facturation des heures de projets.

4. Administration des Systèmes, Gérance Juridique, Services Généraux et Projets Transversaux

Gérer l'administration du système ERP (LABEL) : gérer les accès et les droits, effectuer les clôtures mensuelles et annuelles.
Assurer le suivi des engagements contractuels et la gestion globale des assurances (incluant le traitement des sinistres sur les chantiers et les bâtiments).
Assurer la supervision hiérarchique et le contrôle de la gestion du parc automobile (fleet management).
Piloter la qualité (norme ISO 9001) et mener des projets transversaux d'amélioration continue tels que la poursuite de la digitalisation de l'entreprise.


Profil et Qualités Requises:


Compétences Linguistiques:

En raison de la forte multiculturalité de notre entreprise et des interactions quotidiennes avec les différentes équipes, le profil recherché doit impérativement parler et comprendre l'allemand et le français.
La compréhension du luxembourgeois constitue un atout supplémentaire.


Expertise Technique (Hard Skills):

Solide formation et expérience avérée en gestion financière, contrôle de gestion (idéalement appliqué à la gestion de projets) et comptabilité.
Maîtrise des mécanismes de préparation et de justification lors d'audits financiers (ex. : relation avec des auditeurs).
Expérience dans l'administration des Ressources Humaines et le droit contractuel/gestion des assurances.
Forte aisance informatique avec les systèmes de type ERP (l'administration de logiciels type LABEL est un plus).


Savoir-être et Aptitudes (Soft Skills):

Excellente capacité managériale pour encadrer, coordonner et faire évoluer une équipe variée.
Esprit critique et excellente capacité d'analyse pour évaluer et challenger des données financières et économiques.
Sens aigu de l'organisation garantissant une stricte séparation des rôles entre l'exécution, le contrôle et la validation.
Excellentes compétences de communication inter-départements (capacité à lier les visions comptables, administratives et métier).

jobs.title: Junior National Funding Advisor – Innovation & Sustainability Grants (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Fixed-term contract (CDD – 24 months), full-time, ref.: JNF09
Service: National Funding
Hierarchical Superior: Head of National Funding

About Luxinnovation
Luxinnovation is Luxembourg's national innovation agency. As a semi-public institution set up as an Economic Interest Group (GIE), we empower companies to innovate today to be ready for tomorrow. We also contribute to the development of the economy as a whole by identifying innovation opportunities and fostering collaborative innovation projects that stimulate the development of a sustainable, competitive and digital economy.
Luxinnovation is supported by three ministries — the Ministry of the Economy, the Ministry for Research and Higher Education, and the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs — as well as three semi-public institutions: the Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce, the Luxembourg Chamber of Skilled Crafts, and FEDIL – The Voice of Luxembourg's Industry.

Job mission
Department description
One of Luxinnovation's core activities is to support companies seeking national funding for their innovation activities and sustainability investments. The mission of the National Funding team is to guide and support companies throughout the process of applying for innovation and environmental state aid, ensuring they access the right instruments at the right time.
Job description
As a Junior National Funding Advisor, you will reinforce the National Funding team in the context of increased demand for innovation funding and decarbonisation grants. You will provide first-level guidance to companies, support eligibility assessments and contribute to the promotion of national funding opportunities — including the AI Factory initiative and environmental aid schemes.
You will progressively develop expertise across funding instruments, eligibility criteria and application processes under the mentorship of experienced advisors.

Main tasks and responsibilities
Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:
Inspire:
• Contribute to the promotion of national funding opportunities by supporting the planning, coordination and delivery of awareness campaigns, workshops and events, particularly in relation to emerging environmental and AI aid schemes.
• Assist the National Funding team in knowledge-sharing activities and continuous improvement initiatives that contribute to the team's effectiveness and visibility.
Assess & Accelerate:
• Under the guidance of experienced advisors, participate in client meetings and support the preliminary assessment of companies seeking public funding for research, innovation and sustainability projects, including conducting eligibility checks and due diligence reviews.
• Support the review of funding applications by analysing project descriptions, financial statements, investment plans and supporting documentation, and contribute to the preparation of internal decision-support documents for Gate 1 and Gate 2 reviews.
Connect:
• Manage and qualify incoming client requests on a daily basis, with a particular focus on opportunities related to the AI Factory initiative and environmental/decarbonisation funding schemes, ensuring timely orientation towards relevant support services.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date information within the customer relationship management (CRM) system and other internal tools, ensuring high-quality data management and effective follow-up of client interactions.
Fund:
• Provide first-level guidance to companies on available state aid instruments for innovation and sustainability, including the AI Factory initiative and environmental/decarbonisation funding schemes.
• Collaborate closely with senior members of the National Funding team to address more complex client enquiries and progressively develop expertise across funding instruments, eligibility criteria and application processes.
• Contribute to the preparation of client feedback and internal decision-support documents under the supervision of senior advisors.
This list is not exhaustive. Additional tasks may be assigned to the holder of the job.

You will act as a key bridge between national/European initiatives and the Luxembourg business ecosystem, driving innovation and sustainable growth.

Required competencies
Education level and professional experience required:
• Holder of a master's degree (bac+5 in the French university system) in economics, finance, business management, engineering or a dual scientific/management profile.
• Previous internship or professional experience of 1 to 2 years in an activity related to innovation funding, business consulting, financial analysis or state aid.
Specific competencies:
• Good skills in financial analysis and the ability to assess investment plans and business documentation.
• Strong writing skills and the ability to produce clear summary notes and decision-support documents.
• General knowledge of project management principles.
• Ability to manage several complex files efficiently and independently.
• Relational ease allowing effective interaction with partners at relevant ministries, financial institutions and business managers.
• Organised, flexible, autonomous with excellent listening and analytical skills.
• Interest in innovation ecosystems, decarbonisation and sustainability funding.
Languages:
• Fluent French and English (oral and written) are mandatory. Luxembourgish and/or German are considered a strong asset.
IT skills:
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel in particular).
• Familiarity with CRM tools and internal data management platforms.

Why choose this position?
Join a human-sized, multidisciplinary organisation where you will learn to carry out eligibility assessments using solid procedures, tools and databases. You will be part of a team with a strong team spirit and a culture of information sharing, with direct exposure to Luxembourg's innovation ecosystem. This role offers diversified and rewarding missions — from analysing state aid applications to participating in events on cutting-edge technology — giving you the opportunity to build a solid foundation in innovation funding and public support instruments.

Application
Interested candidates are invited to submit online their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience and motivation for the role.
AI-generated applications might not be the best way to stand out. Show us the real you, and let's see where this journey takes us!
Please note that this position is based at our current offices in Esch-Belval. Luxinnovation GIE will relocate to the Luxembourg main station area in the first quarter of 2027.

jobs.title: Business Relationship Advisor - Agrifood (m/f/x)

The department acts as the primary interface between the business ecosystem and Luxinnovation's programmes, funding instruments and expert networks.
Job description
As an Agrifood Innovation & Business Relationship Advisor, you will serve as the main point of contact for agrifood companies in Luxembourg, identifying their needs and contributing to the digitalisation and decarbonisation of the sector. You will work closely with the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Viticulture and relevant sector-specific associations to support SMEs and large companies in their innovation journey toward sustainable agriculture and food innovation.
You will map the agrifood ecosystem, build trusted relationships with key stakeholders and ensure that companies benefit from tailored Luxinnovation services, R&D collaborations and national or European funding opportunities.

Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:

• Stay informed about European and national market trends, food safety regulations and agrifood policies to guide organisations with a forward-thinking strategic approach
• Support marketing and communication efforts to highlight Luxembourg's agrifood innovation ecosystem and leadership in food innovation
Assess & Accelerate:
• Understand companies' innovation needs and assess how Luxinnovation's services align with their requirements
• Present a clear and complete Luxinnovation service path, offer tailored services or connect companies with other support providers
• Translate business needs into actionable strategies that accelerate the transition toward digital and sustainable practices in the agrifood value chain
Connect:
• Develop and lead a network by connecting agrifood organisations, research centres and businesses to foster innovation and collaboration
• Facilitate strategic partnerships by linking companies with the right agrifood solutions and ensuring effective service delivery through client relationship management (CRM)
• Build and nurture relationships by ensuring ongoing engagement, satisfaction and a clear overview of all ongoing activities through continuous follow-up
• Enhance collaboration by connecting stakeholders and aligning ecosystem services across the agrifood sector
Fund:
• Help companies access State aid, R&D collaborations and adoption programmes related to the agrifood sector
• Strengthen engagement with companies to enhance their access to national and European agrifood support mechanisms
• Increase the number of agrifood companies accompanied by Luxinnovation in their innovation journey
• Improve the conversion rate from initial meetings to the adoption of Luxinnovation services
• Expand outreach to new companies to raise awareness and encourage engagement with innovation funding instruments
This list is not exhaustive. Additional tasks may be assigned to the holder of the job.

You will act as a key bridge between national/European initiatives and the Luxembourg business ecosystem, driving innovation and sustainable growth.

Required competencies
Education level and professional experience required:
• Master's degree in engineering, agrifood sciences, business or a related field
• Minimum 3 years of professional experience in the agrifood sector, bioeconomy, business development, consulting or ecosystem coordination
Specific competencies:
• Strong understanding of agrifood challenges, including decarbonisation, circular economy, digitalisation and sustainable agriculture
• Deep insight into how innovative strategies and sector-specific workflows can accelerate the transition toward digital and sustainable practices
• Analytical skills to gather, document and prioritise business requirements and translate them into actionable strategies
• Excellent communication and networking skills, with the ability to build relationships across agrifood value chains
• Comfortable speaking in front of large audiences, engaging them effectively and tailoring presentations to specific audiences
• Adaptability in evolving environments, with a positive, problem-solving attitude and the ability to work autonomously, take initiative and drive solutions with confidence
• Dynamic, results-oriented and proactive — ready to take ownership and drive change
• Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams
Languages:
Fluency in French, English and Luxembourgish or German is required.
IT skills:
Proficiency with standard office tools (MS Office suite). Familiarity with CRM platforms is an asset.

Why choose this position?
This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Luxembourg's agrifood innovation ecosystem from within its national innovation agency. You will play a pivotal role in connecting agrifood SMEs and large companies to the resources, partnerships and funding they need to accelerate their digital and sustainable transformation.
You will work at the crossroads of policy, industry and research — collaborating with the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Viticulture, sector associations and European networks. Your impact will be tangible: every company you accompany, every partnership you broker and every workgroup you lead will contribute directly to building a more competitive and sustainable agrifood sector in Luxembourg.
You will join a collaborative, forward-looking team that values autonomy, initiative and professional growth — in an environment where your ideas can translate into real, ecosystem-wide change.

Application
Interested candidates are invited to submit online their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience and motivation for the role.
AI-generated applications might not be the best way to stand out. Show us the real you, and let's see where this journey takes us!
Please note that this position is based at our current offices in Esch-Belval. Luxinnovation GIE will relocate to the Luxembourg main station area in the first quarter of 2027.

------Service Now - copy&paste-Position: 50027896

About the LCSB
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Luxembourg Centre for Systems Biomedicine (LCSB) is an interdisciplinary research centre of the University of Luxembourg.
We conduct fundamental and translational research in the field of Systems Biology and Biomedicine – in the lab, in the clinic and in silico. We focus on neurodegenerative processes and are especially interested in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease and their contributing factors. The LCSB recruits talented scientists from various disciplines: computer scientists, mathematicians, biologists, chemists, engineers, physicists and clinicians from more than 50 countries currently work at the LCSB. We excel because we are truly interdisciplinary, and together we contribute to science and society.

Your role
We seek a highly motivated software developer to join a FNR JUMP-funded project translating a validated suite of bioinformatics software tools into CausalOmics, an integrated software platform for causal analysis of omics data. The platform identifies root causal genes and candidate drug targets from multi-omics datasets.
The candidate will contribute to the further development of the unified, point-and-click user interface, implement interactive visualization frameworks for complex biological networks, and develop the core platform architecture that connects the analysis modules, spanning preprocessing, network and pathway analysis, causal reasoning, drug target assessment, and machine learning, through robust APIs.
Further responsibilities include setting up the cloud deployment infrastructure (SaaS architecture, REST API) and ensuring the platform is scalable, reproducible, and accessible to users without coding or bioinformatics expertise. The role is closely linked to the CausalOmics go-to-market project, and the candidate will work directly with the project's principal investigator and its interdisciplinary bioinformatics and business development team.
This position is offered with the explicit intent that the successful candidate may take on the role of Chief Technology Officer (CTO) / Lead Developer of the planned CausalOmics spin-off company after incorporation.

  • pravovremeno prepoznavanje dodatnih radova i komunikacija s klijentom vezano uz njihovu realizaciju
  • koordinacija potrebnih aktivnosti kako bi se osiguralo nesmetano i pravovremeno odvijanje projekata
  • provedba radova i procesa potrebnih za realizaciju projekata remonta i popravaka plovila, uz primjenu odgovarajućih znanja i razumijevanja tehnoloških procesa
  • priprema potrebnih podataka i dokumentacije za završni obračun projekta
  • vođenje projekata u skladu s dogovorenim rokovima, opsegom radova i definiranim troškovima
  • izvođenje drugih poslova prema uputama poslodavca

OD KANDIDATA OČEKUJEMO

  • tehničko znanje i interes za nautiku, brodogradnju i servisiranje plovila
  • sposobnost samostalne organizacije i vođenja servisnih projekata
  • izražene organizacijske i komunikacijske sposobnosti
  • odgovornost, preciznost i sistematičnost u radu
  • sposobnost istovremenog praćenja više projekata i prioriteta
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu i MS Office paketa
  • dobro znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu
  • vozačku dozvolu B kategorije
  • spremnost na timski rad i svakodnevnu komunikaciju s klijentima, dobavljačima i kooperantima

Prednost imaju kandidati s prethodnim iskustvom u nautici, brodogradnji, servisiranju plovila, tehničkom održavanju ili vođenju projekata, kao i kandidati koji poznaju brodske sustave, materijale i tehnološke procese vezane uz održavanje i remont plovila.

jobs.title: ELEKTRIČAR MONTER/ELEKTRIČARKA MONTERKA
jobs.description:
Opis poslova:
  • Polaganje i spajanje kabela (VN, SN, NN, signalnih): polaganje svih vrsta kabela i njihovo spajanje.
  • Izrada kablovskih snopova: izrada kablovskih snopova svih vrsta kabela.

  • stručna sprema: SSS ili KV elektrostruke

  • stimulativna i redovna primanjau skladu s postignutim rezultatima
  • bonus na osnovnu plaćutemeljen na učinku

  • osiguranje smještaja i prijevozado gradilišta
  • radna oprema i zaštitna odjećaosigurani
  • mogućnost napredovanja i profesionalnog usavršavanjau okviru firme
  • podrška u obrazovanju, uključujući financiranje stručnih certifikata i specijaliziranih tečajeva
  • kompenzacija za prekovremene sate u skladu s važećim propisima
  • bonus za lojalnostuz nagrade za dugogodišnji rad u firmi
  • sigurnost i stabilnost zapošljavanjau renomiranom poduzeću s dugogodišnjom tradicijom
  • rad u klimatiziranoj hali
  • osiguranje za slučaj nesreće na poslu ili izvan njega
  • božićnica i regres

  7. Elektronski ispis staža iz HZMO

jobs.title: UČITELJ/ICA ENGLESKOG JEZIKA
jobs.description: Objava natječaja na HZZZ-u od 28.09.- 06.10.2026. Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine br. 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10. - ispr., 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18 i 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 156/23), članka 13. Pravilnika o radu i članaka 6. i 7. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja Osnovne škole Remete (u daljnjem tekstu: Pravilnik), ravnatelj Osnovne škole Remete objavljuje: N A T J E Č A J za zasnivanje radnog odnosa 1. Učitelj/ica engleskog jezika, na određeno, nepuno radno vrijeme (6 sati tjedno), 1 izvršitelj/ica Uvjeti: Kandidati uz opće uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa, sukladno općim propisima o radu, moraju ispunjavati i posebne uvjete propisane Zakonom o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine br.: 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 156/23) i čl.17. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (Narodne novine br. 6/19, 75/20). Na natječaj se mogu javiti muške i ženske osobe u skladu sa Zakonom o ravnopravnosti spolova (Narodne novine br. 82/08 i 69/17) U prijavi na natječaj navode se i podaci podnositelja prijave (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela, adresa e-pošte, isključivo za potrebe postupka), naziv radnog mjesta za koje se prijavljuje i datum objave natječaja. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj, kandidati su dužni priložiti: 1. životopis 2. dokaz o državljanstvu 3. diplomu, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi 4. uvjerenje nadležnog suda da kandidat nije pod istragom i da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela iz čl.106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana raspisivanja natječaja 5. elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje Navedene isprave odnosno prilozi dostavljaju se u neovjerenoj preslici i ne vraćaju se kandidatu nakon završenog natječajnog postupka. Prije sklapanja ugovora o radu odabrani kandidat dužan je sve navedene priloge odnosno isprave predočiti u izvorniku ili u preslici ovjerenoj od strane javnog bilježnika. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21), članku 48. stavku 1.-3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) dužna je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja i ovisno o kategoriji u koju ulazi sve potrebne dokaze (članak 103.st.1.Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja te priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju (čl.49.st.1. Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Prijavom na natječaj svaki kandidat daje privolu Osnovnoj školi Remete za obradu osobnih podataka u skladu s propisima kojima je propisana zaštita osobnih podataka za svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka i objave rezultata natječaja. Rok za podnošenje prijava kandidata je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i o tome se ne radi posebna obavijest. Kandidat/kinja koji/a je pravodobno dostavio/la potpunu prijavu sa svim ispravama odnosno prilozima i ispunjava uvjete natječaja dužan/a je pristupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju prema odredbama Pravilnika. Odluku o vremenu, mjestu i načinu održavanja procjene vrednovanja kandidata/kinje Škola će objaviti na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr s napomenom da se kandidati/kinje neće posebno pozivati. Obavijest o ishodu natječajnog postupka, objavit će se na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr najkasnije u roku od osam dana od dana sklapanja ugovora s odabranim kandidatom. U slučaju da se na natječaj prijave kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom propisu, kandidati će se obavijestiti prema članku 17. stavku 4. Pravilnika. Prijave na natječaj s potrebnom dokumentacijom kandidati dostavljaju neposredno ili poštom na adresu: Osnovna škola Remete, Remete 99a, 10 000 Zagreb, s naznakom “za natječaj- Učitelj/ica engleskog jezika“.
