jobs.title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

jobs.title: Csoportkoordinátor- Külső csomagolási projektek (Leiter/in - Logistik)
jobs.description:
Bevezetés

Részt venni a változás alakításában. Egy lépéssel megelőzni a holnap kihívásait már ma. Együtt növekedni egy fejlődő iparágban. Értékeink mentén, felelősen viselkedni. TÚLLÉPNI A HATÁROKAT. Ezt jelenti a DEUFOL csapatában dolgozni.
Világszerte 3 kontinensen, 12 ország 90 telephelyén, 2400 motivált munkatársunkkal, globális szereplők vagyunk az ellátási lánc megoldások és az ipari csomagolás területén.

Milyen feladatokra számíthatsz?

- Külső (a Deufol Hungary telephelyén kívül megvalósítandó) csomagolási és logisztikai projektek megvalósításának menedzsmentje az üzleti partnereink telephelyein (Debrecenen belül, illetve kívül, több változó helyszínen a régióban), a munkavállalók és a szakmai feladatok koordinálása
- A különféle külső helyszíneken az ipari termékek szakszerű, a megrendelésben meghatározott specifikációknak megfelelő csomagolásának, valamint a lecsomagolt termékek adminisztrációs, anyagmozgatási feladatainak biztosítása, a tevékenységek koordinálása
- Az ügyfélelégedettség biztosítása a külső csomagolási projektek során: egyeztetés a helyi kapcsolattartóval a helyszínen elvégzendő feladatokról, prioritásokról, reklamációs esetek kivizsgálása és részvétel a reakciós folyamatban.
- A külső csomagolási tevékenységekhez felhasznált csomagolóanyagok helyszínre történő kiszállítása céges autóval, szükség esetén fuvarszervezés
- A csapat tevékenységéhez kapcsolódó dokumentációs, riportolási és adminisztrációs feladatok ellátása a csoportvezető felé
- Együttműködés a cégen belüli társterületekkel, illetve a külső partnerekkel

Hozzád illik a pozíció, ha:

- Magabiztos, releváns tapasztalattal rendelkezel kisebb, néhány fős csapat vezetésében és koordinálásában gyártási, termelési, raktári, logisztikai területen
- Magabiztos számítógép-felhasználói ismeretekkel rendelkezel, gyakorlottan használod a MS Office alkalmazásokat; előny, ha valamilyen logisztikai, vállalatirányítási szoftver használatában van már tapasztalatod
- Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel; előny a szakirányú végzettség vagy tapasztalat logisztika, ellátási lánc menedzsment, ipari csomagolási, faipari, raktári területen

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Support Engineer you are at the forefront of helping those developers create. In a given day you’ll help folks with all sorts of things ranging from general Replit usage questions, identifying and debugging issues on the platform and helping to build and maintain the tools we use. We use tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and Replit itself to get the job done. We also value solving the problems we can ourselves. We have a number of tools we build and maintain ourselves.



You will work on a small, global team of support specialists and engineers united by Replit's mission to make the next billion software creators. Together, you'll ensure developers worldwide have the support they need to bring their ideas to life.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Work directly with Replit customers via support tickets to solve technical product issues, bugs, and provide technical guidance while meeting daily ticket volume and resolution time targets.

 - Collaborate with the rest of the Support team in telling the story of our users to the rest of Replit.

 - Directly contribute to and maintain the Support team's Knowledge Base.

 - Support customer-facing communications for outages and incidents and swiftly report ongoing bugs for Eng to triage and fix.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Prior experience in software development or relevant technical support experience

 - Proven ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, high-volume support environments with strict productivity metrics.

 - Strong time management and ticket triage skills with comfort in performance tracking and regular reporting.

 - Excellent communication skills with initiative to ask questions when encountered with the unknown.

 - Experience with support tools and ticketing systems (e.g. Zendesk)




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

 - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems



This is a full-time role that can be held from our NYC (SoHo) office. The schedule follows a Saturday through Wednesday work week, with an in-office requirement on Mondays and Wednesdays.

Om Diamond Slice

Diamond Slice serverer New York-style surdejspizza slices i København fra vores afdelinger på Blågårds Plads og Tagensvej. Vi kombinerer klassiske amerikanske slice-opskrifter med gode råvarer, koldhævet dej og bagning ved høj varme. Vi har fart på både i restauranterne og på takeaway, og vi er en virksomhed i fortsat vækst.

Rollen

Som Kitchen Manager er du ansvarlig for den daglige drift i køkkenet. Det er din opgave at sikre et højt bundniveau på alle serveringer, holde styr på systemer og hygiejne, samt lede køkkenholdet i tæt samarbejde med vores front of house (FOH).

  • Varebestillinger, varemodtagelse og lagerstyring

  • Oplæring, instruktion og daglig ledelse af køkkenpersonalet

  • Overholdelse af hygiejnestandarder, rengøringsrutiner og egenkontrol

  • Daglig koordinering og kontakt med FOH under service

  • Sikring af et højt arbejdstempo under spidsbelastninger og takeaway-ryk

Krav og profil

  • Minimum 3 års erfaring fra restaurationsbranchen

  • Erfaring med pizzabagning ELLER erfaring med ledelse er et krav (erfaring med ledelse af et pizzakøkken er en klar fordel)

  • Tryg ved at arbejde selvstændigt uden direkte supervision og med stærke beslutningsevner

  • Meget velstruktureret og organiseret, og motiveres af at arbejde hurtigt og slå uret under travle perioder

  • God fysisk form og komfortabel med hele vagter på benene

  • Klar og parat til at arbejde aften- og weekendvagter

  • Gode engelskkundskaber (dansk er en kærkommen bonus)

Vi tilbyder

  • Timeløn på 175 – 185 kr./time baseret på erfaring

  • Grundig oplæring og faglige færdigheder i at producere New York-style pizza i særklasse

  • En arbejdsom, men venlig og støttende arbejdskultur

  • En virksomhed i vækst med reel mulighed for mere ansvar og stigende løn over tid

  • En fleksibel vagtplan

About Diamond Slice

Diamond Slice serves New York-style sourdough pizza by the slice in Copenhagen from our locations at Blågårds Plads and Tagensvej.   • Confident working solo without direct supervision, with strong decision-making skills

  • Highly structured, organized, and genuinely energized by working fast and beating the clock during rush hours

  • Comfortable working full shifts on your feet

  • Ready and available to work evening and weekend shifts

  • Strong communication skills in English (Danish is an appreciated bonus)

What We Offer

  • Hourly wage of 175 – 185 DKK/hour based on experience

  • Training and technical skills in producing world-class New York-style pizza

  • A hardworking but friendly and supportive atmosphere

  • A growing company with opportunities to take on more responsibility and higher pay over time

  • A flexible schedule

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life.

Â 

Role

As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets.

  • Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets.

  • Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications.

  • Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows.

  • Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices.

  • Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly.

Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies.

  • Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance.

  • Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces.

  • Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces.

  • Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details.

  • Able to independently own features from technical design through production.

Â 

Outcomes

  • Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

  • Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable.

  • AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences.

  • Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows.

Â 

Tech Stack

  • TypeScript

  • React.js / Next.js

  • HTML / CSS

  • WebSockets / streaming APIs

  • Node.js

  • REST / GraphQL APIs

Â 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product.

Â 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally.

jobs.title: Senior Tax Accountant
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Tax team is growing, and we’re looking for a Senior Tax Accountant to support our global tax operations. In this role, you’ll run global indirect tax operations and strengthen the systems behind them. As Notion scales across products and jurisdictions, this role exists to make compliance, close, audits, and tax data more accurate, scalable, and audit-ready. You’ll own recurring sales and use tax, VAT/GST, business tax, registrations, notices, reconciliations, and related controls, while building exposure to income tax compliance and reporting. The work is hands-on and cross-functional: you’ll trace differences across billing, tax engines, filings, payments, and the general ledger with Accounting, Revenue, Billing, Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Experience partners.

 

This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Take ownership of recurring U.S. and global indirect-tax filings, calendars, data packages, notices, registrations, and close support—with accurate, review-ready work.

 - Establish a reliable reconciliation and exception workflow across billing, tax engines, filings, payments, and the general ledger, escalating issues clearly and early.

 - Use AI-enabled workflows and data tools to investigate variances, quality-check work papers, and improve documentation while preserving human review and controls.

 - Make tax operations more scalable and audit-ready by strengthening controls, process documentation, evidence, handoffs, audit support, and SOX walkthrough readiness.

 - Become a trusted partner to Accounting, Revenue, Billing, Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Experience—and contribute to income tax compliance and reporting with guidance from experienced teammates.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - At least 3 years of public accounting and/or industry tax experience, with a primary focus on indirect tax compliance and operations.

 - Hands-on experience with indirect tax compliance or operations, especially U.S. sales and use tax, VAT/GST, business taxes, or other non-income-based taxes; this is the foundation for owning Notion’s recurring global work.

 - Experience preparing accurate reconciliations, journal entries, filings, payments, and audit-ready work papers, with the ability to connect activity across source systems and the general ledger.

 - Strong operational judgment: you manage recurring deadlines, investigate exceptions, keep documentation organized, escalate issues promptly, and drive assigned work through completion.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, with a collaborative approach to working across Finance, Accounting, business teams, and external advisors.

 - Curiosity and learning agility, including willingness to build income-tax capability and demonstrated AI fluency—using AI to analyze data, investigate variances, improve documentation, perform quality checks, or automate repeatable workflows while validating outputs and protecting sensitive information.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting (m/f)
jobs.description:
Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting

Role Overview

Within the Fund Administration department, the Assistant Manager is responsible for overseeing a portfolio of complex and high‑profile fund structures, ensuring high‑quality service delivery, regulatory compliance, and timely reporting.

The role combines technical expertise, team leadership, and client ownership. The Assistant Manager acts as a key escalation point for both clients and internal teams and supports the Manager in driving operational excellence, risk management, and process improvement.

Tasks

Client & Delivery Ownership

• Act as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of sophisticated clients (Private Equity, Private Debt, Evergreen structures, Hybrid structures, Open-ended structures).
• Assume end‑to‑end responsibility for service delivery, ensuring compliance with SLAs, fund documentation, and regulatory requirements.
• Manage client expectations proactively and handle escalations independently before involving the Manager where required.
Build and maintain trusted, long‑term client relationships, participating in client meetings, onboarding calls, and post‑audit reviews.

Onboarding

During client onboarding, the Assistant Manager undertakes several crucial tasks to ensure a smooth transition and establish a productive relationship with the new client. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Lead or actively support client onboardings, restructurings, migrations, and system set‑ups.
• Validate fund structures, valuation methodologies, fee models, and reporting frameworks in line with legal documents.
• Coordinate across internal teams (FA, TA, back office, Corporate, AIFM, Risk & Compliance, IT etc) to ensure seamless implementation.
• Review and sign‑off data migration and initial NAVs.

NAV Oversight & Technical Review

During Net Asset Value (NAV) oversight, the Assistant Manager play a critical role in ensuring accuracy, compliance, and smooth operations. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Assume overall accountability for the NAV oversight framework across the assigned client portfolio, ensuring accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and compliance with fund documentation, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Oversee the end‑to‑end NAV production cycle, including capital activity, income recognition, valuation inputs, investor allocations, and fee calculations.
• Perform in‑depth technical reviews and approvals of complex NAVs, including:

o Private equity, private debt, evergreen funds, and multi‑compartment structures
o Complex instruments (loans, profit‑participating notes, derivatives, look‑through investments)
o FX treatments, waterfalls, and performance fee mechanisms
• Act as a technical reference point on Lux GAAP, IFRS, consolidation and structure‑specific treatments.

• Ensure all NAV‑related deliverables meet agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and internal quality standards.
• Maintain strong documentation standards, including working papers, reconciliation files, and management review evidence, to support both internal controls and external audit requirements.
• Support the preparation of financial statements inputs by ensuring consistency between NAVs, accounting records, and statutory reporting.

Risk Management, Controls & Audit

• Act as a key control owner for the assigned client portfolio, ensuring that fund accounting activities are performed in line with internal policies, ISAE requirements, regulatory obligations, and client documentation.
• Ensure that appropriate preventive and detective controls are in place, operating effectively, and evidenced.
• Review and challenge unusual transactions, valuation judgments, late data, or deviations from standard processes.
• Act as the primary escalation point for NAV issues, breaches, or errors, ensuring timely resolution, root‑cause analysis, and clear documentation.
• Act as the primary liaison for external auditors, managing audit queries and timelines.
• Support the Manager in maintaining a strong control culture across the team and client portfolio.

Team Leadership & People Management

• Provide day‑to‑day supervision of Senior Fund Accountants and Fund Accountants within the team.
• Allocate work effectively, taking into account complexity, risk and deadlines.
• Review deliverables prepared by the team and provide structured feedback.
• Support training, development, and performance management of team members.
• Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and quality.
• Escalate capacity, performance, or quality concerns to the Manager with proposed solutions.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

• Continuously assess existing fund accounting and reporting processes to identify inefficiencies, risks, and improvement opportunities.
• Actively contribute to system enhancements, automation, and standardisation.
• Support the Manager in implementing new operating models, tools, and best practices.
• Encourage a culture of continuous improvement and risk awareness

Required Experience / Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics
• ACCA (or equivalent) – qualified or advanced stage preferred
• Strong knowledge of Lux GAAP and IFRS (including consolidation)
• 8+ years of experience in fund administration, primarily for closed-ended funds, open-ended funds and evergreen/hybrid funds, with experience in various asset classes (private equity, private debt, listed loans)
• Prior experience reviewing NAVs and supervising team members is essential.
• Experience in capital hedging and portfolio management.
• Added value for candidates familiar with public loans managed through Allvue or WSO platforms.
• Languages: English fluent; French and/or German is an advantage.
• Additional advantage for candidates with experience using Paxus.

Skills/Behavior

In addition to demonstrating IQEQ's Group Values (Authentic, Bold, Collaborative), the Assistant Manager is expected to:

• Take ownership and accountability
• Demonstrate sound judgement and risk awareness
• Lead and develop others
• Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders
• Navigate complexity and ambiguity
• Balance client service with internal control discipline
• Plan, prioritise, and delegate effectively
• Continuously develop technical and leadership skills

jobs.title: Head of Internal Audit (m/f)

jobs.description:
C-27001 HEAD OF INTERNAL AUDIT
Permanent contract | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies, LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

Context

As the Head of Internal Audit, you will lead, structure and continuously develop LIST's Internal Audit Service, an independent and objective assurance and advisory function serving the Board of Directors through the Finance and Audit Committee.
The role provides independent assurance on the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management and internal control, while supporting compliance with applicable laws and regulations and contributing to the continuous improvement of LIST's organisation and operations.

In addition to defining the internal audit strategy and the risk-based annual audit plan, you will oversee the full audit lifecycle, from planning and execution to reporting, follow-up and quality assurance. The role also leads specific assurance, advisory and investigation assignments and ensures that Internal Audit methodologies, policies, processes and the Internal Audit Charter remain robust and aligned with professional internal audit standards.

Working closely with the Board of Directors, the Finance and Audit Committee, the CEO, Executive Management, Risk Management, external auditors and auditees, you will provide clear insights and recommendations to support informed decision-making while safeguarding the independence, objectivity and credibility of the function.

Your team and environment

Your team - 3 people

• Head of Internal Audit - 1 | leadership of the function, audit strategy, governance and stakeholder engagement
• Internal Audit collaborators - 2 | contribution to assurance, advisory, audit follow-up and continuous improvement activities

The Internal Audit Service operates as an independent function within LIST and coordinates with Risk Management, where relevant, to leverage synergies and avoid duplication of work without prejudice to its independence.
You will report to the Chair of the Board of Directors, or to the Vice-Chair in the event of replacement of the Chair, in accordance with the Internal Audit Charter. For administrative and day-to-day matters, you will report to the CEO.

Description

You will be mainly responsible for:

Internal Audit Leadership & Governance

• Lead and develop the Internal Audit Service, setting a high standard for performance, integrity, objectivity, confidentiality and competence
• Define and implement the internal audit strategy in alignment with LIST's goals and objectives
• Develop, maintain and continuously improve the Internal Audit Charter, policies, methodologies, processes and procedures

Risk-Based Audit Planning & Delivery

jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Otsime oma meeskonda rendi projektijuhti. Sa ei tee seda üksi — Sinu selja taga on kogenud Storenti meeskond ja väljakujunenud protsessid — kuid Tallinnas oled just Sina see, kes klientide juures käib, projekte juhib ja piirkonna äri üles ehitab.
Usaldame Sulle: • Uute A-segmendi klientide leidmise ja Storenti tuntuse ülesehitamise Tallinna piirkonnas, • Pikaajaliste ja usalduslike kliendisuhete loomise ning hoidmise, • Rendiprojektide juhtimise algusest lõpuni — kliendi vajaduse mõistmisest kuni tehnika puhta tagastuseni, • Pakkumiste koostamise ja läbirääkimise õige hinnataseme ning kasumlikkuse eest, • Mugavat ja efektiivset projektide haldamist kaasaegses rendihaldussüsteemis.

Omalt poolt pakume: • Head töötasu - tagame väga head boonused. Mida rohkem kliente ja projekte, seda rohkem teenid.
• Tugevat meeskonda - pakume tööd professionaalses meeskonnas kaasaegse rendihaldussüsteemi toel. • Ärikoolitusi - pakume koolitusi tehnikapargile ning müügis. • Tööautot, mida tohib kasutada ka isiklikel sõitudel. • Paindlikku tööaega - võimalus kokku sobitada töö ja eraelu.

Muud nõuded: Vajalik on eelnev B2B tööriistade või ehitusseadmete ja -masinate edukas müügi või rendi kogemus.
Muud nõuded: B2B müügikogemus ja tulemustele orienteeritud isiksus, kes tunneb rõõmu nii diili sulgemisest kui pikaajalise kliendisuhte hoidmisest; • Ehitusvaldkonna ja sellel töötavate professionaalide tundmine — Sa tead, millest ehituse valdkonnas tegutseva kliendiga rääkida; • Iseseisvus, ettevõtja hoiak ja distsipliin; • B-kategooria juhiluba ja valmisolek piirkonnas regulaarselt külastada kliente ja ehitusobjekte; • Suhtled/kirjutad vabalt eesti keeles.

jobs.title: Junior Digital Assets Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Application URL
https://omegadg.com/work/remoteok

Omega Enterprises is an international digital-assets company focused on cryptocurrency markets, market intelligence, and data-based financial operations. We are expanding our team and looking for motivated people who would like to build practical knowledge of digital markets and develop their analytical skills.

This is an entry-level opportunity designed for candidates who are interested in cryptocurrency, financial markets, and working with market information. Previous employment in the crypto industry is not necessary. New team members receive onboarding, training, and ongoing support from experienced colleagues.

What You'll Do

  • Follow daily developments across cryptocurrency and digital-asset markets.
  • Assist the team with routine operational and analytical activities.
  • Track changes in prices, trading activity, liquidity, and other relevant indicators.
  • Gather information from internal and external market-data sources.
  • Maintain organized records and prepare concise internal reports.
  • Summarize market observations for team discussions.
  • Take part in regular training, feedback sessions, and team meetings.
  • Complete structured tasks under the guidance of more experienced team members.

What You'll Get

  • Fully remote working arrangement.
  • Flexible day-to-day workflow.
  • Structured onboarding for people new to the crypto industry.
  • Training in basic market-analysis and digital-asset tools.
  • Access to practical market information and analytical resources.
  • Regular feedback and guidance from a mentor.
  • A clear path for developing toward more advanced analytical responsibilities.
  • Opportunity to work within an international digital-assets team.

The Person We're Looking For

  • Are genuinely interested in cryptocurrency, financial markets, or market analytics.
  • Enjoy learning new tools and working with structured information.
  • Pay attention to detail when handling data and written tasks.
  • Can follow procedures and instructions consistently.
  • Are dependable, organized, and comfortable working independently.
  • Have English proficiency around B2 or higher, sufficient for professional tools, market information, and training materials.

Position Details

  • Position: Junior Digital Assets Operations Analyst
  • Work format: Remote
  • Experience: Entry level / training provided

Application URL
https://omegadg.com/work/remoteok

ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ, ΕΚΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ. ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΤΑΞΗΣ ΣΤΟΝ ΧΩΡΟ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΚΑΝΟΝΩΝ ΥΓΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑΣ ΣΤΟ ΕΡΓΟΤΑΞΙΟ. ΕΚΤΕΛΕΣΗ ΑΛΛΩΝ ΣΥΝΑΦΩΝ ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΩΝ ΠΟΥ ΑΝΑΤΙΘΕΝΤΑΙ ΑΠΟ ΤΟΝ ΠΡΟΙΣΤΑΜΕΝΟ. , ΚΑΛΗ ΦΥΣΙΚΗ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΕΚΤΕΛΕΣΗΣ ΧΕΙΡΩΝΑΚΤΙΚΗΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ, ΣΥΝΕΠΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟ ΠΝΕΥΜΑ. ΔΙΑΘΕΣΗ ΓΙΑ ΜΑΘΗΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΚΠΑΙΔΕΥΣΗ ΣΤΙΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΚΑΛΟΥΠΙΩΝ. ΠΡΟΗΓΟΥΜΕΝΗ ΕΜΠΕΙΡΙΑ ΣΕ ΟΙΚΟΔΟΜΙΚΕΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΘΑ ΘΕΩΡΗΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΠΡΟΣΘΕΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ. , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.title: ΒΟΗΘΟΣ ΣΙΔΕΡΑΣ
jobs.description: ΥΠΟΒΟΗΘΗΣΗ ΣΤΗΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΗ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΑΡΜΟΛΟΓΗΣΗ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΩΝ. ΠΡΟΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΙΑ, ΚΟΠΗ, ΛΕΙΑΝΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΜΕΤΑΦΟΡΑ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΩΝ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ. ΧΡΗΣΗ ΧΕΙΡΟΚΙΝΗΤΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΙΚΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΩΝ ΣΥΜΦΩΝΑ ΜΕ ΤΙΣ ΟΔΗΓΙΕΣ ΤΟΥ ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΥ ΤΕΧΝΙΤΗ. ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΚΑΝΟΝΩΝ ΥΓΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑΣ ΣΤΟΝ ΧΩΡΟ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΟΡΓΑΝΩΣΗΣ ΤΟΥ ΕΡΓΑΣΤΗΡΙΟΥ Η ΤΟΥ ΕΡΓΟΤΑΞΙΟΥ. , ΚΑΛΗ ΦΥΣΙΚΗ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΔΥΝΑΤΟΤΗΤΑ ΧΕΙΡΩΝΑΚΤΙΚΗΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ, ΣΥΝΕΠΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΔΙΑΘΕΣΗ ΓΙΑ ΜΑΘΗΣΗ. ΠΡΟΗΓΟΥΜΕΝΗ ΕΜΠΕΙΡΙΑ ΣΕ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΕΣ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΕΣ Η ΣΥΝΑΦΕΙΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΘΑ ΘΕΩΡΗΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΠΡΟΣΘΕΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ. , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). jobs.description: •  ΕΜΠΕΙΡΙΑ ΣΤΗ ΣΥΝΤΑΞΗ ΚΑΙ ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗ ΣΥΜΒΟΛΑΙΩΝ.  •  ΧΕΙΡΙΣΜΟΣ ΚΑΙ ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΥΠΟΘΕΣΕΩΝ.  •  ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ.  •  ΠΡΟΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΥΠΟΒΟΛΗ ΕΓΓΡΑΦΩΝ ΠΡΟΣ ΤΟ ΚΤΗΜΑΤΟΛΟΓΙΟ ΚΑΙ ΤΟ ΤΜΗΜΑ ΦΟΡΟΛΟΓΙΑΣ.  •  ΣΥΜΠΛΗΡΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗ ΕΝΤΥΠΩΝ ΚΤΗΜΑΤΟΛΟΓΙΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΤΜΗΜΑΤΟΣ ΦΟΡΟΛΟΓΙΑΣ.  •  ΣΥΝΤΟΝΙΣΜΟΣ ΚΑΙ ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΑΠΑΙΤΟΥΜΕΝΩΝ ΔΙΑΔΙΚΑΣΙΩΝ ΜΕ ΤΙΣ ΑΡΜΟΔΙΕΣ ΥΠΗΡΕΣΙΕΣ.  , ΟΙ ΥΠΟΨΗΦΙΟΙ ΘΑ ΠΡΕΠΕΙ ΝΑ ΕΙΝΑΙ ΟΡΓΑΝΩΤΙΚΟΙ, ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΙ, ΠΡΟΣΕΚΤΙΚΟΙ ΣΤΗ ΛΕΠΤΟΜΕΡΕΙΑ, ΝΑ ΜΠΟΡΟΥΝ ΝΑ ΕΡΓΑΖΟΝΤΑΙ ΜΕ ΣΥΝΕΠΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΝΑ ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΖΟΝΤΑΙ ΑΠΟΤΕΛΕΣΜΑΤΙΚΑ ΠΟΛΛΑΠΛΕΣ ΥΠΟΘΕΣΕΙΣ ΚΑΙ ΠΡΟΘΕΣΜΙΕΣ. , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , SOPHIA PAPETTA , spapetta@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.description: ΠΑΡΑΛΑΒΗ, ΜΕΤΑΦΟΡΑ ΚΑΙ ΤΑΚΤΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΤΡΟΦΩΝ ΣΚΥΛΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΓΑΤΩΝ ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΚΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ ΕΜΠΟΡΕΥΜΑΤΩΝ ΤΑΚΤΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΠΡΟΙΟΝΤΩΝ ΣΤΗΝ ΑΠΟΘΗΚΗ ΚΑΙ ΣΤΑ ΡΑΦΙΑ ΕΛΕΓΧΟΣ ΠΑΡΑΛΑΒΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΑΠΟΘΕΜΑΤΩΝ , ΚΑΛΗ ΦΥΣΙΚΗ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΔΥΝΑΤΟΤΗΤΑ ΜΕΤΑΦΟΡΑΣ ΒΑΡΟΥΣ ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ, ΣΥΝΕΠΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΕΡΓΑΤΙΚΟΤΗΤΑ ΟΡΓΑΝΩΤΙΚΟΤΗΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟ ΠΝΕΥΜΑ , Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.title: ΜΗΧΑΝΙΚΟΣ ΙΧΘΥΟΚΑΛΛΙΕΡΓΕΙΩΝ/ΥΔΑΤΟΚΑΛΛΙΕΡΓΕΙΩΝ
jobs.description: ΜΗΧΑΝΙΚΟΣ ΠΕΡΙΒΑΛΛΟΝΤΟΣ/ΥΔΡΑΥΛΙΚΟΣ ΜΗΧΑΝΙΚΟΣ ΓΙΑ ΠΛΗΡΗ ΑΠΑΣΧΟΛΗΣΗ ΣΕ ΜΟΝΑΔΑ ΙΧΘΥΟΚΑΛΛΙΕΡΓΕΙΑΣ , ΑΤΟΜΟ ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟ, ΕΡΓΑΤΙΚΟ, ΜΕ ΑΜΕΣΗ ΕΠΙΛΥΣΗ ΤΕΧΝΙΚΩΝ ΠΡΟΒΛΗΜΑΤΩΝ ΥΠΟ ΠΙΕΣΗ.  ΚΑΛΗ ΚΑΤΑΝΟΗΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΛΕΙΤΟΥΡΓΙΑΣ ΥΔΡΑΥΛΙΚΩΝ ΔΙΚΤΥΩΝ, ΑΝΤΛΙΟΣΤΑΣΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΣΤΗΜΑΤΩΝ ΡΟΗΣ/ΦΙΛΤΡΑΡΙΣΜΑΤΟΣ ΝΕΡΟΥ. ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΣΥΝΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ ΜΕ ΤΗΝ ΟΜΑΔΑ ΙΧΘΥΟΛΟΓΩΝ ΚΑΙ  ΤΕΧΝΙΚΩΝ ΤΗΣ ΟΜΑΔΑΣ. ,

jobs.title: ΒΟΗΘΟΣ ΚΗΠΟΥΡΟΥ
jobs.description: ΑΣΧΟΛΕΙΤΑΙ ΜΕ ΤΗΝ ΕΔΑΦΟΚΑΛΥΨΗ ΜΕ ΦΥΤΑ, ΤΗΝ ΠΑΡΑΣΙΤΟΚΤΟΝΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΤΗΝ ΠΕΡΙΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΚΗΠΩΝ  , ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΑΡΣΗΣ ΒΑΡΕΩΝ ΑΝΤΙΚΕΙΜΕΝΩΝ  , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , SOPHIA PAPETTA , spapetta@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). jobs.title: ΠΩΛΗΤΕΣ/ΠΩΛΗΤΡΙΕΣ
jobs.description: ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΑ: ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ, ΒΟΗΘΕΙΑ ΣΤΗΝ ΕΠΙΛΟΓΗ ΠΡΟΙΟΝΤΩΝ. ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑ ΣΤΟ ΤΑΜΕΙΟ. ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΤΑΞΗΣ ΣΤΟΝ ΧΩΡΟ ΤΟΥ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΗΜΑΤΟΣ. ΕΛΕΓΧΟΣ ΠΡΟΙΟΝΤΩΝ ΚΑΤΑ ΤΗΝ ΠΑΡΑΛΑΒΗ ΤΟΥΣ. ΤΑΚΤΙΚΗ ΑΝΑΠΛΗΡΩΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΠΡΟΙΟΝΤΩΝ ΣΤΑ ΡΑΦΙΑ. ΑΝΑΛΗΨΗ ΟΠΟΙΟΝΔΗΠΟΤΕ ΑΛΛΩΝ ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΩΝ ΚΑΘΟΡΙΣΤΟΥΝ ΑΠΟ ΤΟΝ/ΤΗΝ ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟ/Η ΤΟΥ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΗΜΑΤΟΣ.  , ΑΠΑΙΤΗΣΕΙΣ: ΑΡΙΣΤΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΓΓΛΙΚΗΣ ΓΛΩΣΣΑΣ. ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑΚΕΣ ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΕΣ, ΦΙΛΙΚΗ ΔΙΑΘΕΣΗ, ΠΡΟΣΟΧΗ ΣΤΗ ΛΕΠΤΟΜΕΡΕΙΑ. ΕΥΓΕΝΕΙΑ, ΠΡΟΘΥΜΙΑ, ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟ ΠΝΕΥΜΑ.  , Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.title: ΛΕΙΤΟΥΡΓΟΣ ΓΡΑΦΕΙΟΥ, ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗΣ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ & ΠΩΛΗΣΕΩΝ
jobs.description: - ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΥΦΙΣΤΑΜΕΝΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΝΕΩΝ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ ΜΕΣΩ ΤΗΛΕΦΩΝΟΥ, ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΝΙΚΟΥ ΤΑΧΥΔΡΟΜΕΙΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΠΡΟΣΩΠΙΚΩΝ ΣΥΝΑΝΤΗΣΕΩΝ ΟΠΟΥ ΑΠΑΙΤΕΙΤΑΙ.   - ΑΝΑΠΤΥΞΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΟΛΟΓΙΟΥ, ΔΙΕΥΘΕΤΗΣΗ ΡΑΝΤΕΒΟΥ, ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΠΡΟΣΦΟΡΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑ ΜΕ ΠΕΛΑΤΕΣ.   - ΠΑΡΟΧΗ ΔΙΟΙΚΗΤΙΚΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΓΡΑΜΜΑΤΕΙΑΚΗΣ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗΣ, ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗ ΑΡΧΕΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΛΗΛΟΓΡΑΦΙΑΣ, ΟΡΓΑΝΩΣΗ ΠΡΟΓΡΑΜΜΑΤΟΣ ΠΡΟΣΩΠΙΚΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΕΡΓΕΙΩΝ, ΚΑΘΩΣ ΚΑΙ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΒΑΣΙΚΩΝ ΔΙΑΔΙΚΑΣΙΩΝ ΑΝΘΡΩΠΙΝΟΥ ΔΥΝΑΜΙΚΟΥ (HR).   - ΕΚΤΕΛΕΣΗ ΛΟΙΠΩΝ ΣΥΝΑΦΩΝ ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΩΝ ΠΟΥ ΣΧΕΤΙΖΟΝΤΑΙ ΜΕ ΤΗ ΘΕΣΗ. , ΟΡΓΑΝΩΤΙΚΟ ΚΑΙ ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑΚΟ ΑΤΟΜΟ ΜΕ ΑΡΙΣΤΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΑΓΓΛΙΚΩΝ, ΚΑΛΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ Η/Υ. ΕΜΠΕΙΡΙΑ ΣΕ ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ, ΠΩΛΗΣΕΙΣ Ή ΔΙΟΙΚΗΤΙΚΗ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΘΑ ΘΕΩΡΗΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΠΡΟΣΘΕΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ.  ΜΕ ΑΔΕΙΑ ΟΔΗΓΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΙΔΙΟΚΤΗΤΟ ΟΧΗΜΑ.  ΓΙΑ FULL-TIME + PART-T , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

Luxembourg

Founded in 1856, Banque Internationale à Luxembourg is the oldest multi-business bank in the Grand Duchy. From its foundation, the BIL has always played an active role in the development of the Luxembourg economy. It currently operates in retail, private and corporate banking, as well as on major capital markets. Employing more than 2 000 people, BIL is present in the financial hotspots that are Luxembourg, Switzerland, and China.As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

Your next challenge:

Client Engagement : Build and maintain strong relationship with clients, demonstrating empathy and open mindedness to understand their unique needs. Actively engage with clients to provide updates on products, services, and market developments.
Support Client Needs : Identify and address client needs and concerns promptly, demonstrating empathy and a commitment providing solutions that enhance client satisfaction.
Support Relationship Managers : Assist Relationship Managers in preparing clients presentations and reports. Collaborate with other departments to ensure a seamless client experience
Follow up and Reliability : Ensure timely follow-up on client inquiries and requests, demonstrating reliability and commitment to service excellence.
Track client feedback and facilitate resolutions to enhance client satisfaction.

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
As part of the Biotechnology Unit, and particularly the Bioformulation Group, you will contribute to the machine learning assisted structure-function study of soluble dietary fibres (galactomannans) isolated from underexplored leguminous seed bioresources in the framework of the ENTANGLE FNR funded project. You will develop clean label procedures to extract and isolate galactomannans from forage legume seed biomass such as alfalfa and clover. In addition, the successful candidate is expected to determine the technofunctional and prebiotic potential of native and enzymatically modified derivatives benchmarked to commercial biopolymer targets.

As a Postdoctoral Researcher, you will mainly be responsible for:
• Extracting, isolating and purifying galactomannans from forage legume seeds
• Enzymatically tailor the chemical structure and technofunctional profile of native galactomannans
• Determine the structure conformational, technological and prebiotic potential of the native and modified galactomannans and
• Promoting and disseminating your research work through high-quality scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals, oral and poster presentations in conferences, and patents.
If you are specialised in food biopolymers, colloids science, and/or food process engineering, with a strong foundation in soft-matter physics and a focus on understanding and tailoring structure–property–function relationships for innovative food applications, please apply and join our new and dynamic team.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a member of the Corporate Finance team, you'll own the consolidated view of Notion's financial performance — the corporate model, the monthly close-to-reporting cycle, and the numbers that reach our executive team, Board of Directors, and investors. You'll immediately take ownership of core corporate FP&A workstreams, which include the consolidated P&L forecast, the monthly budget-vs-actual and reforecast cycles, and the planning systems that produce them.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Platform (Foundations Lead)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Data Foundations team builds and operates the batch and streaming infrastructure behind our product features, analytics, search, and AI experiences. We’re looking for a hands-on technical leader to shape the next generation of this platform as Notion serves larger customers, expands globally, and supports more data-intensive products. You’ll identify the highest-leverage problems, set direction, build and develop a high-performing team, and lead multi-quarter initiatives across our data lake, streaming, distributed-compute, governance, and reliability systems. You’ll stay close to critical technical decisions while creating clear ownership, growing engineers and technical leaders, and helping the team execute as one—partnering closely with Data Engineering, Data Product, Search, AI, Infrastructure, and Security.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Set the direction for Data Foundations. Turn ambiguous company and customer needs into a clear multi-quarter strategy across the data lake, streaming, distributed compute, governance, and platform reliability—and align engineers and partner teams around it.

 - Build and develop a high-performing team. Attract strong engineers, set clear expectations, grow technical leaders, and create an environment of ownership, direct feedback, and accountability.

 - Lead the team’s hardest initiatives from idea to operation. Ensure complex work has strong technical ownership, de-risk architectures through prototypes, break work into shippable milestones, and coordinate execution across engineers and teams.

 - Make Notion’s data platform enterprise-ready. Guide the team toward durable foundations for external key management, data residency, access controls, lifecycle management, and governance without creating separate systems for every requirement.

 - Raise reliability, simplicity, and cost efficiency. Identify systemic risks and architectural gaps, establish clear service ownership, and lead migrations that make Kafka, Debezium, S3/Iceberg, Spark, EMR, Athena, and related systems easier to operate at scale.

 - Multiply the engineering organization. Establish reusable abstractions and paved paths, delegate meaningful ownership, raise the quality of technical decisions, and scale expertise through coaching, documentation, tooling, design reviews, and direct collaboration.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Deep data-platform expertise. You have designed and operated large-scale batch and streaming systems and can reason across storage, compute, ingestion, orchestration, serving, governance, and production operations.

 - Direction-setting leadership. You have led a Data Platform or infrastructure team through multi-quarter work—finding the right problems, defining a strategy, sequencing execution, and driving decisions with long-term consequences.

 - Team-building and talent development. You have attracted strong engineers, grown people across career stages, developed technical leaders, and created clarity when expectations or performance needed to change.

 - Hands-on engineering judgment. You stay close to critical systems and designs and know when to prototype, simplify, buy, build, or migrate. You can go deep while preserving ownership for the engineers leading the work.

 - Platform-product thinking. You understand the needs behind partner requests and turn repeated patterns into safe, ergonomic, self-serve capabilities rather than accumulating bespoke solutions.

 - Organizational influence. You create clarity across team boundaries, surface uncomfortable technical or organizational risks early, and help engineers do their best work through strong context, delegation, feedback, and coaching.

 - You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, move faster, and build more creatively.




THE SYSTEMS AND PROBLEMS YOU MAY LEAD

 - Evolving Notion’s data lake toward an S3 + Iceberg lakehouse with stronger governance, discoverability, schema evolution, and lifecycle controls

 - Scaling Kafka and Debezium-based streaming infrastructure that powers real-time product, analytics, and AI use cases

 - Improving Spark and distributed-compute performance, workload isolation, developer experience, and cost efficiency

 - Designing EKM, data residency, and compliant processing capabilities across Notion’s data estate

 - Creating clear platform interfaces and self-serve primitives for Data Engineering, Search, AI, and product teams




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Notion’s data infrastructure is no longer only an internal analytics layer. It increasingly powers customer-facing features, AI systems, enterprise controls, and high-volume product workflows. The team needs a leader who can see across these systems, build the technical leadership and operating culture required for that responsibility, and find the problems that matter before they become roadmap blockers. Success means Data Foundations has a strong, growing team with clear direction and dependable execution—and teams across Notion can build ambitious data-powered products faster without compromising customer trust.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $281,000 - $334,000 per year.

They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Commerce & Payments
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Make Replit the single place where businesses can buy everything they need through their agents. As a Staff Software Engineer on Replit’s Money team, you’ll set technical direction and build the commerce platform that lets users discover, evaluate, purchase, and manage the products and services they need to build and run their businesses—without leaving Replit.

 

Replit already enables businesses to accept payments through integrations such as Stripe. This role builds on that foundation to expand what businesses can buy and accomplish through Replit Agent. You’ll design commerce experiences that combine the simplicity consumers expect with the controls enterprises need, making agent-assisted purchasing useful, trustworthy, and reliable.

 

You’ll own architecture and lead cross-team delivery across merchant and service-provider integrations, agent tools, purchasing workflows, and the lifecycle after a transaction. The challenge goes beyond executing a payment: agents need to understand what a user wants, present clear choices and costs, act within delegated authority, and verify that the purchase delivered the intended outcome. You’ll stay hands-on with design and code while aligning partners, mentoring engineers, and turning an ambitious product vision into incremental customer value.

Set the architecture and technical roadmap for agentic commerce, making Replit a single place to discover, buy, and manage the products and services businesses need.




YOU WILL:

 - Lead end-to-end purchasing experiences through Replit Agent: translate user intent into relevant options, communicate prices and terms, obtain appropriate authorization, execute purchases, and confirm fulfillment or provisioning.

 - Build extensible integrations with merchants, software vendors, and service providers so the platform can expand its commerce offering without rebuilding each workflow from scratch.

 - Build on existing Stripe and payments capabilities, extending payment integrations where needed to support new purchasing experiences rather than treating basic payment acceptance as a greenfield problem.

 - Design agent-facing APIs and tools with clear contracts, secure credentials, scoped permissions, spending limits, and appropriate confirmation for consequential actions.

 - Partner with product and security to support enterprise purchasing requirements such as role-based access, approval workflows, purchasing policies, and auditable transaction histories, while keeping simpler purchases easy.

 - Own the purchase lifecycle beyond checkout: provisioning and access, order and subscription state, receipts, renewals, cancellations, refunds, and reconciliation across providers.

 - Make agent-driven transactions reliable with idempotency, verified events, durable state, safe retries, and recovery from partial failures; evaluate whether workflows complete the authorized task without duplicate purchases or unintended spend.

 - Lead ambiguous initiatives across teams, define incremental milestones, stay hands-on with implementation, and raise the engineering bar through mentoring, design reviews, and production ownership.
   
   


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - A track record of Staff-level technical leadership on complex customer-facing products or platforms, taking ambiguous initiatives from architecture through launch and production operation across multiple teams.

 - Strong hands-on engineering and system design skills, including API design, data modeling, distributed workflows, and thoughtful evolution of existing systems.

 - Experience building extensible third-party integrations and handling asynchronous events, duplicate requests, partial failures, and changing provider capabilities.

 - Strong product judgment: you can turn complex, multi-step workflows into simple user experiences and balance rapid delivery with correctness and long-term flexibility.

 - A security-conscious approach to authentication, authorization, credentials, sensitive data, and actions performed on a user’s or organization’s behalf.

 - Demonstrated ability to align engineering and cross-functional partners on technical direction, document decisions clearly, and drive execution without relying on reporting authority.

 - Experience mentoring engineers and improving the quality of architecture, implementation, and operations beyond your own projects.

 - Comfort using AI-assisted development tools while taking responsibility for the correctness, security, and maintainability of the code you ship.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building commerce platforms, marketplaces, purchasing or procurement systems, or products that connect buyers with multiple vendors.

 - Experience with agent tool calling, multi-step agent workflows, or evaluations for reliable execution of actions against external systems.

 - Familiarity with payment and purchase lifecycles, including authorization, checkout, subscriptions, fulfillment or provisioning, refunds, and reconciliation.

 - Experience building enterprise capabilities such as approval workflows, role-based access, purchasing policies, budget controls, or audit trails.

 - Experience with Stripe or other payment providers, developer platforms, or partner integration ecosystems.

 


BONUS POINTS: 

 - Experience with emerging agentic-commerce protocols, MCP, or delegated authorization for agent-initiated transactions.

 - Experience integrating software and service catalogs, pricing and availability, entitlements, or automated provisioning.

 - Familiarity with recurring and usage-based costs, renewal management, international purchasing, or multi-provider transaction workflows.

 - These are additional strengths, not a checklist; prior experience spanning every commerce domain or payment provider is not expected.



WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Customer outcomes: success means a business can get what it needs through its agent, with clear costs and a verified result—not merely a completed API call.

jobs.title: DIPLOMIRANI INŽENJER/KA GRAĐEVINARSTVA-INŽENJER/KA GRAĐEVINARSTVA -PROJEKTANT
jobs.description:
PROJEKTANT HIDROTEHNIČKE STRUKE (m/ž) Želite raditi na projektima koji imaju stvaran utjecaj na razvoj gradova i infrastrukture? PRONING DHI d.o.o. traži diplomiranog inženjera građevinarstva / inženjera građevinarstva – projektanta (m/ž) koji želi svoje znanje razvijati kroz rad na složenim hidrotehničkim projektima u Hrvatskoj i regiji. Ako vas zanimaju hidrotehnika, projektiranje, modeliranje i suvremene tehnologije, a želite raditi u stručnom timu i sudjelovati u projektima od koncepcije do realizacije, voljeli bismo vas upoznati. TKO SMO MI? PRONING DHI je privatno projektno društvo iz Zagreba, osnovano 1994. godine. Više od 30 godina bavimo se projektiranjem i konzaltingom u području:
  • urbane hidrotehnike
  • hidrotehnike riječnih slivova
  • eko-inženjerstva.
Sudjelovali smo u izradi kompleksnih hidrotehničkih projekata u Hrvatskoj i regiji – od master planova kanalizacijskih sustava Zagreba, Ljubljane i Osijeka do projekta odvodnje EKO-Kaštelanskog zaljeva. Posebnu pažnju posvećujemo primjeni suvremenih tehnologija. U radu koristimo i razvijamo 1D i 2D matematičke simulacijske modele, a bavimo se i razvojem sustava za predviđanje poplava u realnom vremenu. ŠTO ĆETE RADITI? Kao član našeg projektnog tima sudjelovat ćete u:
  • izradi i vođenju tehničke dokumentacije u području komunalne hidrotehnike
  • razvoju koncepcijskih rješenja te izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata
  • izradi studija izvodljivosti
  • ishođenju akata za građenje
  • koordinaciji i suradnji s različitim stručnjacima i sudionicima u procesu projektiranja
  • drugim stručnim poslovima iz područja hidrotehničkog projektiranja, ovisno o vašem iskustvu i stručnosti.
Drugim riječima, ne tražimo samo izvršitelja zadataka, već stručnjaka koji želi sudjelovati u razvoju kvalitetnih projektnih rješenja. KOGA TRAŽIMO? Tražimo osobu koja ima:
  • VSS – dipl. ing. građ. / mag. ing. aedif. ili VŠS – ing. građ.
  • iskustvo u izradi hidrotehničkih projekata
  • dobro poznavanje tehničke i zakonske regulative iz područja građevinarstva
  • napredno znanje rada u MS Officeu, AutoCAD-u i Urbanu
  • vozačku dozvolu B kategorije
  • znanje hrvatskog i engleskog jezika.
Prednost, ali ne i uvjet, predstavljaju:
  • najmanje 5 godina radnog iskustva
  • poznavanje SWMM-a i EPANET-a
  • poznavanje GIS alata poput ArcGIS-a i QGIS-a
  • ovlaštenje za inženjera i upis u imenik ovlaštenih inženjera strukovne komore s položenim stručnim ispitom.
Nemate sve navedene kvalifikacije? Ako ste građevinski tehničar s relevantnim radnim iskustvom, također ste dobrodošli prijaviti se. ZAŠTO PRONING DHI? Kod nas ćete imati priliku: RADITI NA SLOŽENIM PROJEKTIMA Sudjelovat ćete na domaćim i internacionalnim projektima u području hidrotehnike. KORISTITI SUVREMENE TEHNOLOGIJE Radit ćete s modernim alatima i tehnologijama, uključujući matematičko modeliranje hidrotehničkih sustava. RAZVIJATI SVOJE ZNANJE Omogućujemo stručno usavršavanje i razvoj kroz rad na različitim projektima. BITI DIO STRUČNOG TIMA Radit ćete u poticajnom i dinamičnom okruženju, uz suradnju s različitim stručnjacima. IMATI STABILNE UVJETE RADA Rad se uglavnom odvija u našem uredu u Zagrebu, uz povremene terenske obilaske i neradne vikende. Uz osnovna primanja nudimo i dodatke na plaću u skladu s ostvarenim rezultatima, božićnicu, uskrsnicu i potporu za godišnji odmor. MJESTO RADA Zagreb – ured PRONING DHI Povremeni terenski obilasci prema potrebama projekata. Vrsta zaposlenja: rad na određeno vrijeme, uz mogućnost stalnog zaposlenja nakon isteka probnog perioda. ZAINTRIGIRALO VAS JE? Ako želite svoje znanje iz građevinarstva i hidrotehnike usmjeriti prema složenim projektima, suvremenim tehnologijama i stručnom razvoju, pošaljite nam svoj životopis. Prijava treba sadržavati:
  • CV / životopis s kontakt podacima
  • motivacijsko pismo.
Prijave se šalju na: info@proning-dhi.hr PRONING DHI d.o.o. Otona Kučere 5, 10000 Zagreb www.proning-dhi.hr

jobs.description:
About KPI Solutions

KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience â rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971. From initial design through go-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients.

Position SummaryÂ 

The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is an individual-contributor role responsible for the end-to-end delivery, configuration, installation, and support of Kommand warehouse execution/control systems and related material handling hardware (pick-to-light, overhead illuminators, AutoStore, and T-sort integrations). This role owns project-level system configuration, commissioning, installation, upgrade, and live troubleshooting work independently, with minimal oversight, across both on-site and remote/office phases of the project lifecycle. It combines software commissioning, hardware coordination, database scripting, environment configuration, and formal test/sign-off responsibilities that have historically been distributed across multiple roles and a dedicated installation team.Â 

This position carries broadened scope following the consolidation of hardware installation and commissioning functions previously performed by a dedicated Systems Integration & Commissioning (SI&C) team, which has since been dissolved. The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is expected to operate as the primary and, in several functions, sole point of ownership for the responsibilities outlined below.Â 

Key ResponsibilitiesÂ 

On-Site DeliveryÂ 

  • Lead software commissioning of Kommand and peripheral hardware systems at customer sites; serve as primary technical owner, with hardware-side support from junior/peer staff.Â 
  • Own full-scope installation of pick-to-light systems, including wiring, physical installation, configuration, and functional testing â a scope absorbed from the former SI&C team.Â 
  • Own full-scope installation of overhead illuminator systems, following the same end-to-end responsibility as above.Â 
  • Conduct IQ (Installation Qualification) and UAT (User Acceptance Testing) following installation, including preparation of formal test documentation and customer sign-off.Â 
  • Serve as the sole owner of Kommand and system-level troubleshooting for live, in-production issues during on-site engagements.Â 

Remote / Office DeliveryÂ 

  • Independently deliver new Kommand installations, including application pre-configuration, database scripting, and pre-deployment testing. Sole personnel on this workstream, currently managing 4 upcoming and 1 active installation.Â 
  • Independently deliver Kommand version upgrades, including SSDT (SQL Server Data Tools) schema comparisons, version control, local pre-install testing, and direct customer coordination. Sole personnel on this workstream, with approximately 22 major upgrades planned in the current year.Â 
  • Production upgrade execution is performed after standard business hours to minimize customer downtime.Â 
  • DEV, QA, and Sandbox environment work is performed during standard business hours.Â 
  • Validate, diagnose, and remediate reported defects; route confirmed fixes to QA prior to merge and deployment. Escalation to other engineering resources is rare.Â 
  • Participate in the on-call rotation covering Kommand, AutoStore, and T-sort system escalations.Â 
  • Provide post-go-live project support on an as-needed basis, including system migrations (e.g., bin/location migrations), integration testing with customer ERP/WMS platforms (e.g., SAP/WMS), and multi-site rollout support.Â 

Project Configuration & DeploymentÂ 

  • Gather all Kommand configurations and system parameters required for a given project.Â 
  • Translate the Business Requirements Document (BRD) and customer conversations into the Kommand system settings spreadsheet, network spreadsheet, and system parameters.Â 
  • Educate the client on use of the host interface.Â 
  • Not required for all projects â dependent on whether the customer's integration involves interface changes (e.g., AutoCase, Pack & Hold).Â 
  • Configure the client's Kommand sandbox environment to be project-specific for customer testing, and support the client through that testing.Â 
  • Configure the Kommand production environment ahead of go-live.Â 
  • Assist with training on any new features requiring customer or internal education.Â 

Scope & IndependenceÂ 

This role currently operates as the sole owner of several critical workstreams, including all new Kommand installations, all Kommand upgrade delivery, and all live Kommand/system troubleshooting. The role requires the judgment and technical depth to manage customer-facing delivery, testing, and sign-off without a dedicated support team, and to make sound decisions under time pressure during after-hours production changes and live escalations.Â 

  • Demonstrated experience commissioning warehouse execution/control software and associated hardware peripherals.Â 
  • Working knowledge of SQL Server-based application environments, including SSDT schema comparison and version control practices.Â 
  • Experience with formal software testing methodology (IQ/UAT), including documentation and customer sign-off processes.Â 
  • Ability to independently diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve live production issues under time pressure.Â 
  • Comfort with hands-on installation work (wiring, hardware configuration) for pick-to-light and overhead illumination systems, or willingness/ability to develop this competency.Â 
  • Willingness to work after hours and participate in an on-call rotation.Â 
  • Ability to translate business requirements documentation and customer conversations into structured system configuration (settings, network, and parameter specifications).Â 
  • Strong customer-facing communication skills; comfortable coordinating directly with customer stakeholders during upgrades, go-live support, and system/interface training.Â 

Preferred QualificationsÂ 

  • Prior experience with AutoStore and/or T-sort systems.Â 
  • Experience with ERP/WMS integration testing (e.g., SAP).Â 
  • Background in material handling, warehouse automation, or industrial controls environments.Â 

What we Offer:

    • Dental Insurance
    • Vision Insurance
    • Health Care Concierge Service
    • 401(k) Retirement Plan (Pre-tax & Roth)
    • Company paid Basic Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability & Long-Term Disability
    • Voluntary Life & AD&D Insurance
    • Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness & Hospital Indemnity Insurance
    • Pet Insurance
    • Milk Stork Program
    • Wellness Program with gift card redemption and wellness challenges
    • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & 10 Holidays)
    • Training & Development

Why KPI Solutions?

jobs.description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Leveraging AI-powered intelligence, Delineaâs leading cloud-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle â across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. It is the only platform that enables you to discover all identities â including workforce, IT administrator, developers, and machines â assign appropriate access levels, detect irregularities, and respond to threats in real-time. With deployment in weeks, not months, 90% fewer resources to manage than the nearest competitor, and a 99.995% uptime, Delinea delivers robust security and operational efficiency without compromise. Learn more about Delinea on Delinea.com, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.
